news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 9: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the offense go without the star there to demand attention from kansas city s secondary the chiefs had little problem shutting down geno smith smith threw for only 165 yards cooper led the way with 58 yards on eight receptions while mitchell went from 142 yards on seven catches last week to zero catches on seven looks a game later new york got nothing going settling for four field goals in the first half tied for the most over the last 10 seasons in the second half the jets didn t even get the opportunity to settle smith and co managed 58 yards over five drives on the other side of intermission forced to watch their two point halftime deficit unravel into a 23 point loss chiefs come alive for much needed blowout kansas city rode a two game losing streak into week 9 with a 22 fourth quarter point differential that ranked 31st in the league over the past two games if there s one thing patrick mahomes is going to do though it s beat up on bad teams by defeating the jets he moved to 18 0 in his career against teams entering a matchup four plus games under 500 the best by any quarterback since 1970 minimum 15 starts per nfl research he went 23 of 31 for 242 yards and two touchdowns with a 117 9 passer rating but most importantly seemed ok after a strip sack by david bailey late in the second quarter bent his elbow awkwardly and forced him to receive medical attention on the sideline he returned and overcame a frustrating offensive stupor to blow the doors off the jets while the chiefs defense minimized damage early and inflicted plenty of it throughout kansas city pressured geno smith on half of his dropbacks chris jones and george karlaftis led the team with six pressures and two sacks apiece while drue tranquill logged 13 tackles and nick bolton had 12 plus a forced fumble detractors will point out it s only the jets and there are still some issues to work out think harrison butker missing a 56 yard field goal and the subsequent 51 yarder after getting a reprieve due to an offsides penalty just before half but the chiefs can only play who is in front of them in this case they demolished them next gen stats insight for jets chiefs via nfl pro travis williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: Jonathan Taylor landing spots: Ranking top 7 trade fits for Colts Pro Bowl running back
news_mentions.description: With the NFL’s Nov. 10 trade deadline days away, all eyes are on Jonathan Taylor and the Colts. Kevin Patra identifies seven possible destinations for the star RB.
news_mentions.body_text: with the nfl s nov 10 trade deadline days away all eyes are on jonathan taylor and the indianapolis colts with indy in clear rebuild mode after firing general manager chris ballard moving the veteran running back could return valuable draft capital while the jury is still out on whether the colts will get their trade price met for taylor several squads could use a pro bowl running back as we push toward thanksgiving let s take a quick gander at some potential landing spots for the former all pro running back the league s worst rushing attack could certainly use some help green bay is averaging a measly 60 6 yards per game and has four total rushing touchdowns worse they re not even getting the yards blocked per next gen stats the packers have a comical 164 rush yards over expected they re averaging 1 0 rush yards over expected per carry woof the pack hoped that josh jacobs return would jumpstart the unit while he s been better than marshawn watch me bounce everything outside lloyd jacobs too has been woefully inefficient jacobs has just 75 rushing yards in two games averaging 2 3 yards per carry and has 1 1 rush yards over expected per carry as a team the packers have 27 total missed tackles forced a trade for taylor would immediately help and green bay could potentially move on from jacobs in 2027 if not sooner the question is whether brian gutekunst who played it conservatively with his backfield entering the season would shell out the draft picks needed to make the deal i m not holding my breath even though the fit makes sense the minnesota passing offense has been horrific with kyler murray at the helm carson wentz may coax more consistency this week but a long term upgrade at running back could help solve another issue for the vikings aaron jones and jordan mason have dealt with injuries and while they have generated yardage it s been inefficient jones is averaging 0 5 rush yards over expected this season and mason sits at 0 3 the vikings run attack lacks explosive plays jones and mason have combined for 14 runs of 10 plus yards taylor has 18 alone this season minnesota s poor interior blocking has played a role but the inability of the vikings backs to break tackles has led to a stymied attack 24 combined missed tackles forced from jones and mason taylor has 35 upgrading the rushing attack would help make the passing attack easier by keeping the vikings in better down and distance situations john harbaugh hasn t been shy about checking in on upgrades up and down the roster for the nfc east leaders while the giants have other needs adding a player of taylor s caliber would certainly boost j j mccarthy and the offense injuries have siphoned off the depth of the backfield tyrone tracy is on injured reserve and starter cam skattebo is dealing with a hamstring injury devin singletary stands as the primary back if skattebo can t go this week taylor and skatt would make a nice one two punch that big blue could lean on down the stretch a splash move at the deadline could go a long way to ensuring the giants keep their division lead into january and provide them a chance to pull off a postseason upset there has been scuttlebutt for weeks about the broncos potentially trading for taylor the denver rushing attack can t find a groove ranking in the bottom seven in yards per game 92 6 and sitting 26th with a 36 2 run success rate broncos rbs have combined for 10 runs of 10 plus yards this season rj harvey landing on injured reserve wiped out one option j k dobbins has been inefficient averaging 3 3 yards per carry with 100 rush yards over expected jonah coleman has shown some upside the past two weeks since returning from injury including posting 104 scrimmage yards in week 8 is it enough to quiet the concerns cincy is possibly the most interesting landing spot for taylor chase brown is a solid dual threat back and the bengals are a pass funnel offense behind joe burrow however adding an upper echelon runner could provide a completely different dimension to the offense it d be a play for the playoffs when a ground attack could be even more beneficial particularly in bad weather games cincinnati has attempted 21 9 rushes per game second fewest in the nfl behind only green bay on 94 carries brown has generated 340 yards and one td with a 35 1 success rate taylor could provide a completely different tackle breaking element pair taylor s ability to slam through light boxes with burrow s dive bombing ability and the bengals chances of returning to the super bowl would skyrocket injuries and ineffectiveness have forced washington to cycle through backs this year jacory croskey merritt still leads the commanders in rushing despite landing on injured reserve after only five games rachaad white has offered no consistency austin ekeler is 31 coming off a season ending injury and jeremy mcnichols is out for the season it s not pretty even at 2 4 1 washington isn t out of the nfc east hunt this week could be significant for that race taylor s multi year contract also puts the commanders in play for me he d provide jayden daniels a reliable running mate beyond 2026 and solve a significant problem in d c news of treveyon henderson s unexpected medical emergency gives the pats more incentive to upgrade the backfield rhamondre stevenson has averaged 3 8 yards per carry corey kiner who has impressed in limited opportunities and generated 29 rush yards over expected on just 42 carries could see a significant increase in reps however with henderson sidelined we shouldn t rule out the pats who have surged back into contention from making a splash

news_mentions.headline: John Harbaugh is Giants' biggest asset in years. Can he lead them on a dream playoff run?
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia john harbaugh was smiling on his sunday walk to the bus when he was reminded of something he said soon after the baltimore ravens fired him before the new york giants had even scooped up that fumble he had watched the 4 13 giants on tape and saw more talent than he expected told at the time that the open atlanta falcons job in the nfc south would give him a cleaner path to a division title in year 1 harbaugh said he wasn 39 t afraid of the competition in the nfc east he maintained that the same giants who had gone 13 38 over the previous three seasons could contend for their first division crown since 2011 a half hour after harbaugh agreed to become the giants 39 coach he told the athletic 34 i expect and want to make the playoffs next year 34 meaning this season 34 i thought we had good players 34 harbaugh said as he was leaving lincoln financial field as the first giants head coach to win in this building since tom coughlin in 2013 34 i didn 39 t really know the personality of the team but i think what i learned is these guys have what it takes they 39 re tough minded they 39 ve got big hearts and they 39 re willing to do what it takes having what it takes means you 39 re willing to do what it takes and they 39 ve been willing to do it they work they believe and they don 39 t flinch 34 with his first place giants at 5 2 1 after a gloriously ugly 19 11 victory over the philadelphia eagles and with his team three loss column games ahead of the dallas cowboys and washington commanders and five ahead of the eagles harbaugh was asked how far this joyride can go 34 everything is possible for every team so we 39 ve got as much chance as anybody else or more than most 34 he said 34 but we don 39 t talk about that 34 the first coach hired by the giants with a super bowl victory on his resume is too smart to dream out loud about the kind of magical way out of left field super bowl run that the new england patriots made last year on cue harbaugh said his only competitive thoughts are on thursday night against the commanders at metlife 34 but we have the lead 34 he conceded 34 my mom always said 39 keep the lead and extend the lead 39 we 39 ve got to keep winning those big picture conversations are good for you guys to talk about we 39 re only focused now on the commanders 34 this is what football coaches are trained to say they can 39 t order their players to remain locked in on the next practice rep in one breath and then address the possibility of matching the new york knicks 39 ticker tape parade in the next even after harbaugh improved his post bye week record to 16 3 and ended the giants 39 13 game losing streak in philly where he was once a longtime special teams coordinator unsure if he 39 d ever get to run his own team in the nfl and man is he ever running this team the giants did not play like a winning postseason team for much of the day especially in the first half when they allowed j j mccarthy to get sacked five times deonte banks committed a pass interference penalty that gifted the eagles a touchdown charlie jones fumbled away a punt down 8 6 to a team that had lost six in a row harbaugh spent part of halftime telling his players their performance was not acceptable 34 our head coach came in there and said we 39 ve got to clean our s up 34 francis mauigoa said 34 he 39 s the driver of the ship 133 and he keeps us focused he came in there and told us to handle our s and told us we had a lot of penalties a lot of missed blocks and we 39 re still only down two points he had that positivity in there but he also had that reality that we need to pick it up 34 patrick ricard who spent nine years with harbaugh in baltimore said the positive part of the coach 39 s halftime message 34 after how bad we looked it 39 s still a two point game 34 was important for the giants to hear 34 he has an accountability and set belief that guys hold onto especially in games like this 34 ricard said 34 maybe in years past here the guys didn 39 t get that from the coaches as much so that 39 s what 39 s been instilled in them as a group i feel like here everything is growing every week and it 39 s why you usually see a second half surge from us 34 that surge came despite the apparent knockout blow eagles linebacker zack baun delivered to mccarthy 39 s right hip leaving the quarterback in so much pain he collapsed to a knee on the sideline after one warmup throw jameis winston led the giants on a stirring 14 play touchdown drive offering the best of 34 the experience 34 with his arm and legs yet harbaugh replaced him when mccarthy suddenly returned from the locker room saying he was good to go you could argue winston deserved to stay in but almost every move harbaugh has made on and off the field including the trade for mccarthy and the two year extension for winston not everyone in the coach 39 s circle of trust loved that signing has come up roses harbaugh drafted arvell reese and reese spent the afternoon looking like a cross between harry carson and lawrence taylor harbaugh didn 39 t bring in a kicker to challenge dominic zvada and the kicker went 4 for 4 on his field goal attempts including three from between 49 and 53 yards there were all kinds of reasons for the giants to lose this game starting with the trade deadline talk that dominated the week it sure seemed sunday that the ghosts were swirling at the linc way up there with braden mann 39 s monster punt from the front of his own end zone that traveled 94 yards and was officially marked at 86 but harbaugh 39 s winning past has the giants believing in the present asked how much his coach has impacted this season kayvon thibodeaux replied 34 one hundred percent however much you can think a head coach should impact winning he 39 s impacted it 34 i think it 39 s from the day he walked in from the plan he put in and the systems he put in place one thing harbaugh 39 s talked about is principles and methods he 39 s strict on his principles and he 39 s flexible on his methods and i think that formula has allowed us to 133 let our best players play their best 34 so how far can the giants 39 best take them after losing jaxson dart brian burns and tremaine edmunds to season ending injuries can they win playoff games if they don 39 t land jonathan taylor or some other difference maker by tuesday 39 s 4 p m et trade deadline 34 that 39 s the beautiful thing in the nfl 34 ricard said 34 you never know right you never know if this is the team that can go win the super bowl all we can worry about is just getting healthy every week getting the game plan from the coaches and trying to execute on game day and just play as hard as we can the teams that win the super bowl do that they just focus on the day the mission at hand they don 39 t worry about winning the super bowl it just happens by working hard and sticking together 34 i feel like we have that makeup so why not us at the end of the day right we 39 ll just continue to get better and work and maybe it 39 s in the cards for us 34 more likely it 39 s next year or the year after or the year after that yet there 39 s no point in these giants putting an artificial ceiling on their dreams on the bus ride in harbaugh reflected on his departure from philadelphia for baltimore nearly two decades ago this homecoming with his giants touched his heart 34 it was really something 34 he said 34 i didn 39 t think it was going to be quite that 34 but he did think the giants could win the nfc east before the team even hired him before he became the franchise 39 s most valuable asset in a long long time this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Giants' Devin Singletary ready for showcase as likely RB1 vs. Eagles: 'I know what I can do'
news_mentions.description: New York Giants running back Devin Singletary, the team's overtime hero in Week 7, could be in line to lead the way on the ground this Sunday against the Philadelphia Eagles. After three healthy scratches earlier this season, he's ready for that chance.
news_mentions.body_text: just like that devin singletary will potentially be the last man standing on sunday against the eagles the giants running back room has been whittled down from a core four earlier this season to one as cam skattebo is currently doubtful to play due to a hamstring injury tyrone tracy was placed on injured reserve and najee harris was released on oct 20 the 29 year old singletary who played the hero with a 30 yard game winning touchdown run in overtime against the texans in week 7 is ready to meet the moment i know what i can do singletary said via the new york post i want to be able to display that singletary s newfound opportunity is surprising not just because of new york s rb depth only a few weeks ago but because of where the veteran ball carrier found himself in the pecking order he was a healthy scratch fourth of four on the depth chart in weeks 3 5 though that was something new for singletary who hasn t missed more than two games in a season for any reason since his 2019 rookie campaign he maintained the right attitude i just stayed positive because that s who i am singletary said do you want it to go down like this no but it s the nature of the beast i wouldn t say it was frustrating it s how the game goes a lot of competition deep backfield when that opportunity comes you want to be ready instead of being so mad or sad that you can t capture the moment when it s here singletary finally got back on the field in week 6 against the saints as new york momentarily shifted away from its normal lead back skattebo for the outing skattebo didn t receive a carry whereas six other giants players logged at least one rushing attempt singletary had four for 18 yards plus a 19 yard reception the giants released harris following the contest and tracy injured his hamstring the following game against houston in that one skattebo resumed his typical workload handling 17 carries for 124 yards and a score but on his final attempt a 42 yarder into texans territory during ot he felt something in his hamstring skattebo slid down to protect against injuring it further singletary stepped up and he broke through for the 30 yard game winner the very next play although skattebo hasn t been ruled out he managed only a limited practice friday before receiving a doubtful designation that means singletary could very well see an extended chance to build on his big run that took place before the team s week 8 bye he would be joined by rookie gregory desrosiers and phil mafah who was elevated from the practice squad in the backfield should singletary get the start it will be his first since week 2 of 2025 a very much unforeseen development for the eight year vet hoping to stack some success for big blue

news_mentions.headline: Bengals' Joe Burrow enjoying Madrid's museums, feeling like ‘normal person’ ahead of Madrid game
news_mentions.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the NFL.
news_mentions.body_text: madrid cincinnati bengals quarterback joe burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the nfl burrow and the bengals are in madrid to take on the atlanta falcons on sunday looking to win their fourth straight game and move to 6 2 in the afc north the trip is not only about football for burrow though he was not yet with the bengals when the team played its first two games abroad in 2016 and 2019 in london this is somewhere that i ve always wanted to go he said friday and so to be able to do it while doing what i love playing football is really a dream come true for me burrow said he was recognized by a group of americans studying abroad while walking around the spanish capital but was enjoying a bit of anonymity on the streets of madrid i usually expect to go pretty incognito and not have anybody recognize me he said it s a little bit more than that but i love being out here because i can feel like a normal person for a little while art connoisseur europe was also allowing burrow to enjoy one of his passions art i went to museo del prado on wednesday that was cool burrow said of spain s renowned art museum and the plan for his half day off on friday was to go find more art in madrid i d like to go see some more museums and go to an art gallery do a little shopping but we ll see he said fashion change shopping in madrid could also be an attractive option for burrow who s been known for his interest in fashion and bold pregame outfits and it could be good timing for him as the bengals quarterback said he has been going through a style change i ve tried to elevate my looks a little bit recently he said for a couple of years there i was full streetwear and i started out going suits on gameday every day and didn t really feel like that was me so i switched it up to full streetwear and that might have been an overcorrection in my creative mind i m finding a happy medium now spanish sports knowledge burrow said he grew up watching soccer and lamented not being able to see one of the two spanish powerhouses play while he was in spain i ve followed international sports for a long time followed real madrid for a long time watched barcelona play real madrid a lot he said played with both of those teams on fifa a lot when i was a kid and loved watching soccer my whole life really so i wish they played while we were here at their home stadium so we could go unfortunately that s not gonna happen but hopefully one day i can make it putting on a show burrow said the bengals explosive and dynamic offense will be fun to watch at real madrid s santiago bernabeu stadium he said he was excited about being the nfl s main attraction sunday morning in the united states i love the only game on tv on sunday morning when people back home wake up and i love showcasing our talents abroad and trying to bring attention to what we do he said offensive line praise burrow threw for five touchdowns and ran for another in overtime as the bengals rallied to defeat the tennessee titans 43 36 last sunday we re completing a lot of passes right now our offensive line is protecting great i think this is the best that that group has played since i ve been here which is really exciting to see he said and you know a lot of our young players are getting better and better and we have the right guys who attack every day with the intent to be better than the day before and i think that is so valuable in this sport super bowl contenders burrow said the bengals still have more to prove before deserving to be considered super bowl contenders i don t think we deserve it yet he said we haven t done enough there s still a lot of season left we certainly have to be a lot better than we have been if we want to be that team at the end of the year winning the super bowl we certainly can we have the capability to do it but right now we aren t there no fast food for zac taylor bengals coach zac taylor joked that he wouldn t really accept anyone going for american fast food while in madrid i ve judged a couple people he said now my kids might be opting for that if you re under 14 years old yes if not i will judge you greatly wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was quick to say friday that he wasn t one of those going for fast food but he did say he missed his chef he also said he was recognized maybe twice on the streets of madrid on thursday defensive tackle dexter lawrence said he missed his bed copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Struggling players at midseason: Is Justin Herbert broken beyond repair? Can DK Metcalf get right?
news_mentions.description: Is Justin Herbert broken beyond repair? Will DK Metcalf ever provide the Steelers with WR1 production? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks examines 10 struggling players. Can they turn things around before season's end?
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he diagnoses the problems afflicting some notable names two months into the 2026 nfl regular season several prominent players are struggling while everyone endures occasional slumps the best can get out of a tailspin with more work and some schematic tweaking today i m spotlighting 10 disappointing players five on offense five on defense and assessing whether each can turn things around before season s end

news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 7 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 7 sunday baltimore ravens guard olaivavega ioane knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to cincinnati carolina panthers offensive tackle taylor moton suffered a fractured fibula in sunday s loss to tampa bay and will be out for a while head coach dave canales said cincinnati bengals tight end erick all knee and safety kyle dugger quadricep were ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore cleveland browns cornerback myles harden hamstring did not return to sunday s win over tennessee detroit lions cornerback ennis rakestraw ankle did not return to sunday s win over the packers green bay packers center sean rhyan ankle and offensive lineman jacob monk quad did not return to sunday s loss to the lions houston texans wide receiver jaylin noel has a turf toe injury head coach demeco ryans told reporters after sunday s loss to the giants las vegas raiders defensive end patrick johnson stinger neck did not return to sunday s loss to the rams miami dolphins cornerback julius brents stinger did not return to sunday s win over the jets minnesota vikings running back aaron jones knee did not return to sunday s win over indianapolis new orleans saints safety justin reid concussion and running back cj donaldson shoulder were ruled out of sunday s loss to pittsburgh in paris new york giants running back tyrone tracy hamstring did not return to sunday s win over houston running back cam skattebo said after the game that he felt something in his hamstring on his 42 yard run in overtime skattebo added that he did not slide on purpose on the play per espn new york jets defensive tackle t 39 vondre sweat knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to miami seattle seahawks wide receiver rashid shaheed knee was ruled out against the chiefs rb velus jones hamstring was also ruled out
