touchdown to interception ratio of 11 1 in his previous four games sunday marked a step back for the third year qb he threw three interceptions in the first half and was lucky to avoid a fourth on a pass that was nearly picked off by the packers kamal hadden new england fell behind 24 7 in the second quarter and the rout was on maye was without wr1 a j brown but brown s only played in three games all season making a total of nine catches for 101 yards the patriots can t count on him to solve all their problems they were also without rb2 treveyon henderson on sunday and it s not clear when he will be back after being hospitalized recently with what he described as a medical emergency to make matters worse rb1 rhamondre stevenson exited the game with a knee injury there were more injuries to a banged up offensive line on sunday too it s all far from ideal for a team with playoff aspirations after winning the afc title last season now the patriots will go overseas for a munich matchup with the lions who have won four games in a row packers defense has something special brewing green bay s offense deserves plenty of praise for its performance but we should not overlook the team s defensive showing yes the packers gave up 27 points but the patriots two second half touchdowns were scored in garbage time when the game was out of hand jonathan gannon s defense had drake maye out of sorts from the jump finishing with four sacks and four takeaways all three of maye s ints ended up in the hands of safeties with xavier mckinney picking him off twice and evan williams snagging one on a deflection maye was pressured on 51 2 of his dropbacks the highest pressure rate he has faced in a regular season game just below the 52 8 he faced in the super bowl against the seahawks per next gen stats and we might not have seen green bay s best on defense yet with three time first team all pro apparently micah parsons getting closer to making his 2026 debut next gen stats insight for packers patriots via nfl pro patriots cornerback christian gonzalez allowed a career high 10 receptions for 187 yards on 11 targets in coverage against the packers nearly matching his yards allowed during his first six games this season 196 yards and the third most by any defender in a game this season gonzalez was targeted on seven of his 17 matchups against matthew golden allowing all seven targets to be caught for 105 yards he was also targeted on three of his four matchups against christian watson allowing three receptions for 82 yards and a td gonzalez is the only player since 2018 to allow more than 80 receiving yards to multiple players in the same game he had never allowed more than 71 yards in a game to a single receiver previously nfl research the packers scored a season high 45 points in their week 9 win the most the patriots have ever allowed in a game at gillette stadium green bay also posted a season high 478 total yards including 129 rushing yards after failing to surpass 90 rushing yards in any of their first eight games of the 2026 season back to top nick shook s takeaways seahawks grind out another win seattle s offense still leaves plenty to be desired but managed to finish with 295 yards pieced together two touchdown drives that ended with tight end aj barner reaching the end zone and snuffed out arizona s comeback attempt by gaining three first downs and maintaining possession over the final 4 35 to secure a 17 3 win seattle accomplished this with backup drew lock playing in place of sam darnold while also dealing with his own elbow injury and sustaining an oblique injury during sunday s game generating enough offense to build a satisfactory lead for the defense to protect for the remainder of the game perhaps most importantly the seahawks won a game without receiving a massive contribution from jaxon smith njigba who finished with seven catches for 51 yards and didn t need to become the game breaking weapon he s been in most of seattle s triumphs this season it wasn t a performance that will take any heat off embattled offensive coordinator brian fleury but the win will quiet critics for the next week and a 5 4 record looks better than a 500 mark at this stage it was also equally important for seattle to keep pace in an nfc west that now features three teams above 500 minshew magic runs out gardner minshew s insertion into the lineup sparked a frantic comeback effort in a thrilling win over dallas in week 8 clearing the way for minshew to take over as starter for arizona to trade jacoby brissett to baltimore and for the cardinals to proceed with another veteran who seemed to have a better rapport with his targets and a higher willingness to take calculated risks in order to jump start the offense that gave cardinals fans reason to believe mike lafleur s offense might finally produce a quality day offensively even against one of the nfl s best defenses instead arizona encountered a familiar experience in its rematch with seattle struggling to generate offense and falling well short of competing with the seahawks in a loss that truly wasn t as close as the score suggested making matters worse was a hit minshew took to his right arm while throwing which seemed to sap him of the arm strength necessary to find open targets in the second half even when arizona flirted with another fourth quarter comeback minshew and the cardinals offense ran aground inside seattle s 10 extinguishing their fading hope of climbing back into the game and reminding arizona of the uphill battle it will face in most matchups going forward does this mean we might see rookie carson beck soon no not yet unless minshew s arm ends up being hurt worse than what was detectable sunday but the thrill of minshew s arrival and instant success proved to be unreliable dropping the cardinals to 3 6 in a season that s likely already starting to look toward april charbonnet shows some juice zach charbonnet the other half of seattle s past two headed backfield finally returned to the field in week 8 but didn t generate much in terms of production or pop it wasn t surprising given the nature of the knee injury that kept him out until his midseason arrival but with the seahawks desperate for ground game consistency they could use a notable contribution from the power back and finally received one sunday charbonnet rushed 16 times for 77 yards made a handful of defenders miss broke some tackles and looked much more like the runner he was in previous seasons bringing a welcome level of balance to an offense that already relied too heavily on sam darnold and was expected to do the same with backup drew lock jadarian price flashed in the passing game too making a fantastic sideline catch as part of his four receptions for 54 yards it s far from a guarantee that they ve suddenly rediscovered their ability to run the ball opponent must be considered in these small sample sizes but at least it s an encouraging sign for an offense that still hasn t found much of a rhythm next gen stats insight for cardinals seahawks via nfl pro seattle entered week 9 ranked 24th in rushing success rate 37 3 and enjoyed an uptick in that category on sunday finishing with a designed run success rate of 44 8 zach charbonnet accounted for most of the improvement finishing with a designed run success rate of 43 8 nfl research drew lock has faced the cardinals in both of his starts in 2026 and beat them in both lock is just the fourth quarterback since starts were tracked in 1950 to face the same team in each of his first two starts of a season and beat them in both joining frankie albert versus the lions in 1952 daryle lamonica versus the jets in 1963 and derek anderson versus the buccaneers in 2014 back to top grant gordon s takeaways bears survive sunday night disaster dazzling at the onset disastrous for most of the final three quarters caleb williams and the bears survived calamity to emerge with their fourth straight win after the buccaneers tied the game with 2 51 to play on sunday night williams seemingly absent of the confidence that was oozing earlier in the evening was able to drive the bears down the field thanks mostly to a 38 yard hook up with a wide open colston loveland the final drive set up cairo santos for a game winning 38 yard field goal with zeroes on the clock it wasn t in the realm of possibility that the game would end in such fashion after williams had hit luther burden on a crosser for a 56 yard touchdown that led to a 14 0 lead at the conclusion of the first quarter williams had completed six of his eight pass attempts for 105 yards and two touchdowns each of the incompletions coming on drops thereafter williams was an atrocious 16 of 29 for 174 yards zero touchdowns a career worst four interceptions and a 33 5 rating in all the bears had five turnovers with williams first three picks coming on ill advised balls in which he appeared to be trying to throw the ball away while fading back and going airborne his fourth was off a deflection and the fifth giveaway was a burden fumble that set up the game tying score burden looked to have potentially gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL experts' Week 9 takeaways: Are Rams back? Commanders make another baffling decision
news_mentions.body_text: each sunday three of the athletic 39 s nfl writers react to the biggest news plays and performances from the day 39 s games we 39 re just about halfway through the regular season and it doesn 39 t feel like any team has separated itself as the clear cut super bowl favorite that team was supposed to be the los angeles rams who were seen as a super team back in the preseason but they 39 e battling just to make the playoffs they 39 ve started to right the ship with three straight wins including a 20 13 victory over the washington commanders on sunday the rams still have plenty of work to do but it 39 s easier to work on problems when you 39 re winning games the commanders aren 39 t so fortunate you 39 d think after a couple of high profile blunders around game management dan quinn 39 s team would have fixed those issues but there jayden daniels was on sunday with three seconds left and 31 yards to the end zone throwing well short of the goal line to end the game it 39 s fair to wonder how much longer this can go on for quinn in less chaotic action the cincinnati bengals put on an offensive clinic and torched the atlanta falcons defense early sunday in madrid joe burrow and the receiver tandem of ja 39 marr chase and tee higgins seem better than ever and will be tough to stop in the afc nfl writers mike jones ted nguyen and dan pompei share their thoughts on the fallout from week 9 the rams have won three straight games and are above 500 for the first time this season are they starting to look like contenders or just beating bad teams jones the rams have definitely beaten three bad teams and sunday 39 s outcome was closer than it should have been i 39 m not going to declare them contenders yet because something seems off with matthew stafford and contenders do better than 3 for 14 on third downs against bad defenses and take better care of the football the rams still have time to work on their offensive glitches and myles garrett 39 s return is a welcomed development for their defense hope does remain alive for l a but sean mcvay 39 s squad has plenty of work to do during the second half of the season nguyen they hit a soft part of their schedule that they absolutely had to sweep and they took care of business the raiders and commanders with jayden daniels aren 39 t terrible though their offense is missing key pieces with davante adams and terrance ferguson out so they 39 ve shortened the playbook winning games ugly which is the right formula they 39 re running the ball well and the defense looks more like we expected with garrett back in the lineup they need to beat the arizona cardinals in their rematch next week stafford still doesn 39 t quite look like himself the ceiling of this team will depend on how much closer he can look like the player that won the mvp last year pompei the rams are back it 39 s true they have taken advantage of a soft stretch of schedule and maybe they wouldn 39 t be getting many style points if they were figure skating but this is the nfl and they are doing what they need to do to win games the spectacular return of garrett bodes very well for a defense that has not played up to expectations this remains one of the league 39 s most gifted teams and the rams may have benefitted from their early stumbles by figuring out how to work around their deficiencies the rams are set up for a strong finish speaking of the rams commanders game washington made another baffling late game decision this time throwing the ball well short of the end zone on the final play what 39 s going on in d c jones it 39 s just more of the same for washington an apparent lack of urgency and situational awareness from players and questionable decision making from coaches david blough their 31 year old rookie offensive coordinator who has only two previous seasons worth of experience as an assistant position coach continues to go through growing pains as a play caller quinn is a defensive minded head coach but he can still provide better direction in those late game situations with time running out he 39 s coached long enough to know what his team needs to do to win there 39 s just no excuse for the mistakes being made so it 39 s just a matter of time before washington hits the reset button again nguyen we saw some teams find their way in the end zone in long yardage situations with screens in the last couple of weeks so maybe blough thought he could do something similar that 39 s all i can think of blough is a first year coordinator and he 39 s had some questionable calls unfortunately for quinn he 39 s essentially staked his job on blough working out there 39 s still some hope that the offense can get it together the nfc east is wide open right now but it 39 s looking rough for the commanders however pompei sometimes throwing short of the end zone isn 39 t a bad gamble but the commanders have made a number of questionable game management decisions they 39 re at the point where everything that doesn 39 t work is going to be scrutinized whether the blame falls on coaches or jayden daniels really doesn 39 t matter it 39 s a bad look for the team that play wasn 39 t the only problem the commanders 39 offense sputtered after the first two drives scoring only after an interception that gave them a short field the run game was not effective and the pass protection left much to be desired is the combination of the bengals 39 high powered offense and a mediocre defense enough to make noise in the afc playoffs jones as well as joe burrow is playing directing a very dangerous offense the bengals certainly can make a deep playoff run their defense isn 39 t perfect but it 39 s improving the unit definitely gives up too many yards and displays struggles on third downs but the bengals are top 10 in sacks takeaways and in the red zone this cincinnati unit is better than the 2021 22 defense when the bengals reached the super bowl and burrow and the offense are more explosive than that 2021 22 version of themselves as well the afc has some really talented teams but the bengals can hold their own against any of them nguyen absolutely after some experimenting with going under center early in the season the bengals are going back to who they are a shotgun passing team with the best receiver duo in football ja 39 marr chase and tee higgins put on a disgusting display of dominance against the falcons secondary and the way burrow was operating sunday reminded me of the peyton manning colts offenses with marvin harrison and reggie wayne the defense has enough talent to slow down opponents dexter lawrence should be in the running for defensive player of the year this is a scary scary bengals team pompei it depends how you define making noise the bengals can win in the postseason but they probably can 39 t win it all unless they play defense better than they have they have the best passing game in the league by a considerable margin but typically the best passing games needs help as the season gets long and the weather turns that means more contributions from the run game and it especially means a defense that can get opposing offenses off the field either by forcing punts or creating takeaways the defense can improve however the cleveland browns lost in overtime after shedeur sanders matched a new orleans saints touchdown but failed on a two point conversion that would have won the game agree with coach todd monken 39 s decision to go for two and the win jones yeah i think they had to go for the win given how little time was left 1 11 in overtime they risked giving the ball back to new orleans with enough time for the saints to march into field goal range and score with no time left monken played to win rather than to tie or lose nguyen i liked the decision the advantage of going second in overtime is so you have more information to work with and you have control of the ending why give the saints a chance at a walk off field goal when you can end the game with 2 yards with the way the saints were moving the ball at the end of regulation and overtime i would have tried to win the game with my offense as well pompei i have no problem with it you know his players wanted to go for it and he put the game in their hands maybe monken is more open to criticism because he had a backup quarterback making the throw but sanders played pretty well throughout the game it didn 39 t work out but it 39 s also possible it wouldn 39 t have worked out of he decided to kick the extra point this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Report: Jaguars acquiring safety Jessie Bates III from Falcons for two draft picks
news_mentions.description: The Jaguars are acquiring safety Jessie Bates from the Falcons in exchange for a 2027 second-pick and 2028 fifth-round selection, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: the jaguars have made a splash move to shore up the back end of their defense jacksonville is acquiring pro bowl safety jessie bates from the atlanta falcons in exchange for a 2027 second round pick and a 2028 fifth round pick espn s adam schefter reported the falcons are paying most of bates salary to complete the deal nfl network s ian rapoport added the jags have dealt with injuries that have sapped the back end of their defense including losing starting safety eric murray for the season with an elbow injury importing bates is a massive coup for an already good defense under coordinator anthony campanile the 29 year old safety is a ballhawk with 28 career interceptions through nine games this season he has one interception four passes defensed three forced fumbles a fumble return touchdown and 60 total tackles a rangy safety bates solidifies the back end of campanile s high flying defense that ranks in the top five against the run but is 22nd against the pass this season as a top tier afc team with a legit shot at making a super bowl run upgrading the secondary keeps the jags on course much like how jacksonville inked jakobi meyers to an extension after trading for the wr last year the jags could eventually extend the 29 year old pending free agent as a veteran cornerstone in the secondary for the 3 6 falcons coming off a loss to the cincinnati bengals in madrid the trade represents a realization that even though they re not out of the hunt in a moribund nfc south they aren t a title contender with bates playing out his contract atlanta likely would have lost him in free agency shipping out a near 30 year old safety for a few games while getting a second round pick is smart business with a ton of cap space in the offseason the falcons were unlikely to recoup any compensatory picks if bates left in free agency so paying out most of his salary to get a day 2 draft pick is a good return atlanta now has four top 100 picks and the most salary cap space in the league for the new brass to continue the rebuild in 2027

news_mentions.headline: Jonathan Taylor landing spots: Ranking top 7 trade fits for Colts Pro Bowl running back
news_mentions.description: With the NFL’s Nov. 10 trade deadline days away, all eyes are on Jonathan Taylor and the Colts. Kevin Patra identifies seven possible destinations for the star RB.
news_mentions.body_text: with the nfl s nov 10 trade deadline days away all eyes are on jonathan taylor and the indianapolis colts with indy in clear rebuild mode after firing general manager chris ballard moving the veteran running back could return valuable draft capital while the jury is still out on whether the colts will get their trade price met for taylor several squads could use a pro bowl running back as we push toward thanksgiving let s take a quick gander at some potential landing spots for the former all pro running back the league s worst rushing attack could certainly use some help green bay is averaging a measly 60 6 yards per game and has four total rushing touchdowns worse they re not even getting the yards blocked per next gen stats the packers have a comical 164 rush yards over expected they re averaging 1 0 rush yards over expected per carry woof the pack hoped that josh jacobs return would jumpstart the unit while he s been better than marshawn watch me bounce everything outside lloyd jacobs too has been woefully inefficient jacobs has just 75 rushing yards in two games averaging 2 3 yards per carry and has 1 1 rush yards over expected per carry as a team the packers have 27 total missed tackles forced a trade for taylor would immediately help and green bay could potentially move on from jacobs in 2027 if not sooner the question is whether brian gutekunst who played it conservatively with his backfield entering the season would shell out the draft picks needed to make the deal i m not holding my breath even though the fit makes sense the minnesota passing offense has been horrific with kyler murray at the helm carson wentz may coax more consistency this week but a long term upgrade at running back could help solve another issue for the vikings aaron jones and jordan mason have dealt with injuries and while they have generated yardage it s been inefficient jones is averaging 0 5 rush yards over expected this season and mason sits at 0 3 the vikings run attack lacks explosive plays jones and mason have combined for 14 runs of 10 plus yards taylor has 18 alone this season minnesota s poor interior blocking has played a role but the inability of the vikings backs to break tackles has led to a stymied attack 24 combined missed tackles forced from jones and mason taylor has 35 upgrading the rushing attack would help make the passing attack easier by keeping the vikings in better down and distance situations john harbaugh hasn t been shy about checking in on upgrades up and down the roster for the nfc east leaders while the giants have other needs adding a player of taylor s caliber would certainly boost j j mccarthy and the offense injuries have siphoned off the depth of the backfield tyrone tracy is on injured reserve and starter cam skattebo is dealing with a hamstring injury devin singletary stands as the primary back if skattebo can t go this week taylor and skatt would make a nice one two punch that big blue could lean on down the stretch a splash move at the deadline could go a long way to ensuring the giants keep their division lead into january and provide them a chance to pull off a postseason upset there has been scuttlebutt for weeks about the broncos potentially trading for taylor the denver rushing attack can t find a groove ranking in the bottom seven in yards per game 92 6 and sitting 26th with a 36 2 run success rate broncos rbs have combined for 10 runs of 10 plus yards this season rj harvey landing on injured reserve wiped out one option j k dobbins has been inefficient averaging 3 3 yards per carry with 100 rush yards over expected jonah coleman has shown some upside the past two weeks since returning from injury including posting 104 scrimmage yards in week 8 is it enough to quiet the concerns cincy is possibly the most interesting landing spot for taylor chase brown is a solid dual threat back and the bengals are a pass funnel offense behind joe burrow however adding an upper echelon runner could provide a completely different dimension to the offense it d be a play for the playoffs when a ground attack could be even more beneficial particularly in bad weather games cincinnati has attempted 21 9 rushes per game second fewest in the nfl behind only green bay on 94 carries brown has generated 340 yards and one td with a 35 1 success rate taylor could provide a completely different tackle breaking element pair taylor s ability to slam through light boxes with burrow s dive bombing ability and the bengals chances of returning to the super bowl would skyrocket injuries and ineffectiveness have forced washington to cycle through backs this year jacory croskey merritt still leads the commanders in rushing despite landing on injured reserve after only five games rachaad white has offered no consistency austin ekeler is 31 coming off a season ending injury and jeremy mcnichols is out for the season it s not pretty even at 2 4 1 washington isn t out of the nfc east hunt this week could be significant for that race taylor s multi year contract also puts the commanders in play for me he d provide jayden daniels a reliable running mate beyond 2026 and solve a significant problem in d c news of treveyon henderson s unexpected medical emergency gives the pats more incentive to upgrade the backfield rhamondre stevenson has averaged 3 8 yards per carry corey kiner who has impressed in limited opportunities and generated 29 rush yards over expected on just 42 carries could see a significant increase in reps however with henderson sidelined we shouldn t rule out the pats who have surged back into contention from making a splash

news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams undaunted by 4-INT night in win over Bucs: 'I'm going to keep grippin' it, keep rippin' it'
news_mentions.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams threw four interceptions, but led the game-winning drive to move to 7-2 on the season.
news_mentions.body_text: caleb williams career high four interception night in a last second 27 24 win over the tampa bay buccaneers won t make the chicago bears quarterback gun shy i m going to throw until i can t throw anymore williams said via espn that s how i live i work my tail off to be in this position i ll never not throw the ball i could throw 100 picks in one game if it comes down to it i m going to throw that pass that i did to tight end https www nfl com players colston loveland or if it s a tighter window i m going to rip it in there that s how i grew up that s who i am i don t get gun shy that s not me that s not my identity that s not who i am with that i m going to keep grippin it keep rippin it and coach calls it it s time to go make a play the four ints were the most for williams in the nfl college or high school per nfl research chicago got off to a scorching start sunday night with williams ripping off platform throws all over the field as the bears built a 14 0 lead on two flawless drives then the interceptions started williams threw picks on three of the next four drives he got greedy on his first int trying to fit a ball to rome odunze at the goal line between two defenders his next two turnovers were poor attempts to throw the ball away the final int came when bucs cornerback jacob parrish tipped a pass and linebacker alex anzalone snagged it through it all the bears maintained their lead with a ferocious defensive effort that kept forcing punts and generated a couple of turnovers of their own chicago s fifth turnover came late in the fourth quarter when wide receiver luther burden took a helmet shot that caused a concussion and fumbled deep in his own territory tampa turned the fumble into the game tying td and converted the two point try despite the second half struggles in which chicago had a single first down on its first six drives williams let it rip on the final possession the qb converted a big first down coming out of the two minute warning then found colston loveland deep for 38 yards to set up the game winning field goal despite the displeasure i might be presenting right now there s a lot of good in terms of building this team that comes from a win like this because it s like i said one it s hard to win under those circumstances coach ben johnson said we really haven t been in that situation where in the fourth quarter with little time left needing to go and field goal touchdown whatever that is it just hasn t happened a whole lot this year and yet i feel like our guys we are prepped for that and we re ready for it that s what i know now after going through that i know as a play caller i certainly felt great it was as calm as i felt on calling plays there that last drive as i was all game long sunday marked the third time since 2000 the bears have won a game committing at least five turnovers the previous two such games came in the 2006 season when they appeared in super bowl xli williams four ints were the most by any quarterback in a win since jared goff had five interceptions in a week 10 2024 win over the texans also on sunday night football williams performance against the bucs blitzes told the story he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz then he went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives on the game winning drive he completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz they sent the same blitz a couple of times and they got through and that s what happens williams said when a defense sends a similar blitz or sends a blitz over and over that just means that they re getting through that means they re going to keep going until we stop it we have to find ways to get better we have to find ways to push through that we have to find ways when it does happen we have to make the adjustments and then when it does happen i have to be the big eraser it wasn t pretty for williams whose impressive 70 completion percentage entering the game took a hit but it didn t cost the bears a win in a hotly contested nfc north race and that s what really matters

news_mentions.headline: Nick Sirianni not ruling out staff changes during Eagles' bye week following 7th consecutive loss
news_mentions.description: The Philadelphia Eagles lost their seventh consecutive game, falling 19-11 to the New York Giants on Sunday afternoon.
news_mentions.body_text: the philadelphia eagles head into the bye week spiraling losers of seven straight including sunday s 19 11 defeat to the new york giants with the trade deadline approaching the roster could look different when the club returns coach nick sirianni also didn t rule out staffing changes over the week off we ll talk sirianni said via espn obviously right now my job is to be there for our guys and to go watch the tape and go look through everything i ll do anything i can to help this team win football games i ll look at myself internally first and then go from there my job is to coach the players and to coach the coaches and anything i can do to help this team win games we ll do everything can always be on the table but i don t think you change just to change because that s what your record says that you ve got to look at what s really real and not react to anything else with the playoffs a pipe dream at this point the eagles are obvious sellers ahead of tuesday s trade deadline even if howie roseman doesn t gut the entire roster at the very least players on expiring contracts such as tight end dallas goedert corner tariq woolen and defensive tackle moro ojomo should garner trade interest the offensive struggles have been the no 1 reason behind the eagles plummet both before and after jalen hurts went down with blood clots sean mannion a 34 year old first time play caller hasn t had a handle on what the offense does well or how he wants to frame game plans the instability up front has been one big issue the offensive line has struggled from the onset lane johnson s retirement stung and the club jettisoned cam jurgens after the center s struggles continued the ground game has been horrific and whoever has been under center has struggled to generate positive plays after entering sunday s game with the league s worst three and out rate the joe milton led offense failed to earn a first down on seven drives in the loss to the giants milton took over for an ineffective tanner mckee while the offense tried to stretch the field a bit more and milton used his legs well it looked like an operation led by a qb making his first start after being in town for only a few weeks philly has had to operate at times without key players from hurts to johnson to devonta smith to saquon barkley and others however it s been more than just injuries that have stymied the eagles offense mannion and offensive line coach chris kuper are squarely in the crosshairs of criticism heading into the bye obviously none of us offensively have done a good enough job we re not going to sit here as coaches and it s not sean it s all of us and it starts with me sirianni said i think the correct question there to me is do you think you ve done a good enough job obviously i haven t done a good enough job we all have things that we ve got to get better at and we ve got to figure it out on offense if sirianni plans to make an in season change to his coaching staff the bye week makes the most sense to pull the trigger

news_mentions.headline: Patriots throw grand nostalgia party for 2016 team, then forget to play football
news_mentions.body_text: foxborough mass what a festive celebratory nostalgia fueled party the new england patriots staged at gillette stadium on sunday let us count the ways 8226 a reunion was held for the 2016 outfit that rallied from a 28 3 deficit to beat the atlanta falcons in super bowl li 8226 rob gronkowski was introduced as the newest red jacketed member of the patriots hall of fame 8226 and yes that was tom brady himself in the house with ol 39 no 12 making his first gillette stadium appearance in his role as lead analyst on fox telecasts but then came the mother of all buzzkills as the green bay packers rolled to a 45 27 victory over the not ready for primetime patriots the score is misleading as it suggests an afternoon of nonstop offense and rock em sock em robots it was only some of that what the score doesn 39 t reveal is that the pats fell on their faces pretty much from the moment the national anthem was completed with drake maye throwing an interception on his first pass of the game it was the first of his three perhaps even more alarming new england cornerback christian gonzalez had his worst outing as a member of the patriots his performance so sputtering and out of sorts that it 39 s hardly unfair to wonder if injured receiver a j brown isn 39 t the only player on this team with a contract that hasn 39 t worked out so far it wasn 39 t just that the patriots 34 lost 34 to the packers on national television they were overmatched in so many ways that it might be wise at least for a week or two to cool the jets on all that the pats can beat any team in the afc and make it back to the super bowl talk 34 it 39 s frustrating 34 gonzalez said after the game but then without even taking a breath he played off the whole thing as a bad day at the office 34 i want to be who i am for the team and everybody knows what i am 34 he said 34 i mean it 39 s football i 39 m gonna have a bad game in this profession 133 and if it 39 s a good game i say 34 all right 34 we move on it 39 s just like that there 39 s things i messed up on and we 39 ll get back to it next week 34 that 39 s all fine this business of having a bad game but even taking into consideration that gonzalez has missed time with injuries this season the fact is that this cornerback who 39 s entitled to a bad game has yet to have a great game he will earn approximately 36 million this season 34 they just got the best of me today 34 gonzalez said 34 it 39 s pro football they got good receivers like every team 34 perhaps we shouldn 39 t get too caught up on athletes 39 canned hackneyed responses that are delivered just moments after a tough loss such as when gonzalez said 34 it 39 s not the end of the world 34 even so it 39 s a bad look to reason that hey 34 it 39 s football 34 and anyway patriots coach mike vrabel had a better take on how things played out against the packers 34 we got our asses kicked there 39 s no two ways about it 34 asked specifically about gonzalez 39 s performance vrabel said 34 when your best players don 39 t play good you don 39 t have much of a chance in this league we expect a lot more he expects a lot more we need more from everybody else 34 so how does any of this connect with the fact that gronk brady and a busload of veterans from the 34 28 3 34 game were in the house maye was asked whether any of that was a distraction 34 i wouldn 39 t say that 34 he said 34 we were focused on the packers i don 39 t think there 39 s a correlation 34 maye is correct having blasts from championships past in the house doesn 39 t inspire the current team to play harder run faster etc nor does it weigh on or intimidate the opponent and yet it 39 s doubtful anybody on the 2016 patriots ever said 34 it 39 s football 34 after a bad game and they certainly didn 39 t say it on super sunday feb 5 2017 as they were being pushed all over the field by the falcons and falling behind 28 3 and speaking of 34 28 3 34 two scores were displayed on the playing surface during sunday 39 s pregame ceremonies the final score of super bowl li 34 28 and the most famous in game score in super bowl history 28 3 it would have made for a great story had the present day patriots been inspired to make a similar comeback but nothing of the sort happened the patriots trailed by a bucketload of glaring deficits including 17 0 24 7 34 14 42 14 and 45 21 to be fair the patriots have been decimated by injuries this season particularly on offense in the pass catching department that maye still managed to complete 21 of 38 passes for 299 yards and three touchdowns can be viewed as an encouraging sign but ticket purchasing patriots fans shouldn 39 t have to figure out what it means when gonzalez says 34 it 39 s football 34 after a bad loss and since we 39 re dredging up the 2016 patriots let 39 s go for broke and bring up the 2014 patriots that 39 s the year then patriots coach bill belichick a day after a 41 14 loss to the kansas city chiefs on 34 monday night football 34 famously buried that game in a ditch by repeatedly saying 34 we 39 re on to cincinnati 34 one week later the patriots beat the bengals they won seven straight games went 10 2 through the end of the regular season then defeated the seattle seahawks in super bowl xlix the patriots 39 next game is sunday against the detroit lions in munich vrabel did not come right out and say 34 we 39 re on to munich 34 after sunday 39 s loss to the packers but the patriots need a reboot and they need one quickly or they might soon find even a wild card berth out of reach new england is 5 4 barely above 500 in most seasons teams that are barely above 500 usually don 39 t make the playoffs it 39 s football this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Niners' Christian McCaffrey catches 37th career touchdown, setting new running back record
news_mentions.description: San Francisco RB Christian McCaffrey caught his 37th career touchdown pass on Sunday against the Raiders, giving him the most receiving scores for a running back in the Super Bowl era.
news_mentions.body_text: the versatility of christian mccaffrey has propelled him into the record books the san francisco 49ers running back caught his 37th career touchdown during sunday s 38 17 win over the las vegas raiders giving him the most receiving scores in the super bowl era for a running back mccaffrey s record setting tally came with 5 15 left in the second quarter on a 12 yard pass from brock purdy the record td reception came after mccaffrey had already found the end zone on the day with a 1 yard touchdown run in the first quarter ahead of the 2026 season mccaffrey s 36 receiving scores were tied for first in the super bowl era with hall of famer marshall faulk who played for the then st louis rams and indianapolis colts mccaffrey is now tied for fifth in nfl history for receiving scores by a running back with hall of famer johnny blood mcnally who like most above cmc lined up as a tailback wingback and halfback hall of famer lenny moore a flanker and halfback who played from 1956 1967 is first all time with 48 receiving scores the 30 year old cmc snapped a nine game drought without a receiving score dating back to last regular season he had two td catches in last season s wild card round that streak was the longest of his career but he s delivered a reminder that he is still one of the best dual threat backs in the game and of all time mccaffrey a four time pro bowler is coming off a stellar 2025 campaign in which he had 2 126 scrimmage yards and 17 scrimmage tds including tying for a career high touchdown receptions cmc is well on his way to the pro football hall of fame with his latest record staking accomplishment

news_mentions.headline: John Harbaugh is Giants' biggest asset in years. Can he lead them on a dream playoff run?
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia john harbaugh was smiling on his sunday walk to the bus when he was reminded of something he said soon after the baltimore ravens fired him before the new york giants had even scooped up that fumble he had watched the 4 13 giants on tape and saw more talent than he expected told at the time that the open atlanta falcons job in the nfc south would give him a cleaner path to a division title in year 1 harbaugh said he wasn 39 t afraid of the competition in the nfc east he maintained that the same giants who had gone 13 38 over the previous three seasons could contend for their first division crown since 2011 a half hour after harbaugh agreed to become the giants 39 coach he told the athletic 34 i expect and want to make the playoffs next year 34 meaning this season 34 i thought we had good players 34 harbaugh said as he was leaving lincoln financial field as the first giants head coach to win in this building since tom coughlin in 2013 34 i didn 39 t really know the personality of the team but i think what i learned is these guys have what it takes they 39 re tough minded they 39 ve got big hearts and they 39 re willing to do what it takes having what it takes means you 39 re willing to do what it takes and they 39 ve been willing to do it they work they believe and they don 39 t flinch 34 with his first place giants at 5 2 1 after a gloriously ugly 19 11 victory over the philadelphia eagles and with his team three loss column games ahead of the dallas cowboys and washington commanders and five ahead of the eagles harbaugh was asked how far this joyride can go 34 everything is possible for every team so we 39 ve got as much chance as anybody else or more than most 34 he said 34 but we don 39 t talk about that 34 the first coach hired by the giants with a super bowl victory on his resume is too smart to dream out loud about the kind of magical way out of left field super bowl run that the new england patriots made last year on cue harbaugh said his only competitive thoughts are on thursday night against the commanders at metlife 34 but we have the lead 34 he conceded 34 my mom always said 39 keep the lead and extend the lead 39 we 39 ve got to keep winning those big picture conversations are good for you guys to talk about we 39 re only focused now on the commanders 34 this is what football coaches are trained to say they can 39 t order their players to remain locked in on the next practice rep in one breath and then address the possibility of matching the new york knicks 39 ticker tape parade in the next even after harbaugh improved his post bye week record to 16 3 and ended the giants 39 13 game losing streak in philly where he was once a longtime special teams coordinator unsure if he 39 d ever get to run his own team in the nfl and man is he ever running this team the giants did not play like a winning postseason team for much of the day especially in the first half when they allowed j j mccarthy to get sacked five times deonte banks committed a pass interference penalty that gifted the eagles a touchdown charlie jones fumbled away a punt down 8 6 to a team that had lost six in a row harbaugh spent part of halftime telling his players their performance was not acceptable 34 our head coach came in there and said we 39 ve got to clean our s up 34 francis mauigoa said 34 he 39 s the driver of the ship 133 and he keeps us focused he came in there and told us to handle our s and told us we had a lot of penalties a lot of missed blocks and we 39 re still only down two points he had that positivity in there but he also had that reality that we need to pick it up 34 patrick ricard who spent nine years with harbaugh in baltimore said the positive part of the coach 39 s halftime message 34 after how bad we looked it 39 s still a two point game 34 was important for the giants to hear 34 he has an accountability and set belief that guys hold onto especially in games like this 34 ricard said 34 maybe in years past here the guys didn 39 t get that from the coaches as much so that 39 s what 39 s been instilled in them as a group i feel like here everything is growing every week and it 39 s why you usually see a second half surge from us 34 that surge came despite the apparent knockout blow eagles linebacker zack baun delivered to mccarthy 39 s right hip leaving the quarterback in so much pain he collapsed to a knee on the sideline after one warmup throw jameis winston led the giants on a stirring 14 play touchdown drive offering the best of 34 the experience 34 with his arm and legs yet harbaugh replaced him when mccarthy suddenly returned from the locker room saying he was good to go you could argue winston deserved to stay in but almost every move harbaugh has made on and off the field including the trade for mccarthy and the two year extension for winston not everyone in the coach 39 s circle of trust loved that signing has come up roses harbaugh drafted arvell reese and reese spent the afternoon looking like a cross between harry carson and lawrence taylor harbaugh didn 39 t bring in a kicker to challenge dominic zvada and the kicker went 4 for 4 on his field goal attempts including three from between 49 and 53 yards there were all kinds of reasons for the giants to lose this game starting with the trade deadline talk that dominated the week it sure seemed sunday that the ghosts were swirling at the linc way up there with braden mann 39 s monster punt from the front of his own end zone that traveled 94 yards and was officially marked at 86 but harbaugh 39 s winning past has the giants believing in the present asked how much his coach has impacted this season kayvon thibodeaux replied 34 one hundred percent however much you can think a head coach should impact winning he 39 s impacted it 34 i think it 39 s from the day he walked in from the plan he put in and the systems he put in place one thing harbaugh 39 s talked about is principles and methods he 39 s strict on his principles and he 39 s flexible on his methods and i think that formula has allowed us to 133 let our best players play their best 34 so how far can the giants 39 best take them after losing jaxson dart brian burns and tremaine edmunds to season ending injuries can they win playoff games if they don 39 t land jonathan taylor or some other difference maker by tuesday 39 s 4 p m et trade deadline 34 that 39 s the beautiful thing in the nfl 34 ricard said 34 you never know right you never know if this is the team that can go win the super bowl all we can worry about is just getting healthy every week getting the game plan from the coaches and trying to execute on game day and just play as hard as we can the teams that win the super bowl do that they just focus on the day the mission at hand they don 39 t worry about winning the super bowl it just happens by working hard and sticking together 34 i feel like we have that makeup so why not us at the end of the day right we 39 ll just continue to get better and work and maybe it 39 s in the cards for us 34 more likely it 39 s next year or the year after or the year after that yet there 39 s no point in these giants putting an artificial ceiling on their dreams on the bus ride in harbaugh reflected on his departure from philadelphia for baltimore nearly two decades ago this homecoming with his giants touched his heart 34 it was really something 34 he said 34 i didn 39 t think it was going to be quite that 34 but he did think the giants could win the nfc east before the team even hired him before he became the franchise 39 s most valuable asset in a long long time this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Lions win for Jack Campbell as their defense gives reason to believe again
news_mentions.body_text: miami gardens fla he wasn 39 t there but he was he was on their minds in the week leading up to an emotional game his name was on their backs as they walked inside hard rock stadium ready to play for him and his signature no 46 jersey rested in the visitors 39 locker room a not so subtle reminder of the message this week it was all part of a collective collaborative effort by the detroit lions to pay homage to jack campbell 34 today was dedicated to 46 man 34 lions linebacker derrick barnes said after his defense lifted the lions to a 19 9 win over the dolphins it was an emotional week at 222 republic drive players and coaches on this team felt helpless watching campbell unable to move during last week 39 s game against the vikings on a tackle considered routine in nature campbell was in the vicinity of the ball as we 39 ve come to expect but he didn 39 t emerge players noticed they called for help and athletic trainers and medical professionals ran to his aid they kept waiting for him to get up he always gets up and when he didn 39 t they knew something was wrong campbell was placed on a spinal board then on a cart and was later transported to detroit 39 s henry ford hospital listed as a neck injury campbell lost movement as scary a situation as you 39 ll see unfold at ford field lions coach dan campbell doing his best to navigate news as it came in said the lions couldn 39 t shy away from the cloud created by campbell 39 s absence they acknowledged the injury and the violent nature of this game they broached the topic with sensitivity offering resources for players if needed it was hard to focus on football for much of the week however in a statement released by campbell and his family on wednesday campbell said he has since regained all movement of his lower body and was making progress on regaining movement of his upper body for his teammates who didn 39 t know what sort of future campbell could live the news offered them a chance to exhale move forward and shift their focus back to football and so the message this week was simple prepare and play like 46 34 it 39 s all we could do 34 dan campbell said of the situation 34 i mentioned this before he 39 ll take the prayers but he didn 39 t want the pity he didn 39 t want you wasting the time thinking about him he certainly doesn 39 t want us to go and not play our best ball and lose a game so that 39 s what we could do and we wanted to honor him there 39 s nothing easy about it this is hard because you do want to talk about it and acknowledge it because if you just brush it under the rug that 39 s not fair i mean the guy means too much to us and so the guys did that 34 the linebacker room knew they wanted to honor campbell at sunday 39 s game they just didn 39 t know how a few different ideas were discussed t shirts were the early answer until they realized those might take weeks to arrive they kept workshopping in search of something quick barnes spoke with lions head equipment manager tim o 39 neill and asked if he could supply the linebackers and a few defensive coaches with no 46 campbell jerseys a plan was put into motion they wore them to breakfast together they wore them into the stadium and when they arrived in the locker room the equipment team left a locker and nameplate for campbell sandwiched between derrick barnes and trevor nowaske with campbell 39 s jersey resting on a hanger 34 it was kind of a collective effort 34 said trevor nowaske campbell 39 s closest friend on the team 34 obviously this whole week 39 s been just kind of trying to support him any way we can 133 we were thinking of a couple different things and you know it 39 s just something kind of subtle to just show that no matter what he 39 s with us whether he 39 s here or not 34 barnes who wore the green dot and communicated detroit 39 s defensive calls sunday spent a little extra time on his tablet in the locker room this week like campbell typically would linebackers knew that a little bit more was expected of them from barnes to nowaske to malcolm rodriguez all three were either here before campbell joined the team or arrived the same year and on their first defensive snap of the game those three met at the line of scrimmage together and stonewalled dolphins running back ollie gordon for no gain a fitting start and a tone set 34 when we hopped up i looked around and said 39 ok 44 rodriguez there we go now aske 39 34 barnes said after the game campbell wasn 39 t out there but you wouldn 39 t know it the way this defense played without their leader they held true to their word preparing and playing like campbell it was early and often against a dolphins team that reminded lions players of themselves back in 2021 and 2022 what made it all the more impressive was that the lions weren 39 t just without campbell they were missing their best cornerback d j reed as well as starting edge rusher dj wonnum and yet this was without question their best defensive effort of the season the lions allowed a season low nine points and 228 yards of offense while controlling the line of scrimmage they held the dolphins to 77 rushing yards on 21 attempts limiting miami to zero or negative rushing yards on 28 6 percent of their attempts second best in week 9 they picked off malik willis and sacked him three times all three coming in the fourth quarter they allowed just two explosive plays on sunday a season low and they got off the field when it mattered holding miami to just 4 of 12 on third down and 0 of 3 in the red zone the dolphins could only muster three field goals each defensive stop each turnover or turnover on downs each field goal attempt players on this defense thought of 46 34 really anytime we were kind of in a rut today or they popped one or something in my head i 39 m just like 39 hey man listen if there 39 s one thing i 39 m gonna do today i 39 m gonna just go balls to the wall because i know jack would 39 34 nowaske said 34 that 39 s what i just kept coming back to and that 39 s really how i played all day 34 the lions 6 2 are playing good football right now they 39 ve won four in a row keeping pace in the toughest division in the league a defense that looked like one of the nfl 39 s worst is now rounding into form in weeks 1 4 the lions allowed 31 75 points per game second worst at the time since week 5 they rank fourth at just 15 5 and while they haven 39 t exactly faced a juggernaut in those games their efforts have directly contributed to wins picking up the slack for the offense at times between better execution the return of brian branch the looming return of kerby joseph and potential additions at the trade deadline this defense is giving folks reason to believe again even if campbell is merely a spectator in the immediate future in the meantime sunday was an ode to campbell and everything he means to this team even though campbell 39 s teammates can admit he 39 ll probably be annoyed with their gesture when they touch base 34 i already know he 39 s gonna be mad 34 nowaske said laughing 34 i know him and i know he 39 s gonna be like 39 guys what are you doing 39 but i mean we gotta show our support to our dog 34 the lions will continue to it is not customary for players on injured reserve to have a designated locker for a road game especially one they didn 39 t travel but you can make an exception for a player like campbell 34 that locker 39 s traveling and we 39 ll do our part 34 dan campbell said the lions won 39 t soon forget campbell and his contributions to this team but they understand they have a job to do to win on sunday they did it for him this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Ravens' Lamar Jackson (right thumb) out 6-9 weeks, expects to return this season
news_mentions.description: Lamar Jackson's latest injury has sidetracked the Ravens' 2026 season, but the two-time MVP may not be lost for the year.
news_mentions.body_text: lamar jackson s latest injury has sidetracked the ravens 2026 season leaving them to trade for journeyman jacoby brissett this week amid a 4 5 start but the two time mvp may not be lost for the year the baltimore signal caller suffered a fractured and dislocated thumb on his right hand on nov 1 and is expected to miss at least six weeks after undergoing surgery nfl network s ian rapoport reported sunday jackson could miss up to nine weeks with his recovery which would put his return to play around the start of the postseason at the latest if the ravens make it that far rapoport reported that jackson told his teammates after week 8 that he plans to return later this season the ravens qb was initially reported to be out indefinitely with jackson and tyler huntley out for the season with turf toe placed on injured reserve the ravens were forced to start undrafted third stringer joe fagnano on thursday night against jacksonville it did not go well the ravens then acquired brissett on friday in a trade with hopes that the veteran qb can lead baltimore to enough wins in the ensuing weeks to make a jackson return worthwhile baltimore faces the chargers panthers texans and buccaneers a combined 8 21 record in the next five weeks before finishing the season with four games in the brutal afc north the ravens are currently last in the division jackson has started five games this season his first under coach jesse minter but has finished just three he left baltimore s week 4 game with an ankle sprain and missed three weeks upon his return in week 8 jackson was knocked out of the game on the ravens first offensive snap when his right hand collided with a bills defender on the season jackson is 68 of 97 passing for 967 yards six touchdowns and one interception adding 144 rushing yards and a td brissett started all eight of the cardinals games before being benched midway through their week 8 comeback win over dallas he was demoted to third string the following day and then dealt to baltimore the 33 year old journeyman has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 tds and seven ints this season brissett will try to keep baltimore afloat with the expectation that jackson can return to a playoff bound ravens team and take them over the top

news_mentions.headline: Saints activate WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring), LT Kelvin Banks (ankle) from IR
news_mentions.description: The New Orleans Saints plan to activate wide receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. from injured reserve, ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reported Saturday. The team has since announced activating both players.
news_mentions.body_text: offensive reinforcements are coming for the saints new orleans is activating wide receiver jordyn tyson and left tackle kelvin banks from injured reserve espn s jeremy fowler reported saturday the team announced both roster moves shortly after tyson the no 8 overall pick in the 2026 draft is the splashier name coming back he was limited all week as he geared up for his return from a hamstring injury that wiped out the first half of his rookie season one of two top 10 wr picks in april s draft tyson hauled in 158 receptions for 2 282 yards and 22 touchdowns across four collegiate seasons split between arizona state and colorado he joined new orleans expected to form one of the next great pass catching duos with chris olave but a training camp hamstring injury delayed a look at how the pair would fare together running routes for quarterback tyler shough the 22 year old will mix back into action alongside olave the team leader with 49 catches and 636 yards as well as devaughn vele and tight end juwan johnson banks return so soon is a pleasant surprise as the standout left tackle suffered a severe high ankle sprain in week 2 that required surgery he spent only six weeks on ir however and his re entry to the lineup should be a boon for shough who could be in line for a bit better protection after seeing a pressure rate of 35 3 this season 17th among qbs new orleans getting some potential difference makers back is massive for a club that sits at the bottom of a still winnable nfc south the saints are 2 5 but they re only one game back of the other three teams in the win column the falcons 3 5 the buccaneers 3 5 and the panthers 3 4 coming out of their bye week much healthier it s now or never for the saints if they re to start climbing out of the hole they dug themselves new orleans kicks off against the browns at 1 p m et on sunday
