season and a half has been for washington the team had a chance to win two games in a row for the first time since jayden daniels rookie year 2024 on sunday they scored first taking a 3 0 lead early but the rams tied the game later in the first quarter and washington never led again twice the commanders started drives in rams territory and they only managed to turn those possessions into a total of three points daniels was 24 of 35 passing for 274 yards and the team s lone touchdown but he also had a costly fumble in the second quarter the qb had little help from the running game with rachaad white and austin ekeler combining for 44 yards on 15 carries 2 9 per with their hopes continuing to dim the commanders now face a road game on a short week they ll visit the nfc east leading giants on thursday night the division rivals tied when they met in week 5 dominant nacua carries the rams offense los angeles wr1 puka nacua finished with 170 yards accounting for nearly 50 percent of the team s total offense on sunday the team must be holding its collective breath right now though with espn s adam schefter and nfl network s mike garafolo reporting nacua suffered a knee injury on the offense s final snap of the game the rams do not believe nacua has an acl tear but he will undergo an mri on monday to determine the severity of the injury per the report the all pro made 14 catches for a season high 150 yards and a touchdown on 19 targets also he had two carries for 20 yards washington played zone on 84 1 of nacua s routes and he caught 12 of 17 targets for 128 yards against it his most yards against zone coverage in a game this season per next gen stats he did lose a fumble but jayden daniels fumbled the ball right back to the rams on the next possession it was still far from easy sledding for the rams offense which started the game 0 for 9 on third down matthew stafford threw an interception on a pass to nacua and was not at his sharpest as a passer the rams scored their fewest points in a game since their last loss an 18 16 defeat against the cardinals the team stafford and co will visit in week 10 next gen stats insight for rams commanders via nfl pro the rams used 13 personnel on 40 of 73 offensive plays 54 8 in their win over the commanders the highest rate by an offense in a game this season in 13 personnel the rams averaged 5 3 yards per play with a 57 5 success rate and a touchdown in all other groupings 33 plays they averaged 4 4 yards per play with a 27 3 success rate and a touchdown nfl research puka nacua now has nine career games with 150 plus receiving yards two more than any other player since he entered the nfl in 2023 he broke a tie with hall of famer elroy hirsch for the third most such games in rams history and now trails only hall of famer isaac bruce 13 and torry holt 12 back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways stroud texans offense is humming in a homecoming game for c j stroud who grew up in southern california he threw the ball to whoever he wanted and wherever he wanted against the chargers evidence that he s playing some of the most confident football of his pro career stroud finished with an impressive 384 yards and five touchdowns before exiting with just under 9 minutes to play in the blowout win tying his career high td passes in a game week 9 of 2023 stroud was well protected by his offensive line and his receivers rewarded him for throwing the ball with pinpoint accuracy look no further than houston s third touchdown drive of the day on three of his four completions stroud dropped absolute dimes on outbreaking routes to dalton schultz 14 yards marvin harrison 15 yards and kayshon boutte 12 yard td who each hauled in the pass with toe tapping flare and talk about jaw dropping catches nico collins made a one handed 13 yard touchdown reception while tank dell and boutte each scored on 63 yard catch and run plays boutte led all receivers with 125 receiving yards on four catches dell finished with 105 yards the fifth career 100 yard receiving game and xavier hutchinson also caught the opening td his second straight week with a score houston ended the game with nearly 500 yards of offense sending a signal to the rest of the league that its qb is making a serious push for mvp chargers spiraling nothing absolutely nothing went well for los angeles on sunday perhaps the lone positive on the day was that the offense finally scored a touchdown a 58 yard catch and run connection between justin herbert and quentin johnston with 12 47 minutes left in the fourth quarter that snapped a 37 drive touchdown drought dating back to week 5 against denver injuries penalties turnovers it all added up to another lopsided loss the team s eighth of the year offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel tried something new sunday calling plays from the box instead of the sideline the first time doing so since 2021 his lone season as 49ers oc but to no avail the unit which was without no 1 receiver ladd mcconkey who experienced back spasms during pre game warmups did ok early by moving into houston territory on four straight drives yet it settled for a punt and three field goals los angeles final three drives of the half were abysmal three plays for negative 1 net yard three plays for negative 4 net yards and three plays for negative 4 net yards ultimately leading to a 15 point deficit at the half the sluggishness before halftime has been a huge crutch for the chargers this season as they have been outscored 47 6 41 in the final two minutes of the second quarter the result of this game was already clear early in the third with the boo birds showing up credit to houston s defense stay tuned for constantly flustering herbert who completed 13 of his 23 passes for 193 yards the touchdown and an interception herbert exited the game after his td pass was assessed by trainers on the sideline and came out of the blue tent with a glove on his left non throwing hand 2025 udfa dj uiagalelei entered the contest in place of herbert throwing a garbage time touchdown in his first nfl appearance it s hard to say where the chargers go from here texans d brings the boom demeco ryans had to be pleased with the texans defensive effort sunday save for that 58 yard chargers garbage time touchdown that snapped l a s td drought his unit relentlessly pressured justin herbert all game long sacking him a whopping eight times sheldon rankins jadeveon clowney and will anderson logged two apiece while m j stewart and logan hall each had one anderson now leads the nfl with 9 5 sacks breaking his tie with t j watt pittsburgh is on a bye frankly the entire unit was mostly exquisite derek stingley recorded his first pick of the season and had three pbus kamari lassiter had four passes defensed azeez al shaair had a team high nine tackles henry to 39 oto 39 o forced a fumble and calen bullock recovered it for a unit that was performing pretty far below expectation early in the season it s rounding into form now several weeks after ryans took back play calling duties next gen stats insight for texans chargers via nfl pro c j stroud completed 10 of 16 passes on intermediate throws between 10 and 19 air yards for 254 yards five touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the chargers it is the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span nfl research with his successful 56 yard field goal in the first quarter ka 39 imi fairbairn tied sebastian janikowski for the third most 50 plus yard field goals in nfl history with 58 back to top kevin patra s takeaways warner niners d dominates in rout of raiders fred warner s push for the defensive player of the year award took another impressive leap forward the nfl s best off ball linebacker dominated a raiders offense that had moved the ball this year warner executed a perfect peanut punch on brock bowers on the ensuing drive the lb pounced on another forced fumble later he perfectly timed a leap over the line to tackle kirk cousins on a sneak for the game he gobbled up five tackles one tackle for loss a forced fumble and a fumble recovery warner sets the tone for a ferocious defense the niners forced five second half turnovers including four straight to close out the contest when the raiders threatened to make it a game raheem morris crew slammed the door shut niners offense handles business coming off the bye week kyle shanahan s squad quickly knocked off the rust with brock purdy deftly going through reads to find open targets the qb spearheaded td drives of 12 13 and 12 plays to open up the game with a 21 7 lead despite still missing wideouts the niners offense didn t miss a beat purdy s worst throw was an undershot of an open george kittle that was intercepted outside of that miscue the mvp candidate shined particularly by pushing the ball downfield on passes of 10 plus air yards purdy went 7 for 11 for 153 yards a td and an int he went 2 for 2 on passes of 20 plus air yards for 74 yards including ripping a 37 yard touchdown to jordan watkins with the ground game blasting for 190 yards on 43 carries the niners offense was a force following its first loss of the season turnovers sink raiders chances despite getting down big early vegas had a chance to make things interesting in the second half but kept stumbling kirk cousins threw a pick six on the opening possession of the third quarter the turnovers were just beginning brock bowers fumble was followed by michael mayer getting the ball punched out as he went into the end zone then the worst sequence happened bowers took a pass and galloped to the goal line he was stopped one yard short cousins lost two yards on a sneak an offensive pass interference call wiped out a mayer td then cousins underthrew a ball in the end zone for an int on back to back drives the raiders got the ball to the half yard line and came away with zero points oof vegas simply doesn t have the horses to keep things close when it turns the ball over at that rate next gen stats insight for 49ers raiders via nfl pro jordan watkins caught all four of his receiving targets for 84 yards career high and his first career touchdown in a win against the raiders his 17 4 average air yards per target were a season high nfl research christian mccaffrey scored his 37th career receiving touchdown breaking a tie with marshall faulk for the most by a running back in the super bowl era mccaffrey snapped a career long drought of nine straight games without a receiving touchdown dating back to week 17 of the 2025 season mccaffrey also scored a rushing touchdown giving him 18 career games with both a rushing and receiving touchdown extending his record for the most in nfl history back to top dan parr s takeaways love states mvp case i m not sure anyone is going to overtake current favorite josh allen in the mvp race this season but as i predicted he would jordan love planted his flag firmly in the conversation with his performance on sunday love completed 23 of 29 passes for 372 yards with three touchdowns in three and a half quarters of work backup tyrod taylor entered the blowout win in the fourth quarter love remains the league leader in passing yards with 2 618 232 yards more than any other qb sunday was yet another game where love received almost no help from the league s least productive running game and he also faced a lot of heat with the patriots pressuring him on 13 of his 33 dropbacks 39 4 it didn t matter love was locked in and dropping dimes to christian watson and matthew golden making a talented new england secondary look silly at times watson finished with a career high 171 receiving yards on seven catches while golden led the team with 10 grabs for a career high 164 yards the packers were the underdogs entering sunday s game but matt lafleur s crew controlled the contest from start to finish with its 1 2 start to the season feeling like a distant memory green bay gets a rematch at home against the nfc north leading vikings next week one storyline to follow leading up to that battle will be the status of running back josh jacobs who suffered a fractured finger on sunday maye s turnovers too much for patriots to overcome progress isn t always linear and sunday offered pats fans a stark reminder of that fact after drake maye shook off a turnover plagued start to the season to compile a touchdown to interception ratio of 11 1 in his previous four games sunday marked a step back for the third year qb he threw three interceptions in the first half and was lucky to avoid a fourth on a pass that was nearly picked off by the packers kamal hadden new england fell behind 24 7 in the second quarter and the rout was on maye was without wr1 a j brown but brown s only played in three games all season making a total of nine catches for 101 yards the patriots can t count on him to solve all their problems they were also without rb2 treveyon henderson on sunday and it s not clear when he will be back after being hospitalized recently with what he described as a medical emergency to make matters worse rb1 rhamondre stevenson exited the game with a knee injury there were more injuries to a banged up offensive line on sunday too it s all far from ideal for a team with playoff aspirations after winning the afc title last season now the patriots will go overseas for a munich matchup with the lions who have won four games in a row packers defense has something special brewing green bay s offense deserves plenty of praise for its performance but we should not overlook the team s defensive showing yes the packers gave up 27 points but the patriots two second half touchdowns were scored in garbage time when the game was out of hand jonathan gannon s defense had drake maye out of sorts from the jump finishing with four sacks and four takeaways all three of maye s ints ended up in the hands of safeties with xavier mckinney picking him off twice and evan williams snagging one on a deflection maye was pressured on 51 2 of his dropbacks the highest pressure rate he has faced in a regular season game just below the 52 8 he faced in the super bowl against the seahawks per next gen stats and we might not have seen green bay s best on defense yet with three time first team all pro apparently micah parsons getting closer to making his 2026 debut next gen stats insight for packers patriots via nfl pro patriots cornerback christian gonzalez allowed a career high 10 receptions for 187 yards on 11 targets in coverage against the packers nearly matching his yards allowed during his first six games this season 196 yards and the third most by any defender in a game this season gonzalez was targeted on seven of his 17 matchups against matthew golden allowing all seven targets to be caught for 105 yards he was also targeted on three of his four matchups against christian watson allowing three receptions for 82 yards and a td gonzalez is the only player since 2018 to allow more than 80 receiving yards to multiple players in the same game he had never allowed more than 71 yards in a game to a single receiver previously nfl research the packers scored a season high 45 points in their week 9 win the most the patriots have ever allowed in a game at gillette stadium green bay also posted a season high 478 total yards including 129 rushing yards after failing to surpass 90 rushing yards in any of their first eight games of the 2026 season back to top nick shook s takeaways seahawks grind out another win seattle s offense still leaves plenty to be desired but managed to finish with 295 yards pieced together two touchdown drives that ended with tight end aj barner reaching the end zone and snuffed out arizona s comeback attempt by gaining three first downs and maintaining possession over the final 4 35 to secure a 17 3 win seattle accomplished this with backup drew lock playing in place of sam darnold while also dealing with his own elbow injury and sustaining an oblique injury during sunday s game generating enough offense to build a satisfactory lead for the defense to protect for the remainder of the game perhaps most importantly the seahawks won a game without receiving a massive contribution from jaxon smith njigba who finished with seven catches for 51 yards and didn t need to become the game breaking weapon he s been in most of seattle s triumphs this season it wasn t a performance that will take any heat off embattled offensive coordinator brian fleury but the win will quiet critics for the next week and a 5 4 record looks better than a 500 mark at this stage it was also equally important for seattle to keep pace in an nfc west that now features three teams above 500 minshew magic runs out gardner minshew s insertion into the lineup sparked a frantic comeback effort in a thrilling win over dallas in week 8 clearing the way for minshew to take over as starter for arizona to trade jacoby brissett to baltimore and for the cardinals to proceed with another veteran who seemed to have a better rapport with his targets and a higher willingness to take calculated risks in order to jump start the offense that gave cardinals fans reason to believe mike lafleur s offense might finally produce a quality day offensively even against one of the nfl s best defenses instead arizona encountered a familiar experience in its rematch with seattle struggling to generate offense and falling well short of competing with the seahawks in a loss that truly wasn t as close as the score suggested making matters worse was a hit minshew took to his right arm while throwing which seemed to sap him of the arm strength necessary to find open targets in the second half even when arizona flirted with another fourth quarter comeback minshew and the cardinals offense ran aground inside seattle s 10 extinguishing their fading hope of climbing back into the game and reminding arizona of the uphill battle it will face in most matchups going forward does this mean we might see rookie carson beck soon no not yet unless minshew s arm ends up being hurt worse than what was detectable sunday but the thrill of minshew s arrival and instant success proved to be unreliable dropping the cardinals to 3 6 in a season that s likely already starting to look toward april charbonnet shows some juice zach charbonnet the other half of seattle s past two headed backfield finally returned to the field in week 8 but didn t generate much in terms of production or pop it wasn t surprising given the nature of the knee injury that kept him out until his midseason arrival but with the seahawks desperate for ground game consistency they could use a notable contribution from the power back and finally received one sunday charbonnet rushed 16 times for 77 yards made a handful of defenders miss broke some tackles and looked much more like the runner he was in previous seasons bringing a welcome level of balance to an offense that already relied too heavily on sam darnold and was expected to do the same with backup drew lock jadarian price flashed in the passing game too making a fantastic sideline catch as part of his four receptions for 54 yards it s far from a guarantee that they ve suddenly rediscovered their ability to run the ball opponent must be considered in these small sample sizes but at least it s an encouraging sign for an offense that still hasn t found much of a rhythm next gen stats insight for cardinals seahawks via nfl pro seattle entered week 9 ranked 24th in rushing success rate 37 3 and enjoyed an uptick in that category on sunday finishing with a designed run success rate of 44 8 zach charbonnet accounted for most of the improvement finishing with a designed run success rate of 43 8 nfl research drew lock has faced the cardinals in both of his starts in 2026 and beat them in both lock is just the fourth quarterback since starts were tracked in 1950 to face the same team in each of his first two starts of a season and beat them in both joining frankie albert versus the lions in 1952 daryle lamonica versus the jets in 1963 and derek anderson versus the buccaneers in 2014 back to top grant gordon s takeaways bears survive sunday night disaster dazzling at the onset disastrous for most of the final three quarters caleb williams and the bears survived calamity to emerge with their fourth straight win after the buccaneers tied the game with 2 51 to play on sunday night williams seemingly absent of the confidence that was oozing earlier in the evening was able to drive the bears down the field thanks mostly to a 38 yard hook up with a wide open colston loveland the final drive set up cairo santos for a game winning 38 yard field goal with zeroes on the clock it wasn t in the realm of possibility that the game would end in such fashion after williams had hit luther burden on a crosser for a 56 yard touchdown that led to a 14 0 lead at the conclusion of the first quarter williams had completed six of his eight pass attempts for 105 yards and two touchdowns each of the incompletions coming on drops thereafter williams was an atrocious 16 of 29 for 174 yards zero touchdowns a career worst four interceptions and a 33 5 rating in all the bears had five turnovers with williams first three picks coming on ill advised balls in which he appeared to be trying to throw the ball away while fading back and going airborne his fourth was off a deflection and the fifth giveaway was a burden fumble that set up the game tying score burden looked to have potentially gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL experts' Week 9 takeaways: Are Rams back? Commanders make another baffling decision
news_mentions.body_text: each sunday three of the athletic 39 s nfl writers react to the biggest news plays and performances from the day 39 s games we 39 re just about halfway through the regular season and it doesn 39 t feel like any team has separated itself as the clear cut super bowl favorite that team was supposed to be the los angeles rams who were seen as a super team back in the preseason but they 39 e battling just to make the playoffs they 39 ve started to right the ship with three straight wins including a 20 13 victory over the washington commanders on sunday the rams still have plenty of work to do but it 39 s easier to work on problems when you 39 re winning games the commanders aren 39 t so fortunate you 39 d think after a couple of high profile blunders around game management dan quinn 39 s team would have fixed those issues but there jayden daniels was on sunday with three seconds left and 31 yards to the end zone throwing well short of the goal line to end the game it 39 s fair to wonder how much longer this can go on for quinn in less chaotic action the cincinnati bengals put on an offensive clinic and torched the atlanta falcons defense early sunday in madrid joe burrow and the receiver tandem of ja 39 marr chase and tee higgins seem better than ever and will be tough to stop in the afc nfl writers mike jones ted nguyen and dan pompei share their thoughts on the fallout from week 9 the rams have won three straight games and are above 500 for the first time this season are they starting to look like contenders or just beating bad teams jones the rams have definitely beaten three bad teams and sunday 39 s outcome was closer than it should have been i 39 m not going to declare them contenders yet because something seems off with matthew stafford and contenders do better than 3 for 14 on third downs against bad defenses and take better care of the football the rams still have time to work on their offensive glitches and myles garrett 39 s return is a welcomed development for their defense hope does remain alive for l a but sean mcvay 39 s squad has plenty of work to do during the second half of the season nguyen they hit a soft part of their schedule that they absolutely had to sweep and they took care of business the raiders and commanders with jayden daniels aren 39 t terrible though their offense is missing key pieces with davante adams and terrance ferguson out so they 39 ve shortened the playbook winning games ugly which is the right formula they 39 re running the ball well and the defense looks more like we expected with garrett back in the lineup they need to beat the arizona cardinals in their rematch next week stafford still doesn 39 t quite look like himself the ceiling of this team will depend on how much closer he can look like the player that won the mvp last year pompei the rams are back it 39 s true they have taken advantage of a soft stretch of schedule and maybe they wouldn 39 t be getting many style points if they were figure skating but this is the nfl and they are doing what they need to do to win games the spectacular return of garrett bodes very well for a defense that has not played up to expectations this remains one of the league 39 s most gifted teams and the rams may have benefitted from their early stumbles by figuring out how to work around their deficiencies the rams are set up for a strong finish speaking of the rams commanders game washington made another baffling late game decision this time throwing the ball well short of the end zone on the final play what 39 s going on in d c jones it 39 s just more of the same for washington an apparent lack of urgency and situational awareness from players and questionable decision making from coaches david blough their 31 year old rookie offensive coordinator who has only two previous seasons worth of experience as an assistant position coach continues to go through growing pains as a play caller quinn is a defensive minded head coach but he can still provide better direction in those late game situations with time running out he 39 s coached long enough to know what his team needs to do to win there 39 s just no excuse for the mistakes being made so it 39 s just a matter of time before washington hits the reset button again nguyen we saw some teams find their way in the end zone in long yardage situations with screens in the last couple of weeks so maybe blough thought he could do something similar that 39 s all i can think of blough is a first year coordinator and he 39 s had some questionable calls unfortunately for quinn he 39 s essentially staked his job on blough working out there 39 s still some hope that the offense can get it together the nfc east is wide open right now but it 39 s looking rough for the commanders however pompei sometimes throwing short of the end zone isn 39 t a bad gamble but the commanders have made a number of questionable game management decisions they 39 re at the point where everything that doesn 39 t work is going to be scrutinized whether the blame falls on coaches or jayden daniels really doesn 39 t matter it 39 s a bad look for the team that play wasn 39 t the only problem the commanders 39 offense sputtered after the first two drives scoring only after an interception that gave them a short field the run game was not effective and the pass protection left much to be desired is the combination of the bengals 39 high powered offense and a mediocre defense enough to make noise in the afc playoffs jones as well as joe burrow is playing directing a very dangerous offense the bengals certainly can make a deep playoff run their defense isn 39 t perfect but it 39 s improving the unit definitely gives up too many yards and displays struggles on third downs but the bengals are top 10 in sacks takeaways and in the red zone this cincinnati unit is better than the 2021 22 defense when the bengals reached the super bowl and burrow and the offense are more explosive than that 2021 22 version of themselves as well the afc has some really talented teams but the bengals can hold their own against any of them nguyen absolutely after some experimenting with going under center early in the season the bengals are going back to who they are a shotgun passing team with the best receiver duo in football ja 39 marr chase and tee higgins put on a disgusting display of dominance against the falcons secondary and the way burrow was operating sunday reminded me of the peyton manning colts offenses with marvin harrison and reggie wayne the defense has enough talent to slow down opponents dexter lawrence should be in the running for defensive player of the year this is a scary scary bengals team pompei it depends how you define making noise the bengals can win in the postseason but they probably can 39 t win it all unless they play defense better than they have they have the best passing game in the league by a considerable margin but typically the best passing games needs help as the season gets long and the weather turns that means more contributions from the run game and it especially means a defense that can get opposing offenses off the field either by forcing punts or creating takeaways the defense can improve however the cleveland browns lost in overtime after shedeur sanders matched a new orleans saints touchdown but failed on a two point conversion that would have won the game agree with coach todd monken 39 s decision to go for two and the win jones yeah i think they had to go for the win given how little time was left 1 11 in overtime they risked giving the ball back to new orleans with enough time for the saints to march into field goal range and score with no time left monken played to win rather than to tie or lose nguyen i liked the decision the advantage of going second in overtime is so you have more information to work with and you have control of the ending why give the saints a chance at a walk off field goal when you can end the game with 2 yards with the way the saints were moving the ball at the end of regulation and overtime i would have tried to win the game with my offense as well pompei i have no problem with it you know his players wanted to go for it and he put the game in their hands maybe monken is more open to criticism because he had a backup quarterback making the throw but sanders played pretty well throughout the game it didn 39 t work out but it 39 s also possible it wouldn 39 t have worked out of he decided to kick the extra point this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.body_text: this past summer spain sent its top footballers to the united states for a showcase of superior skill interplay and resolve the result la roja lifted its second world cup trophy campeones del mundo this sunday the nfl returns the favor in a way for the second time in as many years madrid is hosting a regular season nfl game but unlike last year s contest which featured a backup quarterback for washington and a dipping dolphins side this installment showcases two teams at near full strength with explosive ability and eyes on the postseason joe cool is on a heater for cincinnati one week removed from a maximalist six touchdown three interception outing in the bengals overtime victory over the lowly titans a win in madrid would bring cincy into a tie with the steelers atop the afc north ahead of their week 10 prime time matchup a 6 2 record would be the bengals best start since 2015 when they opened the season at 8 0 standing in their way the erratic falcons it s hard to get a grip on what the dirty birds are halfway through the season despite the sub 500 record atlanta is squarely in the nfc south race but you could say the same of any club in the uninspiring division including the buccaneers who shut out the falcons last sunday in a tampa typhoon without completing a pass the same falcons team that whooped up the packers in lambeau and handed the 49ers their only loss to date make it make sense that s a lesson for the host spaniards in the nfl any team can win on any given domingo when the bengals and falcons meet at the bernabeu on sunday in a uni matchup so bold it would make pedro almodovar blush expect the unexpected oh and unlike in that brutal world cup final against argentina expect scoring and lots of it three must know storylines 1 is there any slowing down cincy s offense the bengals have scored 78 points in the six quarters and change since a scoreless first half coming out of the bye in baltimore will their offensive onslaught continue in spain joe burrow paces the nfl in most notable passing stats 73 0 completion percentage 302 1 passing ypg 20 tds only four players in the super bowl era have ever led the league in all three of those categories in a season drew brees 2011 tom brady 2007 kurt warner 2001 and ken stabler 1976 it helps of course to have the nfl s top receiving tandem on your side burrow s passer ratings when targeting tee higgins 132 3 and ja 39 marr chase 113 6 each rank in the top five among qb wr tandems in the nfl it s a pick your poison deal for opposing defenses how will atlanta fare possibly quite well burrow might have the highest success rate on downfield passes in the next gen stats era since 2016 but the falcons are feisty 10 yards past the line of scrimmage they ve allowed 2 0 yards of separation on downfield targets the second lowest mark in the nfl and have forced a tight window on 34 8 of those targets the second highest rate plus atlanta is one of two defenses yet to allow a td on a deep pass 20 air yards this season the falcons are a turnover happy bunch as well logging at least one takeaway in seven of eight games including four against brock purdy s then unbeaten 49ers if atlanta can force burrow into some of the same mistakes he made against tennessee perhaps the bengals can be tamed through the air one thing s for sure unlike the falcons last opponent cincinnati will complete at least one pass right 2 another big day for bijan in a solo window no one in the nfl performs better in prime time than bijan robinson a 3 30 local time start in madrid isn t quite like playing under the sunday night lights but it is an exclusive tv window for robinson and the falcons which could mean a showcase for the show stopper the nfl s leading rusher has paced atlanta s fifth ranked run game at one point producing three straight gems in prime time see 478 total yards against green bay new orleans and baltimore in weeks 3 5 robinson has slowed over the last three weeks though the falcons ground game was the only thing even moderately functional in the rain soaked loss at tampa with michael penix throwing four picks is this international stage the perfect platform for a bijan bounce back cincy revamped its defensive front in the offseason and it has paid dividends overall the bengals have stuffed 31 7 of outside zone runs the highest rate in the nfl and a good trend against robinson who averages an nfl best 6 5 yards per carry on outside zone runs with a 53 2 success rate plus though robinson is a great tackle breaker averaging 4 3 yards per carry on runs where he is hit at or behind the line of scrimmage the best rate through eight games by anyone since 2018 the bengals tend not to allow such big gains they ve yielded 0 7 yards per carry second fewest when they ve hit the runner at or behind the line and their 24 5 stuff rate on designed runs is the highest in the nfl an acquaintance of real madrid and france star striker kylian mbappe robinson can only hope that in dexter lawrence and the bengals front he is not like mbappe running into the spanish backline bound for a shutout 3 an international brotherhood in this seventh international matchup of the nfl s historic nine game slate in 2026 a unique meeting is set to take place when the bengals offense faces the falcons defense cincinnati starting running back chase brown and atlanta defensive back sydney brown are set to square off against one another for the second time a battle of twin brothers on foreign soil the european encounter won t feel too strange though after all the browns journey to this moment has been an international one born in london ontario canada the brothers made their entry into the united states in high school when they relocated to bradenton florida from there sydney attended the university of illinois while chase initially went to western michigan before rejoining his brother for four seasons on the fighting illini sydney was a third round pick of philadelphia in 2023 while chase went to cincinnati in the fifth the brothers first played one another in 2024 when sydney s eagles stomped chase s bengals 37 17 in the game chase found the end zone while sydney logged three defensive snaps now the browns will meet again this time across the ocean from their homelands original and adopted chase is coming off his most productive game in what has been a slow start to the season 101 scrimmage yards versus tennessee through eight contests in his first year in atlanta sydney has logged 28 tackles one tfl a pass defensed and a forced fumble perhaps before they presumably meet to exchange jerseys after the game the brothers brown sons of ontario will collide in the middle of madrid s famed bernabeu hermano a hermano

news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the offense go without the star there to demand attention from kansas city s secondary the chiefs had little problem shutting down geno smith smith threw for only 165 yards cooper led the way with 58 yards on eight receptions while mitchell went from 142 yards on seven catches last week to zero catches on seven looks a game later new york got nothing going settling for four field goals in the first half tied for the most over the last 10 seasons in the second half the jets didn t even get the opportunity to settle smith and co managed 58 yards over five drives on the other side of intermission forced to watch their two point halftime deficit unravel into a 23 point loss chiefs come alive for much needed blowout kansas city rode a two game losing streak into week 9 with a 22 fourth quarter point differential that ranked 31st in the league over the past two games if there s one thing patrick mahomes is going to do though it s beat up on bad teams by defeating the jets he moved to 18 0 in his career against teams entering a matchup four plus games under 500 the best by any quarterback since 1970 minimum 15 starts per nfl research he went 23 of 31 for 242 yards and two touchdowns with a 117 9 passer rating but most importantly seemed ok after a strip sack by david bailey late in the second quarter bent his elbow awkwardly and forced him to receive medical attention on the sideline he returned and overcame a frustrating offensive stupor to blow the doors off the jets while the chiefs defense minimized damage early and inflicted plenty of it throughout kansas city pressured geno smith on half of his dropbacks chris jones and george karlaftis led the team with six pressures and two sacks apiece while drue tranquill logged 13 tackles and nick bolton had 12 plus a forced fumble detractors will point out it s only the jets and there are still some issues to work out think harrison butker missing a 56 yard field goal and the subsequent 51 yarder after getting a reprieve due to an offsides penalty just before half but the chiefs can only play who is in front of them in this case they demolished them next gen stats insight for jets chiefs via nfl pro travis kelce caught four of six targets for 72 yards accounting for two of the chiefs five explosive passes 40 0 nfl research kenneth walker had his first career game with multiple receiving touchdowns to go along with a rushing touchdown in the chiefs win over the jets his second career game with three touchdowns back to top bobby kownack s takeaways usual suspects lift detroit to tightly contested win sunday s victory over miami was not your typical lions affair jared goff and the offense took forever to get going and it seemed as if they knew things weren t quite clicking the lions pulled out all the stops against their one win opponent they went for it on fourth down on the first drive a few plays later jahmyr gibbs took a direct snap and faked a pitch to goff before streaking around the edge for 16 yards two plays into the second quarter detroit converted a fake punt throw by jack fox on fourth and 7 from its own 30 the lions constantly stalled out failing to score a touchdown until 1 20 remained in the third quarter and that was a run by gibbs on fourth down too luckily they had a couple stars to lean on to help guide them through their struggles amon ra st brown was the main source of the team s passing offense deep into the final frame at the start of the lions seventh drive of the game he had seven catches while the rest of detroit s pass catchers had combined for six st brown drew a third down pass interference penalty early on that possession and a few plays later hauled in a key 17 yard catch on third and 8 to keep the chains moving with a perilous seven point lead he eventually finished with 86 yards on eight receptions every other lion combined for 10 catches and 95 yards and though gibbs was frequently met by a pod of dolphins in the backfield he still broke off a number of clutch gainers including the aforementioned 8 yard td run he finished with a game high 74 rushing yards that was about it for offensive highlights but it was enough miami wastes strong defensive performance jeff hafley s defense fought valiantly against the league s no 3 scoring offense if only the rest of the team had been able to repay the group s efforts the dolphins consistently crashed into detroit s backfield to locate jahmyr gibbs containing the electric back who had been averaging 4 9 yards per carry entering week 9 to 3 7 yards per attempt on 20 rushes jared goff struggled to find and hit open passers throwing for a season low 170 yards he was sacked three times and tossed just his second pick of the season to rookie corner chris johnson after josh uche hit his arm during the throwing motion the dolphins didn t bend to the point of allowing a touchdown the only one of the game until the waning minutes of the third quarter malik willis and the offense could do nothing with their opportunities however willis threw for only 128 yards and an interception and seemed hesitant to open it up on the ground two carries for 7 yards while ollie gordon was held to 55 rushing yards when the fins had a chance to make it a tie game heading into halftime they instead committed a holding penalty and missed a 38 yard field goal on the final two plays of the second quarter toward the start of the fourth quarter down 10 with the ball at detroit s 7 yard line willis took two sacks over the next three plays before miami settled for a three points gut wrenching mistakes are no way to beat a contender like the lions and the dolphins certainly made their share of them ugly game all around one of the biggest concerns for any 5 2 team traveling to face a 1 6 opponent is typically avoiding playing down to the lesser squad s level the lions absolutely joined the dolphins in the doldrums for a messy matchup that will have neither side coming away feeling particularly happy the lions and dolphins combined for 20 accepted penalties with detroit committing nine to miami s 11 they went 7 for 24 on third down collectively detroit managed only 270 yards nearly 100 fewer than its previous low on the season 355 miami posted its second lowest yardage total of the year with 228 thanks to the offensive ineptitude a few of the most exciting plays of the matchup were actually fake punts both teams ran one and both teams converted on passes one by lions punter jack fox and another by dolphins punter bradley pinion it was the first time since at least 1950 that multiple punters have completed a pass in the same game per nfl research give credit to the lions defense for showing up and making life miserable for the dolphins but detroit didn t exactly put an exclamation point on this one despite running its winning streak to four next gen stats insight for lions dolphins via nfl pro aidan hutchinson matched up against austin jackson 16 times in week 9 all one on one recording six pressures 37 5 pressure rate including two quick pressures under 2 5 seconds nfl research jahmyr gibbs recorded his 60th career touchdown tying hall of famer ladainian tomlinson for the second most by any player in their first four seasons in nfl history trailing only hall of famer terrell davis with 61 back to top nick shook s takeaways saints come alive to earn much needed win by all accounts sunday was an ugly display of football between two middling teams for most of the afternoon a field goal fest including a charlie smyth first half miss set up for what appeared to be a likely 9 6 finish until the browns finally hit a big play for a touchdown when shedeur sanders connected with rookie kc concepcion for a 64 yard passing touchdown the score seemed to position the browns for another fourth quarter comeback win but instead it awoke the saints with just enough time for chaos to ensue new orleans covered 55 yards in six plays and 50 seconds to take a 16 13 lead allowed the browns to tie the game with 0 08 left then embarked on an efficient relentless 74 yard scoring drive that required 11 plays and ended with a pretty touchdown pass from tyler shough to juwan johnson for a 23 16 lead in overtime the stop of cleveland s two point try in overtime sealed the win but it was only made possible by some late success that must have felt for saints fans like the thawing of an offense that spent far too long frozen within a glacier at 3 5 the saints are back in the thick of a race for an nfc south crown that might only require nine wins to secure if they re going to get there sunday s late push toward a victory was essential browns show clear weaknesses in brutal defeat cleveland has lost its ability to stop the run since losing maliek collins to injury and delivered an embarrassing effort against the saints low ceiling rushing attack sunday allowing audric estim 233 who was a member of the browns less than a month ago tyler shough and alvin kamara to run for 155 yards on 31 attempts pacing an offense that came to life thanks to this newfound balance in the second half even worse cleveland s pass coverage unit struggled losing one on one matchups all afternoon grant delpit ronnie hickman and tyson campbell each struggled in such matchups and especially in the game s most crucial moments e g juwan johnson s overtime touchdown and a 33 yard completion from shough to chris olave late in the fourth quarter paired with an offense that wasn t threatening for most of the afternoon with sanders at quarterback cleveland was guaranteed to be locked in a four quarter battle with a team most expected it to defeat without a major struggle instead the browns fell in a fashion that is a strong competitor with their week 1 blowout loss to jacksonville for worst defeat of the season that s not a good place to be in in week 9 shough finds his stride new orleans offense has lacked juice for some time now draining the saints of their early season optimism that was tied to the trajectory of tyler shough in his second nfl season that finally changed in the fourth quarter sunday when cleveland stunned the superdome crowd with an explosive touchdown pass from shedeur sanders to kc concepcion new orleans offense woke up stringing together well designed passing plays with a rushing attack that finally showed some life to move down the field with relative ease against a browns defense that had limited it all afternoon shough was at the center of all of it calmly dropping dimes on chris olave juwan johnson and even rookie jordyn tyson to propel the offense to two clutch touchdown drives in a wild fourth quarter and overtime period we saw the return of a composed accurate shough whose clutch gene reappeared after going into hiding over the last month the timing couldn t be better for this saints team which will be in a weekly fight for survival in an nfc south that remains wide open there s no guarantee their rushing success carries over but getting shough back on track was a massively important development for coach kellen moore who was able to demonstrate some of his expertise in how he news_mentions.headline: Bears QB Caleb Williams undaunted by 4-INT night in win over Bucs: 'I'm going to keep grippin' it, keep rippin' it'
news_mentions.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams threw four interceptions, but led the game-winning drive to move to 7-2 on the season.
news_mentions.body_text: caleb williams career high four interception night in a last second 27 24 win over the tampa bay buccaneers won t make the chicago bears quarterback gun shy i m going to throw until i can t throw anymore williams said via espn that s how i live i work my tail off to be in this position i ll never not throw the ball i could throw 100 picks in one game if it comes down to it i m going to throw that pass that i did to tight end https www nfl com players colston loveland or if it s a tighter window i m going to rip it in there that s how i grew up that s who i am i don t get gun shy that s not me that s not my identity that s not who i am with that i m going to keep grippin it keep rippin it and coach calls it it s time to go make a play the four ints were the most for williams in the nfl college or high school per nfl research chicago got off to a scorching start sunday night with williams ripping off platform throws all over the field as the bears built a 14 0 lead on two flawless drives then the interceptions started williams threw picks on three of the next four drives he got greedy on his first int trying to fit a ball to rome odunze at the goal line between two defenders his next two turnovers were poor attempts to throw the ball away the final int came when bucs cornerback jacob parrish tipped a pass and linebacker alex anzalone snagged it through it all the bears maintained their lead with a ferocious defensive effort that kept forcing punts and generated a couple of turnovers of their own chicago s fifth turnover came late in the fourth quarter when wide receiver luther burden took a helmet shot that caused a concussion and fumbled deep in his own territory tampa turned the fumble into the game tying td and converted the two point try despite the second half struggles in which chicago had a single first down on its first six drives williams let it rip on the final possession the qb converted a big first down coming out of the two minute warning then found colston loveland deep for 38 yards to set up the game winning field goal despite the displeasure i might be presenting right now there s a lot of good in terms of building this team that comes from a win like this because it s like i said one it s hard to win under those circumstances coach ben johnson said we really haven t been in that situation where in the fourth quarter with little time left needing to go and field goal touchdown whatever that is it just hasn t happened a whole lot this year and yet i feel like our guys we are prepped for that and we re ready for it that s what i know now after going through that i know as a play caller i certainly felt great it was as calm as i felt on calling plays there that last drive as i was all game long sunday marked the third time since 2000 the bears have won a game committing at least five turnovers the previous two such games came in the 2006 season when they appeared in super bowl xli williams four ints were the most by any quarterback in a win since jared goff had five interceptions in a week 10 2024 win over the texans also on sunday night football williams performance against the bucs blitzes told the story he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz then he went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives on the game winning drive he completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz they sent the same blitz a couple of times and they got through and that s what happens williams said when a defense sends a similar blitz or sends a blitz over and over that just means that they re getting through that means they re going to keep going until we stop it we have to find ways to get better we have to find ways to push through that we have to find ways when it does happen we have to make the adjustments and then when it does happen i have to be the big eraser it wasn t pretty for williams whose impressive 70 completion percentage entering the game took a hit but it didn t cost the bears a win in a hotly contested nfc north race and that s what really matters
