material_news_signals.headline: Eagles QB Joe Milton prepares for first start: NFL is about 'being ready when your name is called'
material_news_signals.description: Joe Milton has never made an official start. Sunday, the former sixth-round pick will get his shot when the Philadelphia Eagles host the New York Giants.
material_news_signals.body_text: joe milton has never made an official start sunday the former sixth round pick will get his shot when the philadelphia eagles host the new york giants milton said thursday that throughout his career as a backup he s been preparing for this chance i was just pretty much going through the plays going through the week like i was a starter or like i was playing and just being ready milton said via the philadelphia inquirer and that s what the nfl is about just being ready when your name is called and just preparing for those moments milton entered the league with the patriots and flashed athleticism during preseason action in week 18 2024 drake maye took the start but milton played the majority of the contest completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and rushing for another score last year he spent the season with dallas appearing in five games milton s last appearance was week 18 2025 for the cowboys when he played the entire second half versus the giants with dak prescott resting 7 13 73 pass yards one int 43 rush yards milton spent the offseason in dallas and while he showed promise again in preseason action the cowboys chose sam howell as prescott s backup milton signed to the dallas practice squad where the eagles plucked him on oct 16 after jalen hurts was placed on injured reserve due to blood clots milton was asked thursday how much of the eagles playbook he knows shoot whatever s in this week he said laughing milton is taking over for tanner mckee who has started the past three weeks the eagles offense has been a slog for most of the season during its six game skid since week 3 philly has been outgained by 889 yards worst in the nfl the hope is that milton can at least provide some pop to the limp unit he has averaged 10 2 air yards attempt since 2024 per next gen stats second most min 50 attempts both of milton s two career pass tds came on deep passes 20 air yds mckee told reporters he understood why he was benched and has been trying to help milton prepare he hasn t been here the whole time with training camp and some of those plays and so just talking to him about different reads different footwork things that we ve had a little more time on task doing here mckee said and so it s been great just communicating with him things that i ve seen in the past things that we ve learned from jalen or that offensive coordinator sean mannion has communicated in the past or things that we can reiterate to kind of slow his thinking down so he can just be free and be able to play like the great athlete he is the eagles hope that great athlete can wake up an offense that has struggled all season philly has gone three and out on 34 1 percent of drives the highest rate in the nfl and the highest in a season since the 2014 raiders 35 9 pct finished 3 13 the giants defense has forced a three and out on 32 9 percent of drives best in the nfl the eagles and giants kick off from lincoln financial field on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: 2025 NFL position battles: Picks to win 10 notable training camp competitions across the league
news_mentions.description: With training camps opening across the NFL, which position battles demand your attention? Kevin Patra spotlights 10 intriguing competitions, including four quarterback derbies.
news_mentions.body_text: summer is over for pigskin professionals the nfl is back with training camps opening across the league it s time for the competitions for jobs to commence competition is the name of the game for every squad it s what breeds improvement and ultimately leads to winning certain positions with limited rep sharing lend themselves to more notable battles you won t see many defensive competitions highlighted mainly because the hefty rotations and matchup centric usage tend to make camp fights less impactful as the season approaches below are the top 10 camp battles i ll be monitoring throughout training camp and into the preseason

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 9: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the offense go without the star there to demand attention from kansas city s secondary the chiefs had little problem shutting down geno smith smith threw for only 165 yards cooper led the way with 58 yards on eight receptions while mitchell went from 142 yards on seven catches last week to zero catches on seven looks a game later new york got nothing going settling for four field goals in the first half tied for the most over the last 10 seasons in the second half the jets didn t even get the opportunity to settle smith and co managed 58 yards over five drives on the other side of intermission forced to watch their two point halftime deficit unravel into a 23 point loss chiefs come alive for much needed blowout kansas city rode a two game losing streak into week 9 with a 22 fourth quarter point differential that ranked 31st in the league over the past two games if there s one thing patrick mahomes is going to do though it s beat up on bad teams by defeating the jets he moved to 18 0 in his career against teams entering a matchup four plus games under 500 the best by any quarterback since 1970 minimum 15 starts per nfl research he went 23 of 31 for 242 yards and two touchdowns with a 117 9 passer rating but most importantly seemed ok after a strip sack by david bailey late in the second quarter bent his elbow awkwardly and forced him to receive medical attention on the sideline he returned and overcame a frustrating offensive stupor to blow the doors off the jets while the chiefs defense minimized damage early and inflicted plenty of it throughout kansas city pressured geno smith on half of his dropbacks chris jones and george karlaftis led the team with six pressures and two sacks apiece while drue tranquill logged 13 tackles and nick bolton had 12 plus a forced fumble detractors will point out it s only the jets and there are still some issues to work out think harrison butker missing a 56 yard field goal and the subsequent 51 yarder after getting a reprieve due to an offsides penalty just before half but the chiefs can only play who is in front of them in this case they demolished them next gen stats insight for jets chiefs via nfl pro travis kelce caught four of six targets for 72 yards accounting for two of the chiefs five explosive passes 40 0 nfl research kenneth walker had his first career game with multiple receiving touchdowns to go along with a rushing touchdown in the chiefs win over the jets his second career game with three touchdowns back to top bobby kownack s takeaways usual suspects lift detroit to tightly contested win sunday s victory over miami was not your typical lions affair jared goff and the offense took forever to get going and it seemed as if they knew things weren t quite clicking the lions pulled out all the stops against their one win opponent they went for it on fourth down on the first drive a few plays later jahmyr gibbs took a direct snap and faked a pitch to goff before streaking around the edge for 16 yards two plays into the second quarter detroit converted a fake punt throw by jack fox on fourth and 7 from its own 30 the lions constantly stalled out failing to score a touchdown until 1 20 hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL experts' Week 9 takeaways: Are Rams back? Commanders make another baffling decision
news_mentions.body_text: each sunday three of the athletic 39 s nfl writers react to the biggest news plays and performances from the day 39 s games we 39 re just about halfway through the regular season and it doesn 39 t feel like any team has separated itself as the clear cut super bowl favorite that team was supposed to be the los angeles rams who were seen as a super team back in the preseason but they 39 e battling just to make the playoffs they 39 ve started to right the ship with three straight wins including a 20 13 victory over the washington commanders on sunday the rams still have plenty of work to do but it 39 s easier to work on problems when you 39 re winning games the commanders aren 39 t so fortunate you 39 d think after a couple of high profile blunders around game management dan quinn 39 s team would have fixed those issues but there jayden daniels was on sunday with three seconds left and 31 yards to the end zone throwing well short of the goal line to end the game it 39 s fair to wonder how much longer this can go on for quinn in less chaotic action the cincinnati bengals put on an offensive clinic and torched the atlanta falcons defense early sunday in madrid joe burrow and the receiver tandem of ja 39 marr chase and tee higgins seem better than ever and will be tough to stop in the afc nfl writers mike jones ted nguyen and dan pompei share their thoughts on the fallout from week 9 the rams have won three straight games and are above 500 for the first time this season are they starting to look like contenders or just beating bad teams jones the rams have definitely beaten three bad teams and sunday 39 s outcome was closer than it should have been i 39 m not going to declare them contenders yet because something seems off with matthew stafford and contenders do better than 3 for 14 on third downs against bad defenses and take better care of the football the rams still have time to work on their offensive glitches and myles garrett 39 s return is a welcomed development for their defense hope does remain alive for l a but sean mcvay 39 s squad has plenty of work to do during the second half of the season nguyen they hit a soft part of their schedule that they absolutely had to sweep and they took care of business the raiders and commanders with jayden daniels aren 39 t terrible though their offense is missing key pieces with davante adams and terrance ferguson out so they 39 ve shortened the playbook winning games ugly which is the right formula they 39 re running the ball well and the defense looks more like we expected with garrett back in the lineup they need to beat the arizona cardinals in their rematch next week stafford still doesn 39 t quite look like himself the ceiling of this team will depend on how much closer he can look like the player that won the mvp last year pompei the rams are back it 39 s true they have taken advantage of a soft stretch of schedule and maybe they wouldn 39 t be getting many style points if they were figure skating but this is the nfl and they are doing what they need to do to win games the spectacular return of garrett bodes very well for a defense that has not played up to expectations this remains one of the league 39 s most gifted teams and the rams may have benefitted from their early stumbles by figuring out how to work around their deficiencies the rams are set up for a strong finish speaking of the rams commanders game washington made another baffling late game decision this time throwing the ball well short of the end zone on the final play what 39 s going on in d c jones it 39 s just more of the same for washington an apparent lack of urgency and situational awareness from players and questionable decision making from coaches david blough their 31 year old rookie offensive coordinator who has only two previous seasons worth of experience as an assistant position coach continues to go through growing pains as a play caller quinn is a defensive minded head coach but he can still provide better direction in those late game situations with time running out he 39 s coached long enough to know what his team needs to do to win there 39 s just no excuse for the mistakes being made so it 39 s just a matter of time before washington hits the reset button again nguyen we saw some teams find their way in the end zone in long yardage situations with screens in the last couple of weeks so maybe blough thought he could do something similar that 39 s all i can think of blough is a first year coordinator and he 39 s had some questionable calls unfortunately for quinn he 39 s essentially staked his job on blough working out there 39 s still some hope that the offense can get it together the nfc east is wide open right now but it 39 s looking rough for the commanders however pompei sometimes throwing short of the end zone isn 39 t a bad gamble but the commanders have made a number of questionable game management decisions they 39 re at the point where everything that doesn 39 t work is going to be scrutinized whether the blame falls on coaches or jayden daniels really doesn 39 t matter it 39 s a bad look for the team that play wasn 39 t the only problem the commanders 39 offense sputtered after the first two drives scoring only after an interception that gave them a short field the run game was not effective and the pass protection left much to be desired is the combination of the bengals 39 high powered offense and a mediocre defense enough to make noise in the afc playoffs jones as well as joe burrow is playing directing a very dangerous offense the bengals certainly can make a deep playoff run their defense isn 39 t perfect but it 39 s improving the unit definitely gives up too many yards and displays struggles on third downs but the bengals are top 10 in sacks takeaways and in the red zone this cincinnati unit is better than the 2021 22 defense when the bengals reached the super bowl and burrow and the offense are more explosive than that 2021 22 version of themselves as well the afc has some really talented teams but the bengals can hold their own against any of them nguyen absolutely after some experimenting with going under center early in the season the bengals are going back to who they are a shotgun passing team with the best receiver duo in football ja 39 marr chase and tee higgins put on a disgusting display of dominance against the falcons secondary and the way burrow was operating sunday reminded me of the peyton manning colts offenses with marvin harrison and reggie wayne the defense has enough talent to slow down opponents dexter lawrence should be in the running for defensive player of the year this is a scary scary bengals team pompei it depends how you define making noise the bengals can win in the postseason but they probably can 39 t win it all unless they play defense better than they have they have the best passing game in the league by a considerable margin but typically the best passing games needs help as the season gets long and the weather turns that means more contributions from the run game and it especially means a defense that can get opposing offenses off the field either by forcing punts or creating takeaways the defense can improve however the cleveland browns lost in overtime after shedeur sanders matched a new orleans saints touchdown but failed on a two point conversion that would have won the game agree with coach todd monken 39 s decision to go for two and the win jones yeah i think they had to go for the win given how little time was left 1 11 in overtime they risked giving the ball back to new orleans with enough time for the saints to march into field goal range and score with no time left monken played to win rather than to tie or lose nguyen i liked the decision the advantage of going second in overtime is so you have more information to work with and you have control of the ending why give the saints a chance at a walk off field goal when you can end the game with 2 yards with the way the saints were moving the ball at the end of regulation and overtime i would have tried to win the game with my offense as well pompei i have no problem with it you know his players wanted to go for it and he put the game in their hands maybe monken is more open to criticism because he had a backup quarterback making the throw but sanders played pretty well throughout the game it didn 39 t work out but it 39 s also possible it wouldn 39 t have worked out of he decided to kick the extra point this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Lions win for Jack Campbell as their defense gives reason to believe again
news_mentions.body_text: miami gardens fla he wasn 39 t there but he was he was on their minds in the week leading up to an emotional game his name was on their backs as they walked inside hard rock stadium ready to play for him and his signature no 46 jersey rested in the visitors 39 locker room a not so subtle reminder of the message this week it was all part of a collective collaborative effort by the detroit lions to pay homage to jack campbell 34 today was dedicated to 46 man 34 lions linebacker derrick barnes said after his defense lifted the lions to a 19 9 win over the dolphins it was an emotional week at 222 republic drive players and coaches on this team felt helpless watching campbell unable to move during last week 39 s game against the vikings on a tackle considered routine in nature campbell was in the vicinity of the ball as we 39 ve come to expect but he didn 39 t emerge players noticed they called for help and athletic trainers and medical professionals ran to his aid they kept waiting for him to get up he always gets up and when he didn 39 t they knew something was wrong campbell was placed on a spinal board then on a cart and was later transported to detroit 39 s henry ford hospital listed as a neck injury campbell lost movement as scary a situation as you 39 ll see unfold at ford field lions coach dan campbell doing his best to navigate news as it came in said the lions couldn 39 t shy away from the cloud created by campbell 39 s absence they acknowledged the injury and the violent nature of this game they broached the topic with sensitivity offering resources for players if needed it was hard to focus on football for much of the week however in a statement released by campbell and his family on wednesday campbell said he has since regained all movement of his lower body and was making progress on regaining movement of his upper body for his teammates who didn 39 t know what sort of future campbell could live the news offered them a chance to exhale move forward and shift their focus back to football and so the message this week was simple prepare and play like 46 34 it 39 s all we could do 34 dan campbell said of the situation 34 i mentioned this before he 39 ll take the prayers but he didn 39 t want the pity he didn 39 t want you wasting the time thinking about him he certainly doesn 39 t want us to go and not play our best ball and lose a game so that 39 s what we could do and we wanted to honor him there 39 s nothing easy about it this is hard because you do want to talk about it and acknowledge it because if you just brush it under the rug that 39 s not fair i mean the guy means too much to us and so the guys did that 34 the linebacker room knew they wanted to honor campbell at sunday 39 s game they just didn 39 t know how a few different ideas were discussed t shirts were the early answer until they realized those might take weeks to arrive they kept workshopping in search of something quick barnes spoke with lions head equipment manager tim o 39 neill and asked if he could supply the linebackers and a few defensive coaches with no 46 campbell jerseys a plan was put into motion they wore them to breakfast together they wore them into the stadium and when they arrived in the locker room the equipment team left a locker and nameplate for campbell sandwiched between derrick barnes and trevor nowaske with campbell 39 s jersey resting on a hanger 34 it was kind of a collective effort 34 said trevor nowaske campbell 39 s closest friend on the team 34 obviously this whole week 39 s been just kind of trying to support him any way we can 133 we were thinking of a couple different things and you know it 39 s just something kind of subtle to just show that no matter what he 39 s with us whether he 39 s here or not 34 barnes who wore the green dot and communicated detroit 39 s defensive calls sunday spent a little extra time on his tablet in the locker room this week like campbell typically would linebackers knew that a little bit more was expected of them from barnes to nowaske to malcolm rodriguez all three were either here before campbell joined the team or arrived the same year and on their first defensive snap of the game those three met at the line of scrimmage together and stonewalled dolphins running back ollie gordon for no gain a fitting start and a tone set 34 when we hopped up i looked around and said 39 ok 44 rodriguez there we go now aske 39 34 barnes said after the game campbell wasn 39 t out there but you wouldn 39 t know it the way this defense played without their leader they held true to their word preparing and playing like campbell it was early and often against a dolphins team that reminded lions players of themselves back in 2021 and 2022 what made it all the more impressive was that the lions weren 39 t just without campbell they were missing their best cornerback d j reed as well as starting edge rusher dj wonnum and yet this was without question their best defensive effort of the season the lions allowed a season low nine points and 228 yards of offense while controlling the line of scrimmage they held the dolphins to 77 rushing yards on 21 attempts limiting miami to zero or negative rushing yards on 28 6 percent of their attempts second best in week 9 they picked off malik willis and sacked him three times all three coming in the fourth quarter they allowed just two explosive plays on sunday a season low and they got off the field when it mattered holding miami to just 4 of 12 on third down and 0 of 3 in the red zone the dolphins could only muster three field goals each defensive stop each turnover or turnover on downs each field goal attempt players on this defense thought of 46 34 really anytime we were kind of in a rut today or they popped one or something in my head i 39 m just like 39 hey man listen if there 39 s one thing i 39 m gonna do today i 39 m gonna just go balls to the wall because i know jack would 39 34 nowaske said 34 that 39 s what i just kept coming back to and that 39 s really how i played all day 34 the lions 6 2 are playing good football right now they 39 ve won four in a row keeping pace in the toughest division in the league a defense that looked like one of the nfl 39 s worst is now rounding into form in weeks 1 4 the lions allowed 31 75 points per game second worst at the time since week 5 they rank fourth at just 15 5 and while they haven 39 t exactly faced a juggernaut in those games their efforts have directly contributed to wins picking up the slack for the offense at times between better execution the return of brian branch the looming return of kerby joseph and potential additions at the trade deadline this defense is giving folks reason to believe again even if campbell is merely a spectator in the immediate future in the meantime sunday was an ode to campbell and everything he means to this team even though campbell 39 s teammates can admit he 39 ll probably be annoyed with their gesture when they touch base 34 i already know he 39 s gonna be mad 34 nowaske said laughing 34 i know him and i know he 39 s gonna be like 39 guys what are you doing 39 but i mean we gotta show our support to our dog 34 the lions will continue to it is not customary for players on injured reserve to have a designated locker for a road game especially one they didn 39 t travel but you can make an exception for a player like campbell 34 that locker 39 s traveling and we 39 ll do our part 34 dan campbell said the lions won 39 t soon forget campbell and his contributions to this team but they understand they have a job to do to win on sunday they did it for him this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.description: Is Justin Herbert broken beyond repair? Will DK Metcalf ever provide the Steelers with WR1 production? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks examines 10 struggling players. Can they turn things around before season's end?
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he diagnoses the problems afflicting some notable names two months into the 2026 nfl regular season several prominent players are struggling while everyone endures occasional slumps the best can get out of a tailspin with more work and some schematic tweaking today i m spotlighting 10 disappointing players five on offense five on defense and assessing whether each can turn things around before season s end

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 8 games: Cardinals bench QB Jacoby Brissett vs. Cowboys
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news developments we're monitoring around the league on this Week 8 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news developments we re monitoring around the league on this week 8 sunday arizona cardinals quarterback gardner minshew replaced jacoby brissettin the second half of sunday s win over dallas brissett was 10 of 23 for 119 yards and an interception at the time of his benching with arizona trailing 17 3 running back jeremiyah love ankle left early and did not return running back bam knight concussion and wide receiver kendrick bourne ankle were ruled out baltimore ravens quarterback lamar jackson right thumb was ruled out from sunday s game against buffalo jackson needs surgery on his injured thumb and will be placed on injured reserve coach jesse minter said after the game qb tyler huntley was also ruled out and suffered what is thought to be a turf toe injury per espn s adam schefter huntley is expected to undergo an mri on monday schefter reported buffalo bills wide receiver josh palmer hamstring was ruled out of sunday s win over baltimore chicago bears linebackers coach richard smith will not travel with the team to seattle for monday s game against the seahawks due to a health issue the team announced assistant linebackers coach kevin koch will handle lb coach duties per the team cincinnati bengals defensive end cashius howell right wrist and defensive end cedric johnson left ankle were ruled out of sunday s win over tennessee cleveland browns defensive tackle maliek collins elbow did not return to sunday s loss to pittsburgh dallas cowboys tight end jake ferguson ankle was ruled out of sunday s loss to arizona cornerback joey porter ankle did not return while safety caleb downs was evaluated for a concussion and ruled out detroit lions linebacker jack campbell was transported to a local hospital to be evaluated for a neck injury suffered in the second half of sunday s win over minnesota the team announced campbell is resting and will remain in the hospital on sunday night for continued evaluation and monitoring campbell left the field on a stretcher after suffering the injury center cade mays ankle running back jacob saylors neck edge rusher d j wonnum concussion and safety brian branch concussion also were ruled out cornerback d j reed hip did not return jacksonville jaguars defensive tackle davon hamilton knee and safety eric murray elbow were ruled out from sunday s win over indianapolis kansas city chiefs defensive lineman peter woods neck was ruled out of sunday s loss to the broncos las vegas raiders cornerback darien porter groin was ruled out of sunday s win over the jets los angeles rams cornerback jaylen watson shoulder was ruled out of sunday s win over the chargers cornerback trent mcduffie back did not return to the game minnesota vikings safety theo jackson quad was ruled out of sunday s loss to detroit philadelphia eagles defensive back michael carter abdomen did not return to sunday night s loss against the commanders tampa bay buccaneers linebacker yaya diaby knee was ruled out of sunday s win over atlanta washington commanders running back jeremy mcnichols foot did not return to sunday night s win against the eagles

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: Report: Jaguars acquiring safety Jessie Bates III from Falcons for two draft picks
news_mentions.description: The Jaguars are acquiring safety Jessie Bates from the Falcons in exchange for a 2027 second-pick and 2028 fifth-round selection, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: the jaguars have made a splash move to shore up the back end of their defense jacksonville is acquiring pro bowl safety jessie bates from the atlanta falcons in exchange for a 2027 second round pick and a 2028 fifth round pick espn s adam schefter reported the falcons are paying most of bates salary to complete the deal nfl network s ian rapoport added the jags have dealt with injuries that have sapped the back end of their defense including losing starting safety eric murray for the season with an elbow injury importing bates is a massive coup for an already good defense under coordinator anthony campanile the 29 year old safety is a ballhawk with 28 career interceptions through nine games this season he has one interception four passes defensed three forced fumbles a fumble return touchdown and 60 total tackles a rangy safety bates solidifies the back end of campanile s high flying defense that ranks in the top five against the run but is 22nd against the pass this season as a top tier afc team with a legit shot at making a super bowl run upgrading the secondary keeps the jags on course much like how jacksonville inked jakobi meyers to an extension after trading for the wr last year the jags could eventually extend the 29 year old pending free agent as a veteran cornerstone in the secondary for the 3 6 falcons coming off a loss to the cincinnati bengals in madrid the trade represents a realization that even though they re not out of the hunt in a moribund nfc south they aren t a title contender with bates playing out his contract atlanta likely would have lost him in free agency shipping out a near 30 year old safety for a few games while getting a second round pick is smart business with a ton of cap space in the offseason the falcons were unlikely to recoup any compensatory picks if bates left in free agency so paying out most of his salary to get a day 2 draft pick is a good return atlanta now has four top 100 picks and the most salary cap space in the league for the new brass to continue the rebuild in 2027
