s total offense on sunday the team must be holding its collective breath right now though with espn s adam schefter and nfl network s mike garafolo reporting nacua suffered a knee injury on the offense s final snap of the game the rams do not believe nacua has an acl tear but he will undergo an mri on monday to determine the severity of the injury per the report the all pro made 14 catches for a season high 150 yards and a touchdown on 19 targets also he had two carries for 20 yards washington played zone on 84 1 of nacua s routes and he caught 12 of 17 targets for 128 yards against it his most yards against zone coverage in a game this season per next gen stats he did lose a fumble but jayden daniels fumbled the ball right back to the rams on the next possession it was still far from easy sledding for the rams offense which started the game 0 for 9 on third down matthew stafford threw an interception on a pass to nacua and was not at his sharpest as a passer the rams scored their fewest points in a game since their last loss an 18 16 defeat against the cardinals the team stafford and co will visit in week 10 next gen stats insight for rams commanders via nfl pro the rams used 13 personnel on 40 of 73 offensive plays 54 8 in their win over the commanders the highest rate by an offense in a game this season in 13 personnel the rams averaged 5 3 yards per play with a 57 5 success rate and a touchdown in all other groupings 33 plays they averaged 4 4 yards per play with a 27 3 success rate and a touchdown nfl research puka nacua now has nine career games with 150 plus receiving yards two more than any other player since he entered the nfl in 2023 he broke a tie with hall of famer elroy hirsch for the third most such games in rams history and now trails only hall of famer isaac bruce 13 and torry holt 12 back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways stroud texans offense is humming in a homecoming game for c j stroud who grew up in southern california he threw the ball to whoever he wanted and wherever he wanted against the chargers evidence that he s playing some of the most confident football of his pro career stroud finished with an impressive 384 yards and five touchdowns before exiting with just under 9 minutes to play in the blowout win tying his career high td passes in a game week 9 of 2023 stroud was well protected by his offensive line and his receivers rewarded him for throwing the ball with pinpoint accuracy look no further than houston s third touchdown drive of the day on three of his four completions stroud dropped absolute dimes on outbreaking routes to dalton schultz 14 yards marvin harrison 15 yards and kayshon boutte 12 yard td who each hauled in the pass with toe tapping flare and talk about jaw dropping catches nico collins made a one handed 13 yard touchdown reception while tank dell and boutte each scored on 63 yard catch and run plays boutte led all receivers with 125 receiving yards on four catches dell finished with 105 yards the fifth career 100 yard receiving game and xavier hutchinson also caught the opening td his second straight week with a score houston ended the game with nearly 500 yards of offense sending a signal to the rest of the league that its qb is making a serious push for mvp chargers spiraling nothing absolutely nothing went well for los angeles on sunday perhaps the lone positive on the day was that the offense finally scored a touchdown a 58 yard catch and run connection between justin herbert and quentin johnston with 12 47 minutes left in the fourth quarter that snapped a 37 drive touchdown drought dating back to week 5 against denver injuries penalties turnovers it all added up to another lopsided loss the team s eighth of the year offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel tried something new sunday calling plays from the box instead of the sideline the first time doing so since 2021 his lone season as 49ers oc but to no avail the unit which was without no 1 receiver ladd mcconkey who experienced back spasms during pre game warmups did ok early by moving into houston territory on four straight drives yet it settled for a punt and three field goals los angeles final three drives of the half were abysmal three plays for negative 1 net yard three plays for negative 4 net yards and three plays for negative 4 net yards ultimately leading to a 15 point deficit at the half the sluggishness before halftime has been a huge crutch for the chargers this season as they have been outscored 47 6 41 in the final two minutes of the second quarter the result of this game was already clear early in the third with the boo birds showing up credit to houston s defense stay tuned for constantly flustering herbert who completed 13 of his 23 passes for 193 yards the touchdown and an interception herbert exited the game after his td pass was assessed by trainers on the sideline and came out of the blue tent with a glove on his left non throwing hand 2025 udfa dj uiagalelei entered the contest in place of herbert throwing a garbage time touchdown in his first nfl appearance it s hard to say where the chargers go from here texans d brings the boom demeco ryans had to be pleased with the texans defensive effort sunday save for that 58 yard chargers garbage time touchdown that snapped l a s td drought his unit relentlessly pressured justin herbert all game long sacking him a whopping eight times sheldon rankins jadeveon clowney and will anderson logged two apiece while m j stewart and logan hall each had one anderson now leads the nfl with 9 5 sacks breaking his tie with t j watt pittsburgh is on a bye frankly the entire unit was mostly exquisite derek stingley recorded his first pick of the season and had three pbus kamari lassiter had four passes defensed azeez al shaair had a team high nine tackles henry to 39 oto 39 o forced a fumble and calen bullock recovered it for a unit that was performing pretty far below expectation early in the season it s rounding into form now several weeks after ryans took back play calling duties next gen stats insight for texans chargers via nfl pro c j stroud completed 10 of 16 passes on intermediate throws between 10 and 19 air yards for 254 yards five touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the chargers it is the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span nfl research with his successful 56 yard field goal in the first quarter ka 39 imi fairbairn tied sebastian janikowski for the third most 50 plus yard field goals in nfl history with 58 back to top kevin patra s takeaways warner niners d dominates in rout of raiders fred warner s push for the defensive player of the year award took another impressive leap forward the nfl s best off ball linebacker dominated a raiders offense that had moved the ball this year warner executed a perfect peanut punch on brock bowers on the ensuing drive the lb pounced on another forced fumble later he perfectly timed a leap over the line to tackle kirk cousins on a sneak for the game he gobbled up five tackles one tackle for loss a forced fumble and a fumble recovery warner sets the tone for a ferocious defense the niners forced five second half turnovers including four straight to close out the contest when the raiders threatened to make it a game raheem morris crew slammed the door shut niners offense handles business coming off the bye week kyle shanahan s squad quickly knocked off the rust with brock purdy deftly going through reads to find open targets the qb spearheaded td drives of 12 13 and 12 plays to open up the game with a 21 7 lead despite still missing wideouts the niners offense didn t miss a beat purdy s worst throw was an undershot of an open george kittle that was intercepted outside of that miscue the mvp candidate shined particularly by pushing the ball downfield on passes of 10 plus air yards purdy went 7 for 11 for 153 yards a td and an int he went 2 for 2 on passes of 20 plus air yards for 74 yards including ripping a 37 yard touchdown to jordan watkins with the ground game blasting for 190 yards on 43 carries the niners offense was a force following its first loss of the season turnovers sink raiders chances despite getting down big early vegas had a chance to make things interesting in the second half but kept stumbling kirk cousins threw a pick six on the opening possession of the third quarter the turnovers were just beginning brock bowers fumble was followed by michael mayer getting the ball punched out as he went into the end zone then the worst sequence happened bowers took a pass and galloped to the goal line he was stopped one yard short cousins lost two yards on a sneak an offensive pass interference call wiped out a mayer td then cousins underthrew a ball in the end zone for an int on back to back drives the raiders got the ball to the half yard line and came away with zero points oof vegas simply doesn t have the horses to keep things close when it turns the ball over at that rate next gen stats insight for 49ers raiders via nfl pro jordan watkins caught all four of his receiving targets for 84 yards career high and his first career touchdown in a win against the raiders his 17 4 average air yards per target were a season high nfl research christian mccaffrey scored his 37th career receiving touchdown breaking a tie with marshall faulk for the most by a running back in the super bowl era mccaffrey snapped a career long drought of nine straight games without a receiving touchdown dating back to week 17 of the 2025 season mccaffrey also scored a rushing touchdown giving him 18 career games with both a rushing and receiving touchdown extending his record for the most in nfl history back to top dan parr s takeaways love states mvp case i m not sure anyone is going to overtake current favorite josh allen in the mvp race this season but as i predicted he would jordan love planted his flag firmly in the conversation with his performance on sunday love completed 23 of 29 passes for 372 yards with three touchdowns in three and a half quarters of work backup tyrod taylor entered the blowout win in the fourth quarter love remains the league leader in passing yards with 2 618 232 yards more than any other qb sunday was yet another game where love received almost no help from the league s least productive running game and he also faced a lot of heat with the patriots pressuring him on 13 of his 33 dropbacks 39 4 it didn t matter love was locked in and dropping dimes to christian watson and matthew golden making a talented new england secondary look silly at times watson finished with a career high 171 receiving yards on seven catches while golden led the team with 10 grabs for a career high 164 yards the packers were the underdogs entering sunday s game but matt lafleur s crew controlled the contest from start to finish with its 1 2 start to the season feeling like a distant memory green bay gets a rematch at home against the nfc north leading vikings next week one storyline to follow leading up to that battle will be the status of running back josh jacobs who suffered a fractured finger on sunday maye s turnovers too much for patriots to overcome progress isn t always linear and sunday offered pats fans a stark reminder of that fact after drake maye shook off a turnover plagued start to the season to compile a touchdown to interception ratio of 11 1 in his previous four games sunday marked a step back for the third year qb he threw three interceptions in the first half and was lucky to avoid a fourth on a pass that was nearly picked off by the packers kamal hadden new england fell behind 24 7 in the second quarter and the rout was on maye was without wr1 a j brown but brown s only played in three games all season making a total of nine catches for 101 yards the patriots can t count on him to solve all their problems they were also without rb2 treveyon henderson on sunday and it s not clear when he will be back after being hospitalized recently with what he described as a medical emergency to make matters worse rb1 rhamondre stevenson exited the game with a knee injury there were more injuries to a banged up offensive line on sunday too it s all far from ideal for a team with playoff aspirations after winning the afc title last season now the patriots will go overseas for a munich matchup with the lions who have won four games in a row packers defense has something special brewing green bay s offense deserves plenty of praise for its performance but we should not overlook the team s defensive showing yes the packers gave up 27 points but the patriots two second half touchdowns were scored in garbage time when the game was out of hand jonathan gannon s defense had drake maye out of sorts from the jump finishing with four sacks and four takeaways all three of maye s ints ended up in the hands of safeties with xavier mckinney picking him off twice and evan williams snagging one on a deflection maye was pressured on 51 2 of his dropbacks the highest pressure rate he has faced in a regular season game just below the 52 8 he faced in the super bowl against the seahawks per next gen stats and we might not have seen green bay s best on defense yet with three time first team all pro apparently micah parsons getting closer to making his 2026 debut next gen stats insight for packers patriots via nfl pro patriots cornerback christian gonzalez allowed a career high 10 receptions for 187 yards on 11 targets in coverage against the packers nearly matching his yards allowed during his first six games this season 196 yards and the third most by any defender in a game this season gonzalez was targeted on seven of his 17 matchups against matthew golden allowing all seven targets to be caught for 105 yards he was also targeted on three of his four matchups against christian watson allowing three receptions for 82 yards and a td gonzalez is the only player since 2018 to allow more than 80 receiving yards to multiple players in the same game he had never allowed more than 71 yards in a game to a single receiver previously nfl research the packers scored a season high 45 points in their week 9 win the most the patriots have ever allowed in a game at gillette stadium green bay also posted a season high 478 total yards including 129 rushing yards after failing to surpass 90 rushing yards in any of their first eight games of the 2026 season back to top nick shook s takeaways seahawks grind out another win seattle s offense still leaves plenty to be desired but managed to finish with 295 yards pieced together two touchdown drives that ended with tight end aj barner reaching the end zone and snuffed out arizona s comeback attempt by gaining three first downs and maintaining possession over the final 4 35 to secure a 17 3 win seattle accomplished this with backup drew lock playing in place of sam darnold while also dealing with his own elbow injury and sustaining an oblique injury during sunday s game generating enough offense to build a satisfactory lead for the defense to protect for the remainder of the game perhaps most importantly the seahawks won a game without receiving a massive contribution from jaxon smith njigba who finished with seven catches for 51 yards and didn t need to become the game breaking weapon he s been in most of seattle s triumphs this season it wasn t a performance that will take any heat off embattled offensive coordinator brian fleury but the win will quiet critics for the next week and a 5 4 record looks better than a 500 mark at this stage it was also equally important for seattle to keep pace in an nfc west that now features three teams above 500 minshew magic runs out gardner minshew s insertion into the lineup sparked a frantic comeback effort in a thrilling win over dallas in week 8 clearing the way for minshew to take over as starter for arizona to trade jacoby brissett to baltimore and for the cardinals to proceed with another veteran who seemed to have a better rapport with his targets and a higher willingness to take calculated risks in order to jump start the offense that gave cardinals fans reason to believe mike lafleur s offense might finally produce a quality day offensively even against one of the nfl s best defenses instead arizona encountered a familiar experience in its rematch with seattle struggling to generate offense and falling well short of competing with the seahawks in a loss that truly wasn t as close as the score suggested making matters worse was a hit minshew took to his right arm while throwing which seemed to sap him of the arm strength necessary to find open targets in the second half even when arizona flirted with another fourth quarter comeback minshew and the cardinals offense ran aground inside seattle s 10 extinguishing their fading hope of climbing back into the game and reminding arizona of the uphill battle it will face in most matchups going forward does this mean we might see rookie carson beck soon no not yet unless minshew s arm ends up being hurt worse than what was detectable sunday but the thrill of minshew s arrival and instant success proved to be unreliable dropping the cardinals to 3 6 in a season that s likely already starting to look toward april charbonnet shows some juice zach charbonnet the other half of seattle s past two headed backfield finally returned to the field in week 8 but didn t generate much in terms of production or pop it wasn t surprising given the nature of the knee injury that kept him out until his midseason arrival but with the seahawks desperate for ground game consistency they could use a notable contribution from the power back and finally received one sunday charbonnet rushed 16 times for 77 yards made a handful of defenders miss broke some tackles and looked much more like the runner he was in previous seasons bringing a welcome level of balance to an offense that already relied too heavily on sam darnold and was expected to do the same with backup drew lock jadarian price flashed in the passing game too making a fantastic sideline catch as part of his four receptions for 54 yards it s far from a guarantee that they ve suddenly rediscovered their ability to run the ball opponent must be considered in these small sample sizes but at least it s an encouraging sign for an offense that still hasn t found much of a rhythm next gen stats insight for cardinals seahawks via nfl pro seattle entered week 9 ranked 24th in rushing success rate 37 3 and enjoyed an uptick in that category on sunday finishing with a designed run success rate of 44 8 zach charbonnet accounted for most of the improvement finishing with a designed run success rate of 43 8 nfl research drew lock has faced the cardinals in both of his starts in 2026 and beat them in both lock is just the fourth quarterback since starts were tracked in 1950 to face the same team in each of his first two starts of a season and beat them in both joining frankie albert versus the lions in 1952 daryle lamonica versus the jets in 1963 and derek anderson versus the buccaneers in 2014 back to top grant gordon s takeaways bears survive sunday night disaster dazzling at the onset disastrous for most of the final three quarters caleb williams and the bears survived calamity to emerge with their fourth straight win after the buccaneers tied the game with 2 51 to play on sunday night williams seemingly absent of the confidence that was oozing earlier in the evening was able to drive the bears down the field thanks mostly to a 38 yard hook up with a wide open colston loveland the final drive set up cairo santos for a game winning 38 yard field goal with zeroes on the clock it wasn t in the realm of possibility that the game would end in such fashion after williams had hit luther burden on a crosser for a 56 yard touchdown that led to a 14 0 lead at the conclusion of the first quarter williams had completed six of his eight pass attempts for 105 yards and two touchdowns each of the incompletions coming on drops thereafter williams was an atrocious 16 of 29 for 174 yards zero touchdowns a career worst four interceptions and a 33 5 rating in all the bears had five turnovers with williams first three picks coming on ill advised balls in which he appeared to be trying to throw the ball away while fading back and going airborne his fourth was off a deflection and the fifth giveaway was a burden fumble that set up the game tying score burden looked to have potentially gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: Browns' Shedeur Sanders to start vs. Saints; Deshaun Watson questionable after clearing concussion protocol
news_mentions.description: Shedeur Sanders will make his first start of the 2026 season on Sunday for Cleveland against the Saints, replacing Deshaun Watson, who remains in concussion protocol.
news_mentions.body_text: the browns offense will look a bit different in week 9 shedeur sanders will make his first start of the 2026 season on sunday for cleveland against the new orleans saints replacing deshaun watson who cleared concussion protocol on saturday but remains questionable browns coach todd monken told reporters friday that he hadn t decided whether watson would be active if he progressed through the protocol before the game he s still not able to do team reps monken said of watson he can do individual he can do some routes been in meetings but you re not able to do any of the team reps which makes it difficult watson was limited in his return to practice friday after sitting out the first two sessions of the week sanders will be tasked with leading an offense that gained 319 yards last week but scored just six points in a 27 6 defeat in pittsburgh cleveland 5 3 needs to keep pace in the afc north as it s slipped to third entering week 9 with the steelers 6 2 atop the division and the bengals 5 2 residing in second a 2025 fifth round pick out of colorado sanders took over as cleveland s starter in the back half of the 2025 season appearing in eight games seven starts and posting a 3 4 record while completing 56 6 of his passes for 1 400 yards and a 7 10 td int ratio while producing positive moments sanders first season concluded with plenty of questions to answer and a lack of firm evidence he d be capable of taking over as the browns long term answer under center sanders lost the preseason quarterback battle to watson who has played well in his first action since his season ending injury in 2024 watson had back to back 300 yard games and has led five game winning drives this year tied for the most in the league but also took a league high 33 sacks should watson end up being inactive he will have missed at least a game in each of his seasons with the browns who acquired him in a trade with the texans ahead of the 2022 campaign watson s eight starts this year are already a career high for him as a brown dillon gabriel would serve as sanders backup in that scenario the 24 year old sanders has made two appearances this season completing all three of his pass attempts for 2 yards cleveland kicks off against the saints at 1 p m et on sunday in the unfriendly confines of the caesars superdome

news_mentions.headline: Ravens complete trade for Cardinals' Jacoby Brissett; deal terms revealed
news_mentions.description: The Arizona Cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback Jacoby Brissett to the Baltimore Ravens, the teams announced Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: the arizona cardinals have finalized a trade to send quarterback jacoby brissett to the baltimore ravens the teams announced friday baltimore is sending arizona a 2027 fourth round pick and 2028 seventh rounder in exchange for brissett and a 2027 fifth round selection nfl network s ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported the cardinals also paid more than half of brissett s remaining 2026 salary as part of the swap per rapoport the trade was initially reported on wednesday with the caveat that it would be finalized later in the week which has come to fruition cardinals head coach mike lafleur spoke to reporters on wednesday and stated he would let the process play out before confirming now the parties have come to terms in the aftermath of the ravens losing to the jacksonville jaguars on thursday night marking the third time in as many games baltimore had a different starting quarterback and its fourth consecutive loss undrafted free agent joe fagnano started against jacksonville after franchise qb lamar jackson started week 8 and injured his thumb on his first play back from missing time with an ankle injury in jackson s stead tyler huntley filled in as the starter but after relieving jackson against the buffalo bills huntley suffered a turf toe injury that has ended his season jackson meanwhile is on injured reserve and out indefinitely now the ravens winding road turns to brissett who presumably will start in week 10 against the los angeles chargers on monday night football brissett began this season his 11th in the nfl as arizona s qb1 he was benched following eight starts in favor of gardner minshew and shortly thereafter his trade to baltimore was reported so far in 2026 brissett has completed 63 3 of his passes for 1 719 yards 10 touchdowns and seven interceptions baltimore stands as his seventh nfl team new england patriots indianapolis colts miami dolphins cleveland browns washington commanders cardinals and will become the sixth for which he s started a game the ravens will look to rescue what s fast becoming a lost season as they owned a 12 playoff probability following thursday s defeat unfortunately for those odds brissett hasn t started a game for a playoff team since his rookie season of 2016 with the patriots the cardinals meanwhile will march forward with minshew starting and rookie carson beck in reserve and perhaps getting a shot later as lafleur s team looks to stay competitive and more importantly build for the future

news_mentions.headline: Eagles QB Joe Milton prepares for first start: NFL is about 'being ready when your name is called'
news_mentions.description: Joe Milton has never made an official start. Sunday, the former sixth-round pick will get his shot when the Philadelphia Eagles host the New York Giants.
news_mentions.body_text: joe milton has never made an official start sunday the former sixth round pick will get his shot when the philadelphia eagles host the new york giants milton said thursday that throughout his career as a backup he s been preparing for this chance i was just pretty much going through the plays going through the week like i was a starter or like i was playing and just being ready milton said via the philadelphia inquirer and that s what the nfl is about just being ready when your name is called and just preparing for those moments milton entered the league with the patriots and flashed athleticism during preseason action in week 18 2024 drake maye took the start but milton played the majority of the contest completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and rushing for another score last year he spent the season with dallas appearing in five games milton s last appearance was week 18 2025 for the cowboys when he played the entire second half versus the giants with dak prescott resting 7 13 73 pass yards one int 43 rush yards milton spent the offseason in dallas and while he showed promise again in preseason action the cowboys chose sam howell as prescott s backup milton signed to the dallas practice squad where the eagles plucked him on oct 16 after jalen hurts was placed on injured reserve due to blood clots milton was asked thursday how much of the eagles playbook he knows shoot whatever s in this week he said laughing milton is taking over for tanner mckee who has started the past three weeks the eagles offense has been a slog for most of the season during its six game skid since week 3 philly has been outgained by 889 yards worst in the nfl the hope is that milton can at least provide some pop to the limp unit he has averaged 10 2 air yards attempt since 2024 per next gen stats second most min 50 attempts both of milton s two career pass tds came on deep passes 20 air yds mckee told reporters he understood why he was benched and has been trying to help milton prepare he hasn t been here the whole time with training camp and some of those plays and so just talking to him about different reads different footwork things that we ve had a little more time on task doing here mckee said and so it s been great just communicating with him things that i ve seen in the past things that we ve learned from jalen or that offensive coordinator sean mannion has communicated in the past or things that we can reiterate to kind of slow his thinking down so he can just be free and be able to play like the great athlete he is the eagles hope that great athlete can wake up an offense that has struggled all season philly has gone three and out on 34 1 percent of drives the highest rate in the nfl and the highest in a season since the 2014 raiders 35 9 pct finished 3 13 the giants defense has forced a three and out on 32 9 percent of drives best in the nfl the eagles and giants kick off from lincoln financial field on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

material_news_signals.headline: Eagles QB Joe Milton prepares for first start: NFL is about 'being ready when your name is called'
material_news_signals.description: Joe Milton has never made an official start. Sunday, the former sixth-round pick will get his shot when the Philadelphia Eagles host the New York Giants.
material_news_signals.body_text: joe milton has never made an official start sunday the former sixth round pick will get his shot when the philadelphia eagles host the new york giants milton said thursday that throughout his career as a backup he s been preparing for this chance i was just pretty much going through the plays going through the week like i was a starter or like i was playing and just being ready milton said via the philadelphia inquirer and that s what the nfl is about just being ready when your name is called and just preparing for those moments milton entered the league with the patriots and flashed athleticism during preseason action in week 18 2024 drake maye took the start but milton played the majority of the contest completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and a touchdown and rushing for another score last year he spent the season with dallas appearing in five games milton s last appearance was week 18 2025 for the cowboys when he played the entire second half versus the giants with dak prescott resting 7 13 73 pass yards one int 43 rush yards milton spent the offseason in dallas and while he showed promise again in preseason action the cowboys chose sam howell as prescott s backup milton signed to the dallas practice squad where the eagles plucked him on oct 16 after jalen hurts was placed on injured reserve due to blood clots milton was asked thursday how much of the eagles playbook he knows shoot whatever s in this week he said laughing milton is taking over for tanner mckee who has started the past three weeks the eagles offense has been a slog for most of the season during its six game skid since week 3 philly has been outgained by 889 yards worst in the nfl the hope is that milton can at least provide some pop to the limp unit he has averaged 10 2 air yards attempt since 2024 per next gen stats second most min 50 attempts both of milton s two career pass tds came on deep passes 20 air yds mckee told reporters he understood why he was benched and has been trying to help milton prepare he hasn t been here the whole time with training camp and some of those plays and so just talking to him about different reads different footwork things that we ve had a little more time on task doing here mckee said and so it s been great just communicating with him things that i ve seen in the past things that we ve learned from jalen or that offensive coordinator sean mannion has communicated in the past or things that we can reiterate to kind of slow his thinking down so he can just be free and be able to play like the great athlete he is the eagles hope that great athlete can wake up an offense that has struggled all season philly has gone three and out on 34 1 percent of drives the highest rate in the nfl and the highest in a season since the 2014 raiders 35 9 pct finished 3 13 the giants defense has forced a three and out on 32 9 percent of drives best in the nfl the eagles and giants kick off from lincoln financial field on sunday at 1 p m et

news_mentions.headline: NFL experts' Week 9 takeaways: Are Rams back? Commanders make another baffling decision
news_mentions.body_text: each sunday three of the athletic 39 s nfl writers react to the biggest news plays and performances from the day 39 s games we 39 re just about halfway through the regular season and it doesn 39 t feel like any team has separated itself as the clear cut super bowl favorite that team was supposed to be the los angeles rams who were seen as a super team back in the preseason but they 39 e battling just to make the playoffs they 39 ve started to right the ship with three straight wins including a 20 13 victory over the washington commanders on sunday the rams still have plenty of work to do but it 39 s easier to work on problems when you 39 re winning games the commanders aren 39 t so fortunate you 39 d think after a couple of high profile blunders around game management dan quinn 39 s team would have fixed those issues but there jayden daniels was on sunday with three seconds left and 31 yards to the end zone throwing well short of the goal line to end the game it 39 s fair to wonder how much longer this can go on for quinn in less chaotic action the cincinnati bengals put on an offensive clinic and torched the atlanta falcons defense early sunday in madrid joe burrow and the receiver tandem of ja 39 marr chase and tee higgins seem better than ever and will be tough to stop in the afc nfl writers mike jones ted nguyen and dan pompei share their thoughts on the fallout from week 9 the rams have won three straight games and are above 500 for the first time this season are they starting to look like contenders or just beating bad teams jones the rams have definitely beaten three bad teams and sunday 39 s outcome was closer than it should have been i 39 m not going to declare them contenders yet because something seems off with matthew stafford and contenders do better than 3 for 14 on third downs against bad defenses and take better care of the football the rams still have time to work on their offensive glitches and myles garrett 39 s return is a welcomed development for their defense hope does remain alive for l a but sean mcvay 39 s squad has plenty of work to do during the second half of the season nguyen they hit a soft part of their schedule that they absolutely had to sweep and they took care of business the raiders and commanders with jayden daniels aren 39 t terrible though their offense is missing key pieces with davante adams and terrance ferguson out so they 39 ve shortened the playbook winning games ugly which is the right formula they 39 re running the ball well and the defense looks more like we expected with garrett back in the lineup they need to beat the arizona cardinals in their rematch next week stafford still doesn 39 t quite look like himself the ceiling of this team will depend on how much closer he can look like the player that won the mvp last year pompei the rams are back it 39 s true they have taken advantage of a soft stretch of schedule and maybe they wouldn 39 t be getting many style points if they were figure skating but this is the nfl and they are doing what they need to do to win games the spectacular return of garrett bodes very well for a defense that has not played up to expectations this remains one of the league 39 s most gifted teams and the rams may have benefitted from their early stumbles by figuring out how to work around their deficiencies the rams are set up for a strong finish speaking of the rams commanders game washington made another baffling late game decision this time throwing the ball well short of the end zone on the final play what 39 s going on in d c jones it 39 s just more of the same for washington an apparent lack of urgency and situational awareness from players and questionable decision making from coaches david blough their 31 year old rookie offensive coordinator who has only two previous seasons worth of experience as an assistant position coach continues to go through growing pains as a play caller quinn is a defensive minded head coach but he can still provide better direction in those late game situations with time running out he 39 s coached long enough to know what his team needs to do to win there 39 s just no excuse for the mistakes being made so it 39 s just a matter of time before washington hits the reset button again nguyen we saw some teams find their way in the end zone in long yardage situations with screens in the last couple of weeks so maybe blough thought he could do something similar that 39 s all i can think of blough is a first year coordinator and he 39 s had some questionable calls unfortunately for quinn he 39 s essentially staked his job on blough working out there 39 s still some hope that the offense can get it together the nfc east is wide open right now but it 39 s looking rough for the commanders however pompei sometimes throwing short of the end zone isn 39 t a bad gamble but the commanders have made a number of questionable game management decisions they 39 re at the point where everything that doesn 39 t work is going to be scrutinized whether the blame falls on coaches or jayden daniels really doesn 39 t matter it 39 s a bad look for the team that play wasn 39 t the only problem the commanders 39 offense sputtered after the first two drives scoring only after an interception that gave them a short field the run game was not effective and the pass protection left much to be desired is the combination of the bengals 39 high powered offense and a mediocre defense enough to make noise in the afc playoffs jones as well as joe burrow is playing directing a very dangerous offense the bengals certainly can make a deep playoff run their defense isn 39 t perfect but it 39 s improving the unit definitely gives up too many yards and displays struggles on third downs but the bengals are top 10 in sacks takeaways and in the red zone this cincinnati unit is better than the 2021 22 defense when the bengals reached the super bowl and burrow and the offense are more explosive than that 2021 22 version of themselves as well the afc has some really talented teams but the bengals can hold their own against any of them nguyen absolutely after some experimenting with going under center early in the season the bengals are going back to who they are a shotgun passing team with the best receiver duo in football ja 39 marr chase and tee higgins put on a disgusting display of dominance against the falcons secondary and the way burrow was operating sunday reminded me of the peyton manning colts offenses with marvin harrison and reggie wayne the defense has enough talent to slow down opponents dexter lawrence should be in the running for defensive player of the year this is a scary scary bengals team pompei it depends how you define making noise the bengals can win in the postseason but they probably can 39 t win it all unless they play defense better than they have they have the best passing game in the league by a considerable margin but typically the best passing games needs help as the season gets long and the weather turns that means more contributions from the run game and it especially means a defense that can get opposing offenses off the field either by forcing punts or creating takeaways the defense can improve however the cleveland browns lost in overtime after shedeur sanders matched a new orleans saints touchdown but failed on a two point conversion that would have won the game agree with coach todd monken 39 s decision to go for two and the win jones yeah i think they had to go for the win given how little time was left 1 11 in overtime they risked giving the ball back to new orleans with enough time for the saints to march into field goal range and score with no time left monken played to win rather than to tie or lose nguyen i liked the decision the advantage of going second in overtime is so you have more information to work with and you have control of the ending why give the saints a chance at a walk off field goal when you can end the game with 2 yards with the way the saints were moving the ball at the end of regulation and overtime i would have tried to win the game with my offense as well pompei i have no problem with it you know his players wanted to go for it and he put the game in their hands maybe monken is more open to criticism because he had a backup quarterback making the throw but sanders played pretty well throughout the game it didn 39 t work out but it 39 s also possible it wouldn 39 t have worked out of he decided to kick the extra point this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: John Harbaugh is Giants' biggest asset in years. Can he lead them on a dream playoff run?
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia john harbaugh was smiling on his sunday walk to the bus when he was reminded of something he said soon after the baltimore ravens fired him before the new york giants had even scooped up that fumble he had watched the 4 13 giants on tape and saw more talent than he expected told at the time that the open atlanta falcons job in the nfc south would give him a cleaner path to a division title in year 1 harbaugh said he wasn 39 t afraid of the competition in the nfc east he maintained that the same giants who had gone 13 38 over the previous three seasons could contend for their first division crown since 2011 a half hour after harbaugh agreed to become the giants 39 coach he told the athletic 34 i expect and want to make the playoffs next year 34 meaning this season 34 i thought we had good players 34 harbaugh said as he was leaving lincoln financial field as the first giants head coach to win in this building since tom coughlin in 2013 34 i didn 39 t really know the personality of the team but i think what i learned is these guys have what it takes they 39 re tough minded they 39 ve got big hearts and they 39 re willing to do what it takes having what it takes means you 39 re willing to do what it takes and they 39 ve been willing to do it they work they believe and they don 39 t flinch 34 with his first place giants at 5 2 1 after a gloriously ugly 19 11 victory over the philadelphia eagles and with his team three loss column games ahead of the dallas cowboys and washington commanders and five ahead of the eagles harbaugh was asked how far this joyride can go 34 everything is possible for every team so we 39 ve got as much chance as anybody else or more than most 34 he said 34 but we don 39 t talk about that 34 the first coach hired by the giants with a super bowl victory on his resume is too smart to dream out loud about the kind of magical way out of left field super bowl run that the new england patriots made last year on cue harbaugh said his only competitive thoughts are on thursday night against the commanders at metlife 34 but we have the lead 34 he conceded 34 my mom always said 39 keep the lead and extend the lead 39 we 39 ve got to keep winning those big picture conversations are good for you guys to talk about we 39 re only focused now on the commanders 34 this is what football coaches are trained to say they can 39 t order their players to remain locked in on the next practice rep in one breath and then address the possibility of matching the new york knicks 39 ticker tape parade in the next even after harbaugh improved his post bye week record to 16 3 and ended the giants 39 13 game losing streak in philly where he was once a longtime special teams coordinator unsure if he 39 d ever get to run his own team in the nfl and man is he ever running this team the giants did not play like a winning postseason team for much of the day especially in the first half when they allowed j j mccarthy to get sacked five times deonte banks committed a pass interference penalty that gifted the eagles a touchdown charlie jones fumbled away a punt down 8 6 to a team that had lost six in a row harbaugh spent part of halftime telling his players their performance was not acceptable 34 our head coach came in there and said we 39 ve got to clean our s up 34 francis mauigoa said 34 he 39 s the driver of the ship 133 and he keeps us focused he came in there and told us to handle our s and told us we had a lot of penalties a lot of missed blocks and we 39 re still only down two points he had that positivity in there but he also had that reality that we need to pick it up 34 patrick ricard who spent nine years with harbaugh in baltimore said the positive part of the coach 39 s halftime message 34 after how bad we looked it 39 s still a two point game 34 was important for the giants to hear 34 he has an accountability and set belief that guys hold onto especially in games like this 34 ricard said 34 maybe in years past here the guys didn 39 t get that from the coaches as much so that 39 s what 39 s been instilled in them as a group i feel like here everything is growing every week and it 39 s why you usually see a second half surge from us 34 that surge came despite the apparent knockout blow eagles linebacker zack baun delivered to mccarthy 39 s right hip leaving the quarterback in so much pain he collapsed to a knee on the sideline after one warmup throw jameis winston led the giants on a stirring 14 play touchdown drive offering the best of 34 the experience 34 with his arm and legs yet harbaugh replaced him when mccarthy suddenly returned from the locker room saying he was good to go you could argue winston deserved to stay in but almost every move harbaugh has made on and off the field including the trade for mccarthy and the two year extension for winston not everyone in the coach 39 s circle of trust loved that signing has come up roses harbaugh drafted arvell reese and reese spent the afternoon looking like a cross between harry carson and lawrence taylor harbaugh didn 39 t bring in a kicker to challenge dominic zvada and the kicker went 4 for 4 on his field goal attempts including three from between 49 and 53 yards there were all kinds of reasons for the giants to lose this game starting with the trade deadline talk that dominated the week it sure seemed sunday that the ghosts were swirling at the linc way up there with braden mann 39 s monster punt from the front of his own end zone that traveled 94 yards and was officially marked at 86 but harbaugh 39 s winning past has the giants believing in the present asked how much his coach has impacted this season kayvon thibodeaux replied 34 one hundred percent however much you can think a head coach should impact winning he 39 s impacted it 34 i think it 39 s from the day he walked in from the plan he put in and the systems he put in place one thing harbaugh 39 s talked about is principles and methods he 39 s strict on his principles and he 39 s flexible on his methods and i think that formula has allowed us to 133 let our best players play their best 34 so how far can the giants 39 best take them after losing jaxson dart brian burns and tremaine edmunds to season ending injuries can they win playoff games if they don 39 t land jonathan taylor or some other difference maker by tuesday 39 s 4 p m et trade deadline 34 that 39 s the beautiful thing in the nfl 34 ricard said 34 you never know right you never know if this is the team that can go win the super bowl all we can worry about is just getting healthy every week getting the game plan from the coaches and trying to execute on game day and just play as hard as we can the teams that win the super bowl do that they just focus on the day the mission at hand they don 39 t worry about winning the super bowl it just happens by working hard and sticking together 34 i feel like we have that makeup so why not us at the end of the day right we 39 ll just continue to get better and work and maybe it 39 s in the cards for us 34 more likely it 39 s next year or the year after or the year after that yet there 39 s no point in these giants putting an artificial ceiling on their dreams on the bus ride in harbaugh reflected on his departure from philadelphia for baltimore nearly two decades ago this homecoming with his giants touched his heart 34 it was really something 34 he said 34 i didn 39 t think it was going to be quite that 34 but he did think the giants could win the nfc east before the team even hired him before he became the franchise 39 s most valuable asset in a long long time this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Bengals' Joe Burrow enjoying Madrid's museums, feeling like ‘normal person’ ahead of Madrid game
news_mentions.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the NFL.
news_mentions.body_text: madrid cincinnati bengals quarterback joe burrow is trying to make the most out of his first overseas game in the nfl burrow and the bengals are in madrid to take on the atlanta falcons on sunday looking to win their fourth straight game and move to 6 2 in the afc north the trip is not only about football for burrow though he was not yet with the bengals when the team played its first two games abroad in 2016 and 2019 in london this is somewhere that i ve always wanted to go he said friday and so to be able to do it while doing what i love playing football is really a dream come true for me burrow said he was recognized by a group of americans studying abroad while walking around the spanish capital but was enjoying a bit of anonymity on the streets of madrid i usually expect to go pretty incognito and not have anybody recognize me he said it s a little bit more than that but i love being out here because i can feel like a normal person for a little while art connoisseur europe was also allowing burrow to enjoy one of his passions art i went to museo del prado on wednesday that was cool burrow said of spain s renowned art museum and the plan for his half day off on friday was to go find more art in madrid i d like to go see some more museums and go to an art gallery do a little shopping but we ll see he said fashion change shopping in madrid could also be an attractive option for burrow who s been known for his interest in fashion and bold pregame outfits and it could be good timing for him as the bengals quarterback said he has been going through a style change i ve tried to elevate my looks a little bit recently he said for a couple of years there i was full streetwear and i started out going suits on gameday every day and didn t really feel like that was me so i switched it up to full streetwear and that might have been an overcorrection in my creative mind i m finding a happy medium now spanish sports knowledge burrow said he grew up watching soccer and lamented not being able to see one of the two spanish powerhouses play while he was in spain i ve followed international sports for a long time followed real madrid for a long time watched barcelona play real madrid a lot he said played with both of those teams on fifa a lot when i was a kid and loved watching soccer my whole life really so i wish they played while we were here at their home stadium so we could go unfortunately that s not gonna happen but hopefully one day i can make it putting on a show burrow said the bengals explosive and dynamic offense will be fun to watch at real madrid s santiago bernabeu stadium he said he was excited about being the nfl s main attraction sunday morning in the united states i love the only game on tv on sunday morning when people back home wake up and i love showcasing our talents abroad and trying to bring attention to what we do he said offensive line praise burrow threw for five touchdowns and ran for another in overtime as the bengals rallied to defeat the tennessee titans 43 36 last sunday we re completing a lot of passes right now our offensive line is protecting great i think this is the best that that group has played since i ve been here which is really exciting to see he said and you know a lot of our young players are getting better and better and we have the right guys who attack every day with the intent to be better than the day before and i think that is so valuable in this sport super bowl contenders burrow said the bengals still have more to prove before deserving to be considered super bowl contenders i don t think we deserve it yet he said we haven t done enough there s still a lot of season left we certainly have to be a lot better than we have been if we want to be that team at the end of the year winning the super bowl we certainly can we have the capability to do it but right now we aren t there no fast food for zac taylor bengals coach zac taylor joked that he wouldn t really accept anyone going for american fast food while in madrid i ve judged a couple people he said now my kids might be opting for that if you re under 14 years old yes if not i will judge you greatly wide receiver ja 39 marr chase was quick to say friday that he wasn t one of those going for fast food but he did say he missed his chef he also said he was recognized maybe twice on the streets of madrid on thursday defensive tackle dexter lawrence said he missed his bed copyright 2026 by the associated press

news_mentions.headline: Bengals vs. Falcons: Three must-know storylines for NFL Week 9 Madrid game
news_mentions.description: Does Atlanta excel in an area that could frustrate Joe Burrow? Will Bijan Robinson provide another sparkling performance in the spotlight? Jeremy Bergman provides three must-know storylines for Sunday's Bengals-Falcons game in Madrid.
news_mentions.body_text: this past summer spain sent its top footballers to the united states for a showcase of superior skill interplay and resolve the result la roja lifted its second world cup trophy campeones del mundo this sunday the nfl returns the favor in a way for the second time in as many years madrid is hosting a regular season nfl game but unlike last year s contest which featured a backup quarterback for washington and a dipping dolphins side this installment showcases two teams at near full strength with explosive ability and eyes on the postseason joe cool is on a heater for cincinnati one week removed from a maximalist six touchdown three interception outing in the bengals overtime victory over the lowly titans a win in madrid would bring cincy into a tie with the steelers atop the afc north ahead of their week 10 prime time matchup a 6 2 record would be the bengals best start since 2015 when they opened the season at 8 0 standing in their way the erratic falcons it s hard to get a grip on what the dirty birds are halfway through the season despite the sub 500 record atlanta is squarely in the nfc south race but you could say the same of any club in the uninspiring division including the buccaneers who shut out the falcons last sunday in a tampa typhoon without completing a pass the same falcons team that whooped up the packers in lambeau and handed the 49ers their only loss to date make it make sense that s a lesson for the host spaniards in the nfl any team can win on any given domingo when the bengals and falcons meet at the bernabeu on sunday in a uni matchup so bold it would make pedro almodovar blush expect the unexpected oh and unlike in that brutal world cup final against argentina expect scoring and lots of it three must know storylines 1 is there any slowing down cincy s offense the bengals have scored 78 points in the six quarters and change since a scoreless first half coming out of the bye in baltimore will their offensive onslaught continue in spain joe burrow paces the nfl in most notable passing stats 73 0 completion percentage 302 1 passing ypg 20 tds only four players in the super bowl era have ever led the league in all three of those categories in a season drew brees 2011 tom brady 2007 kurt warner 2001 and ken stabler 1976 it helps of course to have the nfl s top receiving tandem on your side burrow s passer ratings when targeting tee higgins 132 3 and ja 39 marr chase 113 6 each rank in the top five among qb wr tandems in the nfl it s a pick your poison deal for opposing defenses how will atlanta fare possibly quite well burrow might have the highest success rate on downfield passes in the next gen stats era since 2016 but the falcons are feisty 10 yards past the line of scrimmage they ve allowed 2 0 yards of separation on downfield targets the second lowest mark in the nfl and have forced a tight window on 34 8 of those targets the second highest rate plus atlanta is one of two defenses yet to allow a td on a deep pass 20 air yards this season the falcons are a turnover happy bunch as well logging at least one takeaway in seven of eight games including four against brock purdy s then unbeaten 49ers if atlanta can force burrow into some of the same mistakes he made against tennessee perhaps the bengals can be tamed through the air one thing s for sure unlike the falcons last opponent cincinnati will complete at least one pass right 2 another big day for bijan in a solo window no one in the nfl performs better in prime time than bijan robinson a 3 30 local time start in madrid isn t quite like playing under the sunday night lights but it is an exclusive tv window for robinson and the falcons which could mean a showcase for the show stopper the nfl s leading rusher has paced atlanta s fifth ranked run game at one point producing three straight gems in prime time see 478 total yards against green bay new orleans and baltimore in weeks 3 5 robinson has slowed over the last three weeks though the falcons ground game was the only thing even moderately functional in the rain soaked loss at tampa with michael penix throwing four picks is this international stage the perfect platform for a bijan bounce back cincy revamped its defensive front in the offseason and it has paid dividends overall the bengals have stuffed 31 7 of outside zone runs the highest rate in the nfl and a good trend against robinson who averages an nfl best 6 5 yards per carry on outside zone runs with a 53 2 success rate plus though robinson is a great tackle breaker averaging 4 3 yards per carry on runs where he is hit at or behind the line of scrimmage the best rate through eight games by anyone since 2018 the bengals tend not to allow such big gains they ve yielded 0 7 yards per carry second fewest when they ve hit the runner at or behind the line and their 24 5 stuff rate on designed runs is the highest in the nfl an acquaintance of real madrid and france star striker kylian mbappe robinson can only hope that in dexter lawrence and the bengals front he is not like mbappe running into the spanish backline bound for a shutout 3 an international brotherhood in this seventh international matchup of the nfl s historic nine game slate in 2026 a unique meeting is set to take place when the bengals offense faces the falcons defense cincinnati starting running back chase brown and atlanta defensive back sydney brown are set to square off against one another for the second time a battle of twin brothers on foreign soil the european encounter won t feel too strange though after all the browns journey to this moment has been an international one born in london ontario canada the brothers made their entry into the united states in high school when they relocated to bradenton florida from there sydney attended the university of illinois while chase initially went to western michigan before rejoining his brother for four seasons on the fighting illini sydney was a third round pick of philadelphia in 2023 while chase went to cincinnati in the fifth the brothers first played one another in 2024 when sydney s eagles stomped chase s bengals 37 17 in the game chase found the end zone while sydney logged three defensive snaps now the browns will meet again this time across the ocean from their homelands original and adopted chase is coming off his most productive game in what has been a slow start to the season 101 scrimmage yards versus tennessee through eight contests in his first year in atlanta sydney has logged 28 tackles one tfl a pass defensed and a forced fumble perhaps before they presumably meet to exchange jerseys after the game the brothers brown sons of ontario will collide in the middle of madrid s famed bernabeu hermano a hermano

news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook in today s installment he diagnoses the problems afflicting some notable names two months into the 2026 nfl regular season several prominent players are struggling while everyone endures occasional slumps the best can get out of a tailspin with more work and some schematic tweaking today i m spotlighting 10 disappointing players five on offense five on defense and assessing whether each can turn things around before season s end
