news_mentions.headline: Lions win for Jack Campbell as their defense gives reason to believe again
news_mentions.body_text: miami gardens fla he wasn 39 t there but he was he was on their minds in the week leading up to an emotional game his name was on their backs as they walked inside hard rock stadium ready to play for him and his signature no 46 jersey rested in the visitors 39 locker room a not so subtle reminder of the message this week it was all part of a collective collaborative effort by the detroit lions to pay homage to jack campbell 34 today was dedicated to 46 man 34 lions linebacker derrick barnes said after his defense lifted the lions to a 19 9 win over the dolphins it was an emotional week at 222 republic drive players and coaches on this team felt helpless watching campbell unable to move during last week 39 s game against the vikings on a tackle considered routine in nature campbell was in the vicinity of the ball as we 39 ve come to expect but he didn 39 t emerge players noticed they called for help and athletic trainers and medical professionals ran to his aid they kept waiting for him to get up he always gets up and when he didn 39 t they knew something was wrong campbell was placed on a spinal board then on a cart and was later transported to detroit 39 s henry ford hospital listed as a neck injury campbell lost movement as scary a situation as you 39 ll see unfold at ford field lions coach dan campbell doing his best to navigate news as it came in said the lions couldn 39 t shy away from the cloud created by campbell 39 s absence they acknowledged the injury and the violent nature of this game they broached the topic with sensitivity offering resources for players if needed it was hard to focus on football for much of the week however in a statement released by campbell and his family on wednesday campbell said he has since regained all movement of his lower body and was making progress on regaining movement of his upper body for his teammates who didn 39 t know what sort of future campbell could live the news offered them a chance to exhale move forward and shift their focus back to football and so the message this week was simple prepare and play like 46 34 it 39 s all we could do 34 dan campbell said of the situation 34 i mentioned this before he 39 ll take the prayers but he didn 39 t want the pity he didn 39 t want you wasting the time thinking about him he certainly doesn 39 t want us to go and not play our best ball and lose a game so that 39 s what we could do and we wanted to honor him there 39 s nothing easy about it this is hard because you do want to talk about it and acknowledge it because if you just brush it under the rug that 39 s not fair i mean the guy means too much to us and so the guys did that 34 the linebacker room knew they wanted to honor campbell at sunday 39 s game they just didn 39 t know how a few different ideas were discussed t shirts were the early answer until they realized those might take weeks to arrive they kept workshopping in search of something quick barnes spoke with lions head equipment manager tim o 39 neill and asked if he could supply the linebackers and a few defensive coaches with no 46 campbell jerseys a plan was put into motion they wore them to breakfast together they wore them into the stadium and when they arrived in the locker room the equipment team left a locker and nameplate for campbell sandwiched between derrick barnes and trevor nowaske with campbell 39 s jersey resting on a hanger 34 it was kind of a collective effort 34 said trevor nowaske campbell 39 s closest friend on the team 34 obviously this whole week 39 s been just kind of trying to support him any way we can 133 we were thinking of a couple different things and you know it 39 s just something kind of subtle to just show that no matter what he 39 s with us whether he 39 s here or not 34 barnes who wore the green dot and communicated detroit 39 s defensive calls sunday spent a little extra time on his tablet in the locker room this week like campbell typically would linebackers knew that a little bit more was expected of them from barnes to nowaske to malcolm rodriguez all three were either here before campbell joined the team or arrived the same year and on their first defensive snap of the game those three met at the line of scrimmage together and stonewalled dolphins running back ollie gordon for no gain a fitting start and a tone set 34 when we hopped up i looked around and said 39 ok 44 rodriguez there we go now aske 39 34 barnes said after the game campbell wasn 39 t out there but you wouldn 39 t know it the way this defense played without their leader they held true to their word preparing and playing like campbell it was early and often against a dolphins team that reminded lions players of themselves back in 2021 and 2022 what made it all the more impressive was that the lions weren 39 t just without campbell they were missing their best cornerback d j reed as well as starting edge rusher dj wonnum and yet this was without question their best defensive effort of the season the lions allowed a season low nine points and 228 yards of offense while controlling the line of scrimmage they held the dolphins to 77 rushing yards on 21 attempts limiting miami to zero or negative rushing yards on 28 6 percent of their attempts second best in week 9 they picked off malik willis and sacked him three times all three coming in the fourth quarter they allowed just two explosive plays on sunday a season low and they got off the field when it mattered holding miami to just 4 of 12 on third down and 0 of 3 in the red zone the dolphins could only muster three field goals each defensive stop each turnover or turnover on downs each field goal attempt players on this defense thought of 46 34 really anytime we were kind of in a rut today or they popped one or something in my head i 39 m just like 39 hey man listen if there 39 s one thing i 39 m gonna do today i 39 m gonna just go balls to the wall because i know jack would 39 34 nowaske said 34 that 39 s what i just kept coming back to and that 39 s really how i played all day 34 the lions 6 2 are playing good football right now they 39 ve won four in a row keeping pace in the toughest division in the league a defense that looked like one of the nfl 39 s worst is now rounding into form in weeks 1 4 the lions allowed 31 75 points per game second worst at the time since week 5 they rank fourth at just 15 5 and while they haven 39 t exactly faced a juggernaut in those games their efforts have directly contributed to wins picking up the slack for the offense at times between better execution the return of brian branch the looming return of kerby joseph and potential additions at the trade deadline this defense is giving folks reason to believe again even if campbell is merely a spectator in the immediate future in the meantime sunday was an ode to campbell and everything he means to this team even though campbell 39 s teammates can admit he 39 ll probably be annoyed with their gesture when they touch base 34 i already know he 39 s gonna be mad 34 nowaske said laughing 34 i know him and i know he 39 s gonna be like 39 guys what are you doing 39 but i mean we gotta show our support to our dog 34 the lions will continue to it is not customary for players on injured reserve to have a designated locker for a road game especially one they didn 39 t travel but you can make an exception for a player like campbell 34 that locker 39 s traveling and we 39 ll do our part 34 dan campbell said the lions won 39 t soon forget campbell and his contributions to this team but they understand they have a job to do to win on sunday they did it for him this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

made a one handed 13 yard touchdown reception while tank dell and boutte each scored on 63 yard catch and run plays boutte led all receivers with 125 receiving yards on four catches dell finished with 105 yards the fifth career 100 yard receiving game and xavier hutchinson also caught the opening td his second straight week with a score houston ended the game with nearly 500 yards of offense sending a signal to the rest of the league that its qb is making a serious push for mvp chargers spiraling nothing absolutely nothing went well for los angeles on sunday perhaps the lone positive on the day was that the offense finally scored a touchdown a 58 yard catch and run connection between justin herbert and quentin johnston with 12 47 minutes left in the fourth quarter that snapped a 37 drive touchdown drought dating back to week 5 against denver injuries penalties turnovers it all added up to another lopsided loss the team s eighth of the year offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel tried something new sunday calling plays from the box instead of the sideline the first time doing so since 2021 his lone season as 49ers oc but to no avail the unit which was without no 1 receiver ladd mcconkey who experienced back spasms during pre game warmups did ok early by moving into houston territory on four straight drives yet it settled for a punt and three field goals los angeles final three drives of the half were abysmal three plays for negative 1 net yard three plays for negative 4 net yards and three plays for negative 4 net yards ultimately leading to a 15 point deficit at the half the sluggishness before halftime has been a huge crutch for the chargers this season as they have been outscored 47 6 41 in the final two minutes of the second quarter the result of this game was already clear early in the third with the boo birds showing up credit to houston s defense stay tuned for constantly flustering herbert who completed 13 of his 23 passes for 193 yards the touchdown and an interception herbert exited the game after his td pass was assessed by trainers on the sideline and came out of the blue tent with a glove on his left non throwing hand 2025 udfa dj uiagalelei entered the contest in place of herbert throwing a garbage time touchdown in his first nfl appearance it s hard to say where the chargers go from here texans d brings the boom demeco ryans had to be pleased with the texans defensive effort sunday save for that 58 yard chargers garbage time touchdown that snapped l a s td drought his unit relentlessly pressured justin herbert all game long sacking him a whopping eight times sheldon rankins jadeveon clowney and will anderson logged two apiece while m j stewart and logan hall each had one anderson now leads the nfl with 9 5 sacks breaking his tie with t j watt pittsburgh is on a bye frankly the entire unit was mostly exquisite derek stingley recorded his first pick of the season and had three pbus kamari lassiter had four passes defensed azeez al shaair had a team high nine tackles henry to 39 oto 39 o forced a fumble and calen bullock recovered it for a unit that was performing pretty far below expectation early in the season it s rounding into form now several weeks after ryans took back play calling duties next gen stats insight for texans chargers via nfl pro c j stroud completed 10 of 16 passes on intermediate throws between 10 and 19 air yards for 254 yards five touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the chargers it is the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span nfl research with his successful 56 yard field goal in the first quarter ka 39 imi fairbairn tied sebastian janikowski for the third most 50 plus yard field goals in nfl history with 58 back to top kevin patra s takeaways warner niners d dominates in rout of raiders fred warner s push for the defensive player of the year award took another impressive leap forward the nfl s best off ball linebacker dominated a raiders offense that had moved the ball this year warner executed a perfect peanut punch on brock bowers on the ensuing drive the lb pounced on another forced fumble later he perfectly timed a leap over the line to tackle kirk cousins on a sneak for the game he gobbled up five tackles one tackle for loss a forced fumble and a fumble recovery warner sets the tone for a ferocious defense the niners forced five second half turnovers including four straight to close out the contest when the raiders threatened to make it a game raheem morris crew slammed the door shut niners offense handles business coming off the bye week kyle shanahan s squad quickly knocked off the rust with brock purdy deftly going through reads to find open targets the qb spearheaded td drives of 12 13 and 12 plays to open up the game with a 21 7 lead despite still missing wideouts the niners offense didn t miss a beat purdy s worst throw was an undershot of an open george kittle that was intercepted outside of that miscue the mvp candidate shined particularly by pushing the ball downfield on passes of 10 plus air yards purdy went 7 for 11 for 153 yards a td and an int he went 2 for 2 on passes of 20 plus air yards for 74 yards including ripping a 37 yard touchdown to jordan watkins with the ground game blasting for 190 yards on 43 carries the niners offense was a force following its first loss of the season turnovers sink raiders chances despite getting down big early vegas had a chance to make things interesting in the second half but kept stumbling kirk cousins threw a pick six on the opening possession of the third quarter the turnovers were just beginning brock bowers fumble was followed by michael mayer getting the ball punched out as he went into the end zone then the worst sequence happened bowers took a pass and galloped to the goal line he was stopped one yard short cousins lost two yards on a sneak an offensive pass interference call wiped out a mayer td then cousins underthrew a ball in the end zone for an int on back to back drives the raiders got the ball to the half yard line and came away with zero points oof vegas simply doesn t have the horses to keep things close when it turns the ball over at that rate next gen stats insight for 49ers raiders via nfl pro jordan watkins caught all four of his receiving targets for 84 yards career high and his first career touchdown in a win against the raiders his 17 4 average air yards per target were a season high nfl research christian mccaffrey scored his 37th career receiving touchdown breaking a tie with marshall faulk for the most by a running back in the super bowl era mccaffrey snapped a career long drought of nine straight games without a receiving touchdown dating back to week 17 of the 2025 season mccaffrey also scored a rushing touchdown giving him 18 career games with both a rushing and receiving touchdown extending his record for the most in nfl history back to top dan parr s takeaways love states mvp case i m not sure anyone is going to overtake current favorite josh allen in the mvp race this season but as i predicted he would jordan love planted his flag firmly in the conversation with his performance on sunday love completed 23 of 29 passes for 372 yards with three touchdowns in three and a half quarters of work backup tyrod taylor entered the blowout win in the fourth quarter love remains the league leader in passing yards with 2 618 232 yards more than any other qb sunday was yet another game where love received almost no help from the league s least productive running game and he also faced a lot of heat with the patriots pressuring him on 13 of his 33 dropbacks 39 4 it didn t matter love was locked in and dropping dimes to christian watson and matthew golden making a talented new england secondary look silly at times watson finished with a career high 171 receiving yards on seven catches while golden led the team with 10 grabs for a career high 164 yards the packers were the underdogs entering sunday s game but matt lafleur s crew controlled the contest from start to finish with its 1 2 start to the season feeling like a distant memory green bay gets a rematch at home against the nfc north leading vikings next week one storyline to follow leading up to that battle will be the status of running back josh jacobs who suffered a fractured finger on sunday maye s turnovers too much for patriots to overcome progress isn t always linear and sunday offered pats fans a stark reminder of that fact after drake maye shook off a turnover plagued start to the season to compile a touchdown to interception ratio of 11 1 in his previous four games sunday marked a step back for the third year qb he threw three interceptions in the first half and was lucky to avoid a fourth on a pass that was nearly picked off by the packers kamal hadden new england fell behind 24 7 in the second quarter and the rout was on maye was without wr1 a j brown but brown s only played in three games all season making a total of nine catches for 101 yards the patriots can t count on him to solve all their problems they were also without rb2 treveyon henderson on sunday and it s not clear when he will be back after being hospitalized recently with what he described as a medical emergency to make matters worse rb1 rhamondre stevenson exited the game with a knee injury there were more injuries to a banged up offensive line on sunday too it s all far from ideal for a team with playoff aspirations after winning the afc title last season now the patriots will go overseas for a munich matchup with the lions who have won four games in a row packers defense has something special brewing green bay s offense deserves plenty of praise for its performance but we should not overlook the team s defensive showing yes the packers gave up 27 points but the patriots two second half touchdowns were scored in garbage time when the game was out of hand jonathan gannon s defense had drake maye out of sorts from the jump finishing with four sacks and four takeaways all three of maye s ints ended up in the hands of safeties with xavier mckinney picking him off twice and evan williams snagging one on a deflection maye was pressured on 51 2 of his dropbacks the highest pressure rate he has faced in a regular season game just below the 52 8 he faced in the super bowl against the seahawks per next gen stats and we might not have seen green bay s best on defense yet with three time first team all pro apparently micah parsons getting closer to making his 2026 debut next gen stats insight for packers patriots via nfl pro patriots cornerback christian gonzalez allowed a career high 10 receptions for 187 yards on 11 targets in coverage against the packers nearly matching his yards allowed during his first six games this season 196 yards and the third most by any defender in a game this season gonzalez was targeted on seven of his 17 matchups against matthew golden allowing all seven targets to be caught for 105 yards he was also targeted on three of his four matchups against christian watson allowing three receptions for 82 yards and a td gonzalez is the only player since 2018 to allow more than 80 receiving yards to multiple players in the same game he had never allowed more than 71 yards in a game to a single receiver previously nfl research the packers scored a season high 45 points in their week 9 win the most the patriots have ever allowed in a game at gillette stadium green bay also posted a season high 478 total yards including 129 rushing yards after failing to surpass 90 rushing yards in any of their first eight games of the 2026 season back to top nick shook s takeaways seahawks grind out another win seattle s offense still leaves plenty to be desired but managed to finish with 295 yards pieced together two touchdown drives that ended with tight end aj barner reaching the end zone and snuffed out arizona s comeback attempt by gaining three first downs and maintaining possession over the final 4 35 to secure a 17 3 win seattle accomplished this with backup drew lock playing in place of sam darnold while also dealing with his own elbow injury and sustaining an oblique injury during sunday s game generating enough offense to build a satisfactory lead for the defense to protect for the remainder of the game perhaps most importantly the seahawks won a game without receiving a massive contribution from jaxon smith njigba who finished with seven catches for 51 yards and didn t need to become the game breaking weapon he s been in most of seattle s triumphs this season it wasn t a performance that will take any heat off embattled offensive coordinator brian fleury but the win will quiet critics for the next week and a 5 4 record looks better than a 500 mark at this stage it was also equally important for seattle to keep pace in an nfc west that now features three teams above 500 minshew magic runs out gardner minshew s insertion into the lineup sparked a frantic comeback effort in a thrilling win over dallas in week 8 clearing the way for minshew to take over as starter for arizona to trade jacoby brissett to baltimore and for the cardinals to proceed with another veteran who seemed to have a better rapport with his targets and a higher willingness to take calculated risks in order to jump start the offense that gave cardinals fans reason to believe mike lafleur s offense might finally produce a quality day offensively even against one of the nfl s best defenses instead arizona encountered a familiar experience in its rematch with seattle struggling to generate offense and falling well short of competing with the seahawks in a loss that truly wasn t as close as the score suggested making matters worse was a hit minshew took to his right arm while throwing which seemed to sap him of the arm strength necessary to find open targets in the second half even when arizona flirted with another fourth quarter comeback minshew and the cardinals offense ran aground inside seattle s 10 extinguishing their fading hope of climbing back into the game and reminding arizona of the uphill battle it will face in most matchups going forward does this mean we might see rookie carson beck soon no not yet unless minshew s arm ends up being hurt worse than what was detectable sunday but the thrill of minshew s arrival and instant success proved to be unreliable dropping the cardinals to 3 6 in a season that s likely already starting to look toward april charbonnet shows some juice zach charbonnet the other half of seattle s past two headed backfield finally returned to the field in week 8 but didn t generate much in terms of production or pop it wasn t surprising given the nature of the knee injury that kept him out until his midseason arrival but with the seahawks desperate for ground game consistency they could use a notable contribution from the power back and finally received one sunday charbonnet rushed 16 times for 77 yards made a handful of defenders miss broke some tackles and looked much more like the runner he was in previous seasons bringing a welcome level of balance to an offense that already relied too heavily on sam darnold and was expected to do the same with backup drew lock jadarian price flashed in the passing game too making a fantastic sideline catch as part of his four receptions for 54 yards it s far from a guarantee that they ve suddenly rediscovered their ability to run the ball opponent must be considered in these small sample sizes but at least it s an encouraging sign for an offense that still hasn t found much of a rhythm next gen stats insight for cardinals seahawks via nfl pro seattle entered week 9 ranked 24th in rushing success rate 37 3 and enjoyed an uptick in that category on sunday finishing with a designed run success rate of 44 8 zach charbonnet accounted for most of the improvement finishing with a designed run success rate of 43 8 nfl research drew lock has faced the cardinals in both of his starts in 2026 and beat them in both lock is just the fourth quarterback since starts were tracked in 1950 to face the same team in each of his first two starts of a season and beat them in both joining frankie albert versus the lions in 1952 daryle lamonica versus the jets in 1963 and derek anderson versus the buccaneers in 2014 back to top grant gordon s takeaways bears survive sunday night disaster dazzling at the onset disastrous for most of the final three quarters caleb williams and the bears survived calamity to emerge with their fourth straight win after the buccaneers tied the game with 2 51 to play on sunday night williams seemingly absent of the confidence that was oozing earlier in the evening was able to drive the bears down the field thanks mostly to a 38 yard hook up with a wide open colston loveland the final drive set up cairo santos for a game winning 38 yard field goal with zeroes on the clock it wasn t in the realm of possibility that the game would end in such fashion after williams had hit luther burden on a crosser for a 56 yard touchdown that led to a 14 0 lead at the conclusion of the first quarter williams had completed six of his eight pass attempts for 105 yards and two touchdowns each of the incompletions coming on drops thereafter williams was an atrocious 16 of 29 for 174 yards zero touchdowns a career worst four interceptions and a 33 5 rating in all the bears had five turnovers with williams first three picks coming on ill advised balls in which he appeared to be trying to throw the ball away while fading back and going airborne his fourth was off a deflection and the fifth giveaway was a burden fumble that set up the game tying score burden looked to have potentially gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again
