after the blockbuster trade to acquire garrett from the browns but the vibes shifted dramatically during the team s disappointing 2 4 start to the season three straight wins later the rams are above squad in 2026 but it feels like the season has been rescued from the brink of disaster commanders crushed by failure to capitalize on opportunities to provide some perspective on how rough the last season and a half has been for washington the team had a chance to win two games in a row for the first time since jayden daniels rookie year 2024 on sunday they scored first taking a 3 0 lead early but the rams tied the game later in the first quarter and washington never led again twice the commanders started drives in rams territory and they only managed to turn those possessions into a total offense s final snap of the game the rams do not believe nacua has an acl tear but he will undergo an mri on monday to determine the severity of the injury per the report the all pro made 14 catches for a season high 150 yards and a touchdown on 19 targets also he had two carries for 20 yards washington played zone on 84 1 of nacua s routes and he caught 12 of 17 targets for 128 yards against it his most yards against zone coverage in a game this season per next gen stats he did lose a fumble but jayden daniels fumbled the ball right back to the rams on the next possession it was still far from easy sledding for the rams offense which started the game 0 for 9 on third down matthew stafford threw an interception on a pass to nacua and was not at his sharpest as a passer the rams scored their fewest points in a game since their last loss an 18 16 defeat against the cardinals the team stafford and co will visit in week 10 next gen stats insight for rams commanders via nfl pro the rams used 13 personnel on 40 of 73 offensive plays 54 8 in their win over the commanders the highest rate by an offense in a game this season in 13 personnel the rams averaged 5 3 yards per play with a 57 5 success rate and a touchdown in all other groupings 33 plays they averaged 4 4 yards per play with a 27 3 success rate and a touchdown nfl research puka nacua now has nine career games with 150 plus receiving yards two more than any other player since he entered the nfl in 2023 he broke a tie with hall of famer elroy hirsch for the third most such games in rams history and now trails only hall of famer isaac bruce 13 and torry holt 12 back to top brooke cersosimo s takeaways stroud texans offense is humming in a homecoming game for c j stroud who grew up in southern california he threw the ball to whoever he wanted and wherever he wanted against the chargers evidence that he s playing some of the most confident football of his pro career stroud finished with an impressive 384 yards and five touchdowns before exiting with just under 9 minutes to play in the blowout win tying his career high td passes in a game week 9 of 2023 stroud was well protected by his offensive line and his receivers rewarded him for throwing the ball with pinpoint accuracy look no further than houston s third touchdown drive of the day on three of his four completions stroud dropped absolute dimes on outbreaking routes to dalton schultz 14 yards marvin harrison 15 yards and kayshon boutte 12 yard td who each hauled in the pass with toe tapping flare and talk about jaw dropping catches nico collins made a one handed 13 yard touchdown reception while tank dell and boutte each scored on 63 yard catch and run plays boutte led all receivers with 125 receiving yards on four catches dell finished with 105 yards the fifth career 100 yard receiving game and xavier hutchinson also caught the opening td his second straight week with a score houston ended the game with nearly 500 yards of offense sending a signal to the rest of the league that its qb is making a serious push for mvp chargers spiraling nothing absolutely nothing went well for los angeles on sunday perhaps the lone positive on the day was that the offense finally scored a touchdown a 58 yard catch and run connection between justin herbert and quentin johnston with 12 47 minutes left in the fourth quarter that snapped a 37 drive touchdown drought dating back to week 5 against denver injuries penalties turnovers it all added up to another lopsided loss the team s eighth of the year offensive coordinator mike mcdaniel tried something new sunday calling plays from the box instead of the sideline the first time doing so since 2021 his lone season as 49ers oc but to no avail the unit which was without no 1 receiver ladd mcconkey who experienced back spasms during pre game warmups did ok early by moving into houston territory on four straight drives yet it settled for a punt and three field goals los angeles final three drives of the half were abysmal three plays for negative 1 net yard three plays for negative 4 net yards and three plays for negative 4 net yards ultimately leading to a 15 point deficit at the half the sluggishness before halftime has been a huge crutch for the chargers this season as they have been outscored 47 6 41 in the final two minutes of the second quarter the result of this game was already clear early in the third with the boo birds showing up credit to houston s defense stay tuned for constantly flustering herbert who completed 13 of his 23 passes for 193 yards the touchdown and an interception herbert exited the game after his td pass was assessed by trainers on the sideline and came out of the blue tent with a glove on his left non throwing hand 2025 udfa dj uiagalelei entered the contest in place of herbert throwing a garbage time touchdown in his first nfl appearance it s hard to say where the chargers go from here texans d brings the boom demeco ryans had to be pleased with the texans defensive effort sunday save for that 58 yard chargers garbage time touchdown that snapped l a s td drought his unit relentlessly pressured justin herbert all game long sacking him a whopping eight times sheldon rankins jadeveon clowney and will anderson logged two apiece while m j stewart and logan hall each had one anderson now leads the nfl with 9 5 sacks breaking his tie with t j watt pittsburgh is on a bye frankly the entire unit was mostly exquisite derek stingley recorded his first pick of the season and had three pbus kamari lassiter had four passes defensed azeez al shaair had a team high nine tackles henry to 39 oto 39 o forced a fumble and calen bullock recovered it for a unit that was performing pretty far below expectation early in the season it s rounding into form now several weeks after ryans took back play calling duties next gen stats insight for texans chargers via nfl pro c j stroud completed 10 of 16 passes on intermediate throws between 10 and 19 air yards for 254 yards five touchdowns and an interception in week 9 against the chargers it is the only game in which a quarterback has thrown five touchdowns targeting the intermediate level since at least 2016 and the third most yards recorded by a quarterback on such throws in that span nfl research with his successful 56 yard field goal in the first quarter ka 39 imi fairbairn tied sebastian janikowski for the third most 50 plus yard field goals in nfl history with 58 back to top kevin patra s takeaways warner niners d dominates in rout of raiders fred warner s push for the defensive player of the year award took another impressive leap forward the nfl s best off ball linebacker dominated a raiders offense that had moved the ball this year warner executed a perfect peanut punch on brock bowers on the ensuing drive the lb pounced on another forced fumble later he perfectly timed a leap over the line to tackle kirk cousins on a sneak for the game he gobbled up five tackles one tackle for loss a forced fumble and a fumble recovery warner sets the tone for a ferocious defense the niners forced five second half turnovers including four straight to close out the contest when the raiders threatened to make it a game raheem morris crew slammed the door shut niners offense handles business coming off the bye week kyle shanahan s squad quickly knocked off the rust with brock purdy deftly going through reads to find open targets the qb spearheaded td drives of 12 13 and 12 plays to open up the game with a 21 7 lead despite still missing wideouts the niners offense didn t miss a beat purdy s worst throw was an undershot of an open george kittle that was intercepted outside of that miscue the mvp candidate shined particularly by pushing the ball downfield on passes of 10 plus air yards purdy went 7 for 11 for 153 yards a td and an int he went 2 for 2 on passes of 20 plus air yards for 74 yards including ripping a 37 yard touchdown to jordan watkins with the ground game blasting for 190 yards on 43 carries the niners offense was a force following its first loss of the season turnovers sink raiders chances despite getting down big early vegas had a chance to make things interesting in the second half but kept stumbling kirk cousins threw a pick six on the opening possession of the third quarter the turnovers were just beginning brock bowers fumble was followed by michael mayer getting the ball punched out as he went into the end zone then the worst sequence happened bowers took a pass and galloped to the goal line he was stopped one yard short cousins lost two yards on a sneak an offensive pass interference call wiped out a mayer td then cousins underthrew a ball in the end zone for an int on back to back drives the raiders got the ball to the half yard line and came away with zero points oof vegas simply doesn t have the horses to keep things close when it turns the ball over at that rate next gen stats insight for 49ers raiders via nfl pro jordan watkins caught all four of his receiving targets for 84 yards career high and his first career touchdown in a win against the raiders his 17 4 average air yards per target were a season high nfl research christian mccaffrey scored his 37th career receiving touchdown breaking a tie with marshall faulk for the most by a running back in the super bowl era mccaffrey snapped a career long drought of nine straight games without a receiving touchdown dating back to week 17 of the 2025 season mccaffrey also scored a rushing touchdown giving him 18 career games with both a rushing and receiving touchdown extending his record for the most in nfl history back to top dan parr s takeaways love states mvp case i m not sure anyone is going to overtake current favorite josh allen in the mvp race this season but as i predicted he would jordan love planted his flag firmly in the conversation with his performance on sunday love completed 23 of 29 passes for 372 yards with three touchdowns in three and a half quarters of work backup tyrod taylor entered the blowout win in the fourth quarter love remains the league leader in passing yards with 2 618 232 yards more than any other qb sunday was yet another game where love received almost no help from the league s least productive running game and he also faced a lot of heat with the patriots pressuring him on 13 of his 33 dropbacks 39 4 it didn t matter love was locked in and dropping dimes to christian watson and matthew golden making a talented new england secondary look silly at times watson finished with a career high 171 receiving yards on seven catches while golden led the team with 10 grabs for a career high 164 yards the packers were the underdogs entering sunday s game but matt lafleur s crew controlled the contest from start to finish with its 1 2 start to the season feeling like a distant memory green bay gets a rematch at home against the nfc north leading vikings next week one storyline to follow leading up to that battle will be the status of running back josh jacobs who suffered a fractured finger on sunday maye s turnovers too much for patriots to overcome progress isn t always linear and sunday offered pats fans a stark reminder of that fact after drake maye shook off a turnover plagued start to the season to compile a touchdown to interception ratio of 11 1 in his previous four games sunday marked a step back for the third year qb he threw three interceptions in the first half and was lucky to avoid a fourth on a pass that was nearly picked off by the packers kamal hadden new england fell behind 24 7 in the second quarter and the rout was on maye was without wr1 a j brown but brown s only played in three games all season making a total of nine catches for 101 yards the patriots can t count on him to solve all their problems they were also without rb2 treveyon henderson on sunday and it s not clear when he will be back after being hospitalized recently with what he described as a medical emergency to make matters worse rb1 rhamondre stevenson exited the game with a knee injury there were more injuries to a banged up offensive line on sunday too it s all far from ideal for a team with playoff aspirations after winning the afc title last season now the patriots will go overseas for a munich matchup with the lions who have won four games in a row packers defense has something special brewing green bay s offense deserves plenty of praise for its performance but we should not overlook the team s defensive showing yes the packers gave up 27 points but the patriots two second half touchdowns were scored in garbage time when the game was out of hand jonathan gannon s defense had drake maye out of sorts from the jump finishing with four sacks and four takeaways all three of maye s ints ended up in the hands of safeties with xavier mckinney picking him off twice and evan williams snagging one on a deflection maye was pressured on 51 2 of his dropbacks the highest pressure rate he has faced in a regular season game just below the 52 8 he faced in the super bowl against the seahawks per next gen stats and we might not have seen green bay s best on defense yet with three time first team all pro apparently micah parsons getting closer to making his 2026 debut next gen stats insight for packers patriots via nfl pro patriots cornerback christian gonzalez allowed a career high 10 receptions for 187 yards on 11 targets in coverage against the packers nearly matching his yards allowed during his first six games this season 196 yards and the third most by any defender in a game this season gonzalez was targeted on seven of his 17 matchups against matthew golden allowing all seven targets to be caught for 105 yards he was also targeted on three of his four matchups against christian watson allowing three receptions for 82 yards and a td gonzalez is the only player since 2018 to allow more than 80 receiving yards to multiple players in the same game he had never allowed more than 71 yards in a game to a single receiver previously nfl research the packers scored a season high 45 points in their week 9 win the most the patriots have ever allowed in a game at gillette stadium green bay also posted a season high 478 total yards including 129 rushing yards after failing to surpass 90 rushing yards in any of their first eight games of the 2026 season back to top nick shook s takeaways seahawks grind out another win seattle s offense still leaves plenty to be desired but managed to finish with 295 yards pieced together two touchdown drives that ended with tight end aj barner reaching the end zone and snuffed out arizona s comeback attempt by gaining three first downs and maintaining possession over the final 4 35 to secure a 17 3 win seattle accomplished this with backup drew lock playing in place of sam darnold while also dealing with his own elbow injury and sustaining an oblique injury during sunday s game generating enough offense to build a satisfactory lead for the defense to protect for the remainder of the game perhaps most importantly the seahawks won a game without receiving a massive contribution from jaxon smith njigba who finished with seven catches for 51 yards and didn t need to become the game breaking weapon he s been in most of seattle s triumphs this season it wasn t a performance that will take any heat off embattled offensive coordinator brian fleury but the win will quiet critics for the next week and a 5 4 record looks better than a 500 mark at this stage it was also equally important for seattle to keep pace in an nfc west that now features three teams above 500 minshew magic runs out gardner minshew s insertion into the lineup sparked a frantic comeback effort in a thrilling win over dallas in week 8 clearing the way for minshew to take over as starter for arizona to trade jacoby brissett to baltimore and for the cardinals to proceed with another veteran who seemed to have a better rapport with his targets and a higher willingness to take calculated risks in order to jump start the offense that gave cardinals fans reason to believe mike lafleur s offense might finally produce a quality day offensively even against one of the nfl s best defenses instead arizona encountered a familiar experience in its rematch with seattle struggling to generate offense and falling well short of competing with the seahawks in a loss that truly wasn t as close as the score suggested making matters worse was a hit minshew took to his right arm while throwing which seemed to sap him of the arm strength necessary to find open targets in the second half even when arizona flirted with another fourth quarter comeback minshew and the cardinals offense ran aground inside seattle s 10 extinguishing their fading hope of climbing back into the game and reminding arizona of the uphill battle it will face in most matchups going forward does this mean we might see rookie carson beck soon no not yet unless minshew s arm ends up being hurt worse than what was detectable sunday but the thrill of minshew s arrival and instant success proved to be unreliable dropping the cardinals to 3 6 in a season that s likely already starting to look toward april charbonnet shows some juice zach charbonnet the other half of seattle s past two headed backfield finally returned to the field in week 8 but didn t generate much in terms of production or pop it wasn t surprising given the nature of the knee injury that kept him out until his midseason arrival but with the seahawks desperate for ground game consistency they could use a notable contribution from the power back and finally received one sunday charbonnet rushed 16 times for 77 yards made a handful of defenders miss broke some tackles and looked much more like the runner he was in previous seasons bringing a welcome level of balance to an offense that already relied too heavily on sam darnold and was expected to do the same with backup drew lock jadarian price flashed in the passing game too making a fantastic sideline catch as part of his four receptions for 54 yards it s far from a guarantee that they ve suddenly rediscovered their ability to run the ball opponent must be considered in these small sample sizes but at least it s an encouraging sign for an offense that still hasn t found much of a rhythm next gen stats insight for cardinals seahawks via nfl pro seattle entered week 9 ranked 24th in rushing success rate 37 3 and enjoyed an uptick in that category on sunday finishing with a designed run success rate of 44 8 zach charbonnet accounted for most of the improvement finishing with a designed run success rate of 43 8 nfl research drew lock has faced the cardinals in both of his starts in 2026 and beat them in both lock is just the fourth quarterback since starts were tracked in 1950 to face the same team in each of his first two starts of a season and beat them in both joining frankie albert versus the lions in 1952 daryle lamonica versus the jets in 1963 and derek anderson versus the buccaneers in 2014 back to top grant gordon s takeaways bears survive sunday night disaster dazzling at the onset disastrous for most of the final three quarters caleb williams and the bears survived calamity to emerge with their fourth straight win after the buccaneers tied the game with 2 51 to play on sunday night williams seemingly absent of the confidence that was oozing earlier in the evening was able to drive the bears down the field thanks mostly to a 38 yard hook up with a wide open colston loveland the final drive set up cairo santos for a game winning 38 yard field goal with zeroes on the clock it wasn t in the realm of possibility that the game would end in such fashion after williams had hit luther burden on a crosser for a 56 yard touchdown that led to a 14 0 lead at the conclusion of the first quarter williams had completed six of his eight pass attempts for 105 yards and two touchdowns each of the incompletions coming on drops thereafter williams was an atrocious 16 of 29 for 174 yards zero touchdowns a career worst four interceptions and a 33 5 rating in all the bears had five turnovers with williams first three picks coming on ill advised balls in which he appeared to be trying to throw the ball away while fading back and going airborne his fourth was off a deflection and the fifth giveaway was a burden fumble that set up the game tying score burden looked to have potentially gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the nfl research drew lock has faced the cardinals in both of his starts in 2026 and beat them in both lock is just the fourth quarterback since starts were tracked in 1950 to face the same team in each of his first two starts of a season and beat them in both joining frankie albert versus the lions in 1952 daryle lamonica versus the jets in 1963 and derek anderson versus the buccaneers in 2014 back to top grant gordon s takeaways bears survive sunday night disaster dazzling at the onset disastrous for most of the final three quarters caleb williams and the bears survived calamity to emerge with their fourth straight win after the buccaneers tied the game with 2 51 to play on sunday night williams seemingly absent of the confidence that was oozing earlier in the evening was able to drive the bears down the field thanks mostly to a 38 yard hook up with a wide open colston loveland the final drive set up cairo santos for a game winning 38 yard field goal with zeroes on the clock it wasn t in the realm of possibility that the game would end in such fashion after williams had hit luther burden on a crosser for a 56 yard touchdown that led to a 14 0 lead at the conclusion of the first quarter williams had completed six of his eight pass attempts for 105 yards and two touchdowns each of the incompletions coming on drops thereafter williams was an atrocious 16 of 29 for 174 yards zero touchdowns a career worst four interceptions and a 33 5 rating in all the bears had five turnovers with williams first three picks coming on ill advised balls in which he appeared to be trying to throw the ball away while fading back and going airborne his fourth was off a deflection and the fifth giveaway was a burden fumble that set up the game tying score burden looked to have potentially gone limp on the hit that forced him to drop possession and suffered a concussion chicago s defense was truly the catalyst for the victory but it wouldn t be possible without williams brilliance early and his final drive dramatics ahead of this one the bears were getting crowned as the new super bowl darlings nothing comes easy in the nfl though and if chicago is to fulfill some high expectations williams must recover get his swagger back and be able to balance it without making the never before seen errors he did on a night in which he and his bears escaped with a w bucky defense have bucs flirting with comeback nine minutes into sunday s proceedings the buccaneers were down 14 points the bears running roughshod on both sides of the ball somehow someway tampa bay made a game of this and came oh so close to a stunning win the somehow was the bucs defense and the someway was bucky irving the defense had the aforementioned quintet of takeaways and held the bears offense to six points after giving up touchdowns on the first two drives zyon mccollum had a pair of picks alex anzalone had an interception and four qb pressures and josiah trotter brought the hat all night long leading a hard hitting defensive effort offensively irving did his best to do it all the squiggly runner had a game high 97 yards on 20 carries and both of tampa s touchdowns he added a team high four receptions for 28 yards it was irving who scored from 6 yards out with 2 51 to go to bring the score to 24 22 baker mayfield then ran in the tying two point conversion mayfield was limping throughout much of the game and it s been made clear that just as the defense is the hallmark of tampa s success irving is the motor driving the bucs offense with tampa sitting at 3 0 this season when irving hits 100 yards rushing he fell just short this night and so did the bucs fortunately at 3 6 the bucs are in the nfc south and right in the thick of the race for the division crown defense saves bears leads win after a torrid start the chicago offense went rogue as it pertained to the script the defense was savage throughout however with jeffery simmons austin booker and the gang absolutely brutalizing baker mayfield and a jaylon johnson interception return for a touchdown keying the win the simmons effect is real so far with the acquisition of the pro bowl defensive tackle having spurred the defense to back to back excellent outings a week after grounding the seahawks the bears got stellar outings from devin bush nine tackles cam lewis six tackles interception simmons sack and booker sack four qb pressures johnson the high priced pro bowler has been terrible for most of the season as his 38 1 pro football focus grade would attest however with the bears clinging to a 17 13 lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: Jonathan Taylor landing spots: Ranking top 7 trade fits for Colts Pro Bowl running back
news_mentions.description: With the NFL’s Nov. 10 trade deadline days away, all eyes are on Jonathan Taylor and the Colts. Kevin Patra identifies seven possible destinations for the star RB.
news_mentions.body_text: with the nfl s nov 10 trade deadline days away all eyes are on jonathan taylor and the indianapolis colts with indy in clear rebuild mode after firing general manager chris ballard moving the veteran running back could return valuable draft capital while the jury is still out on whether the colts will get their trade price met for taylor several squads could use a pro bowl running back as we push toward thanksgiving let s take a quick gander at some potential landing spots for the former all pro running back the league s worst rushing attack could certainly use some help green bay is averaging a measly 60 6 yards per game and has four total rushing touchdowns worse they re not even getting the yards blocked per next gen stats the packers have a comical 164 rush yards over expected they re averaging 1 0 rush yards over expected per carry woof the pack hoped that josh jacobs return would jumpstart the unit while he s been better than marshawn watch me bounce everything outside lloyd jacobs too has been woefully inefficient jacobs has just 75 rushing yards in two games averaging 2 3 yards per carry and has 1 1 rush yards over expected per carry as a team the packers have 27 total missed tackles forced a trade for taylor would immediately help and green bay could potentially move on from jacobs in 2027 if not sooner the question is whether brian gutekunst who played it conservatively with his backfield entering the season would shell out the draft picks needed to make the deal i m not holding my breath even though the fit makes sense the minnesota passing offense has been horrific with kyler murray at the helm carson wentz may coax more consistency this week but a long term upgrade at running back could help solve another issue for the vikings aaron jones and jordan mason have dealt with injuries and while they have generated yardage it s been inefficient jones is averaging 0 5 rush yards over expected this season and mason sits at 0 3 the vikings run attack lacks explosive plays jones and mason have combined for 14 runs of 10 plus yards taylor has 18 alone this season minnesota s poor interior blocking has played a role but the inability of the vikings backs to break tackles has led to a stymied attack 24 combined missed tackles forced from jones and mason taylor has 35 upgrading the rushing attack would help make the passing attack easier by keeping the vikings in better down and distance situations john harbaugh hasn t been shy about checking in on upgrades up and down the roster for the nfc east leaders while the giants have other needs adding a player of taylor s caliber would certainly boost j j mccarthy and the offense injuries have siphoned off the depth of the backfield tyrone tracy is on injured reserve and starter cam skattebo is dealing with a hamstring injury devin singletary stands as the primary back if skattebo can t go this week taylor and skatt would make a nice one two punch that big blue could lean on down the stretch a splash move at the deadline could go a long way to ensuring the giants keep their division lead into january and provide them a chance to pull off a postseason upset there has been scuttlebutt for weeks about the broncos potentially trading for taylor the denver rushing attack can t find a groove ranking in the bottom seven in yards per game 92 6 and sitting 26th with a 36 2 run success rate broncos rbs have combined for 10 runs of 10 plus yards this season rj harvey landing on injured reserve wiped out one option j k dobbins has been inefficient averaging 3 3 yards per carry with 100 rush yards over expected jonah coleman has shown some upside the past two weeks since returning from injury including posting 104 scrimmage yards in week 8 is it enough to quiet the concerns cincy is possibly the most interesting landing spot for taylor chase brown is a solid dual threat back and the bengals are a pass funnel offense behind joe burrow however adding an upper echelon runner could provide a completely different dimension to the offense it d be a play for the playoffs when a ground attack could be even more beneficial particularly in bad weather games cincinnati has attempted 21 9 rushes per game second fewest in the nfl behind only green bay on 94 carries brown has generated 340 yards and one td with a 35 1 success rate taylor could provide a completely different tackle breaking element pair taylor s ability to slam through light boxes with burrow s dive bombing ability and the bengals chances of returning to the super bowl would skyrocket injuries and ineffectiveness have forced washington to cycle through backs this year jacory croskey merritt still leads the commanders in rushing despite landing on injured reserve after only five games rachaad white has offered no consistency austin ekeler is 31 coming off a season ending injury and jeremy mcnichols is out for the season it s not pretty even at 2 4 1 washington isn t out of the nfc east hunt this week could be significant for that race taylor s multi year contract also puts the commanders in play for me he d provide jayden daniels a reliable running mate beyond 2026 and solve a significant problem in d c news of treveyon henderson s unexpected medical emergency gives the pats more incentive to upgrade the backfield rhamondre stevenson has averaged 3 8 yards per carry corey kiner who has impressed in limited opportunities and generated 29 rush yards over expected on just 42 carries could see a significant increase in reps however with henderson sidelined we shouldn t rule out the pats who have surged back into contention from making a splash
