news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the carolina panthers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 21 rookies july 22 veterans location bank of america stadium charlotte north carolina fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs cleveland browns 7 p m et nfl network on friday aug 8 week 2 at houston texans 1 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs pittsburgh steelers 7 p m et nfl network on thursday aug 21 2025 schedule note the panthers are one of just seven teams that do not have a thursday game on their schedule their monday night matchup with san francisco in week 12 is currently slated to be their only prime time game of the 2025 regular season nfl research what you need to know 1 bryce young s growth in the last half of 2024 was the silver lining of yet another lost season in carolina and furthering his development will be a primary focus over training camp the panthers helped that cause in april with the first round selection of tetairoa mcmillan who possesses the typical traits of a true no 1 wide receiver and offers young a rangy target as the quarterback enters year 3 establishing chemistry with mcmillan is crucial for an immediate impact and having veteran adam thielen around figures to aid that process xavier legette s development entering his second season is also essential to forming a dynamic group weapons for young to utilize hunter renfrow s comeback attempt in carolina is another subplot to keep an eye on over the summer as the panthers aim to build around their franchise quarterback 2 derrick brown s return in 2025 won t be only thing to anticipate for the panthers defense defensive linemen tershawn wharton and bobby brown are key free agent additions joining carolina s star defender and the initial gelling of this reimagined defensive front is worth monitoring the panthers lacked any push without brown who suffered a season ending knee injury in week 1 and their run stopping troubles spiraled into last season s 32nd ranked defense a turnaround up front could do wonders for a unit with a talented secondary headed by jaycee horn and mike jackson the panthers also added pass rusher patrick jones and safety tre 39 von moehrig via free agency rookies nic scourton and lathan ransom are also in the mix for playing time 3 kickoff and punt returns might bring some added excitement along carolina s preseason both primary roles are up for grabs this summer and a pair of rookies wr jimmy horn and running back trevor etienne are expected to compete for both jobs the pairing is small in size but brings plenty of speed and shiftiness to a club that has produced just one touchdown return since 2018 the panthers oncoming work on special teams doesn t stop with figuring out the returners either with new kickers matthew wright and ryan fitzgerald battling for the starting role and new punter sam martin holding for longtime long snapper j j jansen

cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the offense go without the star there to demand attention from kansas city s secondary the chiefs had little problem shutting down geno smith smith threw for only 165 yards cooper led the way with 58 yards on eight receptions while mitchell went from 142 yards on seven catches last week to zero catches on seven looks a game later new york got nothing going settling for four field goals in the first half tied for the most over the last 10 seasons in the second half the jets didn t even get the opportunity to settle smith and co managed 58 yards over five drives on the other side of intermission forced to watch their two point halftime deficit unravel into a 23 point loss chiefs come alive for much needed blowout kansas city rode a two game losing streak into week 9 with a 22 fourth quarter point differential that ranked 31st in the league over the past two games if there s one thing patrick mahomes is going to do though it s beat up on bad teams by defeating the jets he moved to 18 0 in his career against teams entering a matchup four plus games under 500 the best by any quarterback since 1970 minimum 15 starts per nfl research he went 23 of 31 for 242 yards and two touchdowns with a 117 9 passer rating but most importantly seemed ok after a strip sack by david bailey late in the second quarter bent his elbow awkwardly and forced him to receive medical attention on the sideline he returned and overcame a frustrating offensive stupor to blow the doors off the jets while the chiefs defense minimized damage early and inflicted plenty of it throughout kansas city pressured geno smith on half of his dropbacks chris jones and george karlaftis led the team with six pressures and two sacks apiece while drue tranquill logged 13 tackles and nick bolton had 12 plus a forced fumble detractors will point out it s only the jets and there are still some issues to work out think harrison butker missing a 56 yard field goal and the subsequent 51 yarder after getting a reprieve due to an offsides penalty just before half but the chiefs can only play who is in front of them in this case they demolished them next gen stats insight for jets chiefs via nfl pro travis kelce caught four of six targets for 72 yards accounting for two of the chiefs five explosive passes 40 0 nfl research kenneth walker had his first career game with multiple receiving touchdowns to go along with a rushing touchdown in the chiefs win over the jets his second career game with three touchdowns back to top bobby kownack s takeaways usual suspects lift detroit to tightly contested win sunday s victory over miami was not your typical lions affair jared goff and the offense took forever to get going and it seemed as if they knew things weren t quite clicking the lions pulled out all the stops against their one win opponent they went for it on fourth down on the first drive a few plays later jahmyr gibbs took a direct snap and faked a pitch to goff before streaking around the edge for 16 yards two plays into the second quarter detroit converted a fake punt throw by jack fox on fourth and 7 from its own 30 the lions constantly stalled out failing to score a touchdown until 1 20 remained in the third quarter and that was a run by gibbs on fourth down too luckily they had a couple stars to lean on to help guide them through their struggles amon ra st brown was the main source of the team s passing offense deep into the final frame at the start of the lions seventh drive of the game he had seven catches while the rest of detroit s pass catchers had combined for six st brown drew a third down pass interference penalty early on that possession and a few plays later hauled in a key 17 yard catch on third and 8 to keep the chains moving with a perilous seven point lead he eventually finished with 86 yards on eight receptions every other lion combined for 10 catches and 95 yards and though gibbs was frequently met by a pod of dolphins in the backfield he still broke off a number of clutch gainers including the aforementioned 8 yard td run he finished with a game high 74 rushing yards that was about it for offensive highlights but it was enough miami wastes strong defensive performance jeff hafley s defense fought valiantly against the league s no 3 scoring offense if only the rest of the team had been able to repay the group s efforts the dolphins consistently crashed into detroit s backfield to locate jahmyr gibbs containing the electric back who had been averaging 4 9 yards per carry entering week 9 to 3 7 yards per attempt on 20 rushes jared goff struggled to find and hit open passers throwing for a season low 170 yards he was sacked three times and tossed just his second pick of the season to rookie corner chris johnson after josh uche hit his arm during the throwing motion the dolphins didn t bend to the point of allowing a touchdown the only one of the game until the waning minutes of the third quarter malik willis and the offense could do nothing with their opportunities however willis threw for only 128 yards and an interception and seemed hesitant to open it up on the ground two carries for 7 yards while ollie gordon was held to 55 rushing yards when the fins had a chance to make it a tie game heading into halftime they instead committed a holding penalty and missed a 38 yard field goal on the final two plays of the second quarter toward the start of the fourth quarter down 10 with the ball at detroit s 7 yard line willis took two sacks over the next three plays before miami settled for a three points gut wrenching mistakes are no way to beat a contender like the lions and the dolphins certainly made their share of them ugly game all around one of the biggest concerns for any 5 2 team traveling to face a 1 6 opponent is typically avoiding playing down to the lesser squad s level the lions absolutely joined the dolphins in the doldrums for a messy matchup that will have neither side coming away feeling particularly happy the lions and dolphins combined for 20 accepted penalties with detroit committing nine to miami s 11 they went 7 for 24 on third down collectively detroit managed only 270 yards nearly 100 fewer than its previous low on the season 355 miami posted its second lowest yardage total of the year with 228 thanks to the offensive ineptitude a few of the most exciting plays of the matchup were actually fake punts both teams ran one and both teams converted on passes one by lions punter jack fox and another by dolphins punter bradley pinion it was the first time since at least 1950 that multiple punters have completed a pass in the same game per nfl research give credit to the lions defense for showing up and making life miserable for the dolphins but detroit didn t exactly put an exclamation point on this one despite running its winning streak to four next gen stats insight for lions dolphins via nfl pro aidan hutchinson matched up against austin jackson 16 times in week 9 all one on one recording six pressures 37 5 pressure rate including two quick pressures under 2 5 seconds nfl research jahmyr gibbs recorded his 60th career touchdown tying hall of famer ladainian tomlinson for the second most by any player in their first four seasons in nfl history trailing only hall of famer terrell davis with 61 back to top nick shook s takeaways saints come alive to earn much needed win by all accounts sunday was an ugly display of football between two middling teams for most of the afternoon a field goal fest including a charlie smyth first half miss set up for what appeared to be a likely 9 6 finish until the browns finally hit a big play for a touchdown when shedeur sanders connected with rookie kc concepcion for a 64 yard passing touchdown the score seemed to position the browns for another fourth quarter comeback win but instead it awoke the saints with just enough time for chaos to ensue new orleans covered 55 yards in six plays and 50 seconds to take a 16 13 lead allowed the browns to tie the game with 0 08 left then embarked on an efficient relentless 74 yard scoring drive that required 11 plays and ended with a pretty touchdown pass from tyler shough to juwan johnson for a 23 16 lead in overtime the stop of cleveland s two point try in overtime sealed the win but it was only made possible by some late success that must have felt for saints fans like the thawing of an offense that spent far too long frozen within a glacier at 3 5 the saints are back in the thick of a race for an nfc south crown that might only require nine wins to secure if they re going to get there sunday s late push toward a victory was essential browns show clear weaknesses in brutal defeat cleveland has lost its ability to stop the run since losing maliek collins to injury and delivered an embarrassing effort against the saints low ceiling rushing attack sunday allowing audric estim 233 who was a member of the browns less than a month ago tyler shough and alvin kamara to run for 155 yards on 31 attempts pacing an offense that came to life thanks to this newfound balance in the second half even worse cleveland s pass coverage unit struggled losing one on one matchups all afternoon grant delpit ronnie hickman and tyson campbell each struggled in such matchups and especially in the game s most crucial moments e g juwan johnson s overtime touchdown and a 33 yard completion from shough to chris olave late in the fourth quarter paired with an offense that wasn t threatening for most of the afternoon with sanders at quarterback cleveland was guaranteed to be locked in a four quarter battle with a team most expected it to defeat without a major struggle instead the browns fell in a fashion that is a strong competitor with their week 1 blowout loss to jacksonville for worst defeat of the season that s not a good place to be in in week 9 shough finds his stride new orleans offense has lacked juice for some time now draining the saints of their early season optimism that was tied to the trajectory of tyler shough in his second nfl season that finally changed in the fourth quarter sunday when cleveland stunned the superdome crowd with an explosive touchdown pass from shedeur sanders to kc concepcion new orleans offense woke up stringing together well designed passing plays with a rushing attack that finally showed some life to move down the field with relative ease against a browns defense that had limited it all afternoon shough was at the center of all of it calmly dropping dimes on chris olave juwan johnson and even rookie jordyn tyson to propel the offense to two clutch touchdown drives in a wild fourth quarter and overtime period we saw the return of a composed accurate shough whose clutch gene reappeared after going into hiding over the last month the timing couldn t be better for this saints team which will be in a weekly fight for survival in an nfc south that remains wide open there s no guarantee their rushing success carries over but getting shough back on track was a massively important development for coach kellen moore who was able to demonstrate some of his expertise in how he too many free rushers at the qb saquon barkley generated just 22 yards on 13 carries 1 7 yards per carry with a td that s not enough to help a young qb in his first start reese is a menace giants rookie linebacker arvell reese was all over the field mashing the eagles with ferocity and bad intentions reese gobbled up three sacks a team high 12 tackles three tackles for loss a forced fumble news_mentions.headline: Saints activate WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring), LT Kelvin Banks (ankle) from IR
news_mentions.description: The New Orleans Saints plan to activate wide receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. from injured reserve, ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reported Saturday. The team has since announced activating both players.
news_mentions.body_text: offensive reinforcements are coming for the saints new orleans is activating wide receiver jordyn tyson and left tackle kelvin banks from injured reserve espn s jeremy fowler reported saturday the team announced both roster moves shortly after tyson the no 8 overall pick in the 2026 draft is the splashier name coming back he was limited all week as he geared up for his return from a hamstring injury that wiped out the first half of his rookie season one of two top 10 wr picks in april s draft tyson hauled in 158 receptions for 2 282 yards and 22 touchdowns across four collegiate seasons split between arizona state and colorado he joined new orleans expected to form one of the next great pass catching duos with chris olave but a training camp hamstring injury delayed a look at how the pair would fare together running routes for quarterback tyler shough the 22 year old will mix back into action alongside olave the team leader with 49 catches and 636 yards as well as devaughn vele and tight end juwan johnson banks return so soon is a pleasant surprise as the standout left tackle suffered a severe high ankle sprain in week 2 that required surgery he spent only six weeks on ir however and his re entry to the lineup should be a boon for shough who could be in line for a bit better protection after seeing a pressure rate of 35 3 this season 17th among qbs new orleans getting some potential difference makers back is massive for a club that sits at the bottom of a still winnable nfc south the saints are 2 5 but they re only one game back of the other three teams in the win column the falcons 3 5 the buccaneers 3 5 and the panthers 3 4 coming out of their bye week much healthier it s now or never for the saints if they re to start climbing out of the hole they dug themselves new orleans kicks off against the browns at 1 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Chicago Bears training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon
