news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL season, Week 9: What We Learned from Sunday's games
news_mentions.description: Around The NFL breaks down what you need to know from Sunday's action in Week 9 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: around the nfl breaks down what you need to know from sunday s action in week 9 of the 2026 nfl season catch up on each game s biggest takeaways using the links below madrid cincinnati bengals 34 atlanta falcons 17 early window denver broncos 26 carolina panthers 21 dallas cowboys 27 indianapolis colts 23 kansas city chiefs 35 new york jets 12 detroit lions 19 miami dolphins 9 new orleans saints 23 cleveland browns 22 ot new york giants 19 philadelphia eagles 11 los angeles rams 20 washington commanders 13 late window houston texans 44 los angeles chargers 22 san francisco 49ers 38 las vegas raiders 17 green bay packers 45 new england patriots 27 seattle seahawks 17 arizona cardinals 3 sunday night chicago bears 27 tampa bay buccaneers 24 jeremy bergman s takeaways cincy s stars sizzle in espana few teams have had better 10 quarter stretches than the bengals over the past three weeks since being shut out in the first half against baltimore in week 7 cincinnati has responded with 112 points over two and a half games leading the way is joe burrow staking a strong claim in the mvp race burrow was lethal again on sunday in the first half leading cincy s offense to four scoring drives on 9 3 yards per play and completing 82 of his passes for 239 yards eight of those completions went to ja 39 marr chase who set a career high with 142 yards in the first half finishing with 155 and a score on 10 catches showcasing his dynamic ability on an international stage for the first time tee higgins boxed out c j henderson and atlanta s defensive backs for two tds even chase brown season high 6 3 ypc and cincinnati s anemic run game season best 123 yards showed some explosion after sunday s romp cincinnati has now won four straight games with at least 30 points scored for the first time in franchise history if the bengals are capable of this type of production weekly do they even need to swing big for a piece possibly at running back at the trade deadline that s a question for tuesday maybe atlanta will have an answer for cincy s offensive onslaught by then another big bijan day undone by atlanta errors a week after losing to a tampa team that didn t complete a pass the falcons found a more traditional way to fall sunday morning play leaky defense commit penalties repeat in pristine climate controlled conditions inside madrid s bernabeu there were no excuses for atlanta s performance first the positives michael penix threw three fewer interceptions than he did a week prior and scrambled for a career high 50 yards looking svelte and nimble on the spanish pitch bijan robinson who loves an exclusive window rushed for 100 again totaling 147 yards from scrimmage and one td on the day the elusive dynamo was right at home at the home of real madrid s galacticos but jeff ulbrich s defense was a sieve against the nfl s hottest attack allowing 7 1 yards per play and forcing just two punts on the day atlanta also committed 12 accepted penalties for 88 yards repeatedly setting back the offense the falcons o line committed two fouls in the red zone on their second drive leading to the first field goal of a touchdown fight its most critical error though came at the start of the fourth quarter when down two tds at the bengals 10 yard line atlanta was called for offensive holding on a third and 2 incompletion cincy accepted the penalty and forced a fourth and 12 settling for cutting a two score lead to a two score lead nick folk instead shanked a 38 yard field goal and the bengals lead held at 14 the falcons never got closer a tale of two divisions despite the result cincinnati and atlanta will both return to the states tied in the win column for leads in their respective divisions the bengals victory moved them into a 6 2 tie atop the afc north with the steelers setting up a critical sunday night football showdown on the banks of the ohio river in week 10 having already lost this season to pittsburgh the bengals need a home win against aaron rodgers and co to improve their division record and ensure no favor in the head to head tiebreaker down in the cursed nfc south the falcons at 3 6 are nowhere near out of it but are at risk of falling behind hotter clubs after sunday s slate atlanta is essentially tied with carolina 3 5 new orleans 3 5 and tampa bay 3 6 a needed bye awaits for the falcons after a week 10 matchup with patrick mahomes chiefs next gen stats insight for bengals falcons via nfl pro joe burrow was pressured on nine of 32 dropbacks 28 1 against the falcons completing 20 of 23 passes for 237 yards and two touchdowns when kept clean his time to pressure of 3 26 seconds was the longest of his career and the falcons defense had just one quick pressure in the game nfl research joe burrow and ja marr chase connected for their 19th touchdown of at least 40 yards in sunday s win tied with joe montana and jerry rice for the third most by any qb receiver duo since 1980 the only duos with more are peyton manning and marvin harrison 21 tds and steve young and jerry rice 20 tds their first quarter touchdown was the 58th score by the duo overall including playoffs which passed daunte culpepper and randy moss for second most by any qb receiver duo before age 30 trailing only dan marino and mark clayton 68 tds back to top nick shook s takeaways broncos win a game of runs it wasn t quite an avalanche but as is often the case in basketball sunday s game became a tale of runs what began as a one sided contest in favor of denver reversed course just before halftime sunday when the panthers turned an interception into a scoring possession to claw back into the competition that shift in momentum saw bryce young enter a flow state dotting the field with precise confident passes and leading a second scoring drive to double up between halves and put the panthers in a 14 13 lead he appeared poised to extend that lead in the fourth too but a wacky interception snagged by denver safety devon key stopped the panthers in their tracks and swung momentum back in favor of the broncos who rattled off two straight touchdown drives to take a 26 14 lead in the final period good for their latest fourth quarter comeback effort denver had to hang on for dear life in the final minutes after carolina mounted one final push and it s not exactly a resounding victory but it s the latest example of a contending team finding a way to win a back and forth contest by coming through in the most important moments and finishing in a style that fits the team s strengths with edge rusher nik bonitto strip sacking young to stop the panthers final drive in its tracks bo nix looked more like the passer we ve known him to be too a small but encouraging sign as the calendar creeps toward thanksgiving panthers defensive changes fail to produce improvement defensive coordinator ejiro evero became the fall guy when coach dave canales relieved him of his duties following carolina s week 8 loss to green bay installing an interim dc with the hopes it might improve the panthers inconsistent defense in short it didn t the panthers allowed denver to break 300 yards of total offense and mount two touchdown drives that appeared vastly different but produced the same result the first fourth quarter scoring march covered 80 yards over 14 plays while the other needed just six plays to gain 61 yards and finish with a wide open touchdown pass to pat bryant as a result of a blown coverage a symptom of a defense that is still scrambling to take care of the details carolina stood tall late buying its offense a chance to compile a game winning drive but the earlier breakdowns represent a persistent issue had cornerback corey thornton not made an incredibly athletic play on the ball to pick off nix this game might have snowballed out of control in the first half long before the panthers offense was able to climb back into the game had jaylen waddle not exited due to a head injury denver might have continued to rely on the playmaker to break open for big gains this unit was never going to be completely fixed in one week but sunday told us there s still plenty to correct nix begins to break out of his shell it didn t last throughout the entire game but seemingly for the first time in ages bo nix took the training wheels off his own bicycle and let himself play a bit more instinctively proof existed in his decisions made while rolling out in which nix twice opted to throw back against his body to open targets underneath instead of accepting a small scramble gain or throwing it away his bullet ripped through traffic to courtland sutton for a touchdown was another encouraging sign because he was willing to take a minor risk and when bryant streaked open through the carolina secondary nix didn t hesitate to put the ball on him for a score the results are evident in his stat line 25 of 37 237 yards two touchdowns one interception it s not a massive change in performance but it s a start broncos fans have been yearning to see for weeks we ll see if it s a sign of things to come next gen stats insight for broncos panthers via nfl pro bo nix posted a 124 2 passer rating against single high coverage 20 of 26 for 202 yards and two touchdowns but a 15 3 passer rating against split safety coverage 5 of 11 for 35 yards and an interception his 15 3 passer rating against split safety looks was his lowest in a game since his nfl debut in week 1 2024 nfl research the broncos won 26 21 in week 9 against the panthers after trailing by one point entering the fourth quarter their fifth win of the season after trailing at any point in the fourth that is tied with the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings for the most wins after trailing in the fourth quarter in a team s first nine games of a season since 2000 both the 2016 lions and 2022 vikings lost their first playoff game that season in the wild card round back to top kevin patra s takeaways cowboys survive collapse to secure a much needed win over colts brian schottenheimer s squad tried to give the game away luckily the cowboys opponent did a better job dallas built a 10 point lead deep into the third quarter mistakes then gave indianapolis life ceedee lamb fumbled late the cowboys second turnover of the day to wipe out a chance to put the game away despite putting up stats with george pickens out lamb had a mistake filled day in addition to the fumble he was called for offensive pass interference twice and couldn t toe tap a td that cost the cowboys four points in the red zone dallas couldn t get out of its own way for much of the contest dak prescott was far more off the mark than we re used to leading to stalled drives schotty s club was called for 14 penalties for a whopping 153 yards turned the ball over twice and missed a late go ahead field goal that s how you let an opponent amid a fire sale stay in a game despite being outgained 508 271 dallas should have run away with the game instead it trailed late until ryan flournoy the best no 3 wr in the league made a massive play for a 46 yard gain to set up the game winning td a loss would have all but doomed the cowboys who still have a big hill to climb in the nfc east colts offense can t kick it into gear until late facing a bad cowboys defense daniel jones and co couldn t take advantage for long stretches indy went three and out five times including on four of its first five drives the other was a 19 yard td drive following a dak prescott fumble jones was inconsistent and often off the mark completing 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards with a td and an interception the cowboys d entered the game allowing a league high 385 4 yards per game and 5 9 yards per play 29th indy generated just 271 yards and 4 6 yards per play while going 3 for 13 on third down ashton dulin s 55 yard catch and run td was indy s only pass play longer than 16 yards jones averaged 2 6 air yards per completion in the game third fewest of his career minimum 10 completions per next gen stats against a dallas d that s been ripped up jones needed to do more the rushing attack did some solid work generating 105 total yards on the ground with seth mcgowan earning 7 5 yards per carry on six totes with a td if sunday was jonathan taylor s final game in indy mcgowan flashed some upside to take over the bulk of the workload downs calls game when javonte williams scored the go ahead touchdown with a little over a minute remaining the big question was whether a sieve dallas d could hold on caleb downs ensured it would by stepping in front of a daniel jones pass sealing the win over his brother josh downs squad the int capped a game in which downs generated a sack three tackles a qb hit a tackle for loss and two passes defensed allowing just one reception on four targets sunday marked the first time all season that the cowboys defense allowed fewer than 318 total yards doing so against a team that s begun a mid season teardown is one thing the cowboys will have a stiffer test against kyle shanahan and the 49ers in week 10 next gen stats insight for cowboys colts via nfl pro ceedee lamb caught six of 12 targets for 180 yards and a touchdown on downfield throws 10 plus air yards in week 9 against the colts the most receiving yards he has recorded on downfield throws in his career nfl research sunday marked dak prescott s first game with 300 plus passing yards multiple passing touchdowns no interceptions and a game winning drive since 2018 in a week 17 win against the giants prescott had one such game in each of his first three career seasons but none from 2019 2025 back to top bobby kownack s takeaways k9 scores touchdowns kenneth walker s reign of terror over the rest of the league took a couple weeks break as the running back was held to 105 rushing yards and no touchdowns over the previous two contests after torching opponents for 665 rushing yards and eight total scores in his first five outings as a chief unfortunately for the jets his dominance s brief hiatus ended sunday walker was a man on a mission versus gang green almost singlehandedly keeping kansas city afloat amid a slow start that included two fumbles a three and out and a missed field goal over the opening two quarters kansas city s other two first half drives ended a bit differently on 7 and 25 yard touchdown receptions by walker he provided the offensive spark while patrick mahomes worked to piece together a consistent passing game using anyone else and after the rest of the operation caught up to walker s heroics to start pulling away from the jets he added a 2 yard td run in the third quarter walker finished with 102 rushing yards a 5 7 per carry average and four runs of 10 plus yards as well as four catches for 41 yards that s after he was able to take a rest midway through the fourth quarter due to a blowout he helped create he now has five games with multiple scrimmage touchdowns the most in the nfl this season and the most by a chiefs running back since larry johnson eight in 2005 wilson is sorely missed by jets there was a lot of intrigue surrounding new york s offense heading into week 9 how would the jets mix breece hallback into the rotation after braelon allen excelled to such a degree during the starter s four game absence how would the passing offense operate without garrett wilson after omar cooper and adonai mitchell recently took turns breaking out for new york as far as the running backs hall saw 18 touches to allen s 10 with hall turning his into 87 yards and allen totaling 54 both running backs averaged 4 1 yards per carry as for the passing offense it was ugly wilson had appeared frustrated in recent weeks as he produced smaller numbers than his counterparts hauling in 12 catches for 153 yards without a score over his previous three games before sustaining a concussion but it s clear he makes the offense go without the star there to demand attention from kansas city s secondary the chiefs had little problem shutting down geno smith smith threw for only 165 yards cooper led the way with 58 yards on eight receptions while mitchell went from 142 yards on seven catches last week to zero catches on seven looks a game later new york got nothing going settling for four field goals in the first half tied for the most over the last 10 seasons in the second half the jets didn t even get the opportunity to settle smith and co managed 58 yards over five drives on the other side of intermission forced to watch their two point halftime deficit unravel into a 23 point loss chiefs come alive for much needed blowout kansas city rode a two game losing streak into week 9 with a 22 fourth quarter point differential that ranked 31st in the league over the past two games if there s one thing patrick mahomes is going to do though it s beat up on bad teams by defeating the jets he moved to 18 0 in his career against teams entering a matchup four plus games under 500 the best by any quarterback since 1970 minimum 15 starts per nfl research he went 23 of 31 for 242 yards and two touchdowns with a 117 9 passer rating but most importantly seemed ok after a strip sack by david bailey late in the second quarter bent his elbow awkwardly and forced him to receive medical attention on the sideline he returned and overcame a frustrating offensive stupor to blow the doors off the jets while the chiefs defense minimized damage early and inflicted plenty of it throughout kansas city pressured geno smith on half of his dropbacks chris jones and george karlaftis led the team with six pressures and two sacks apiece while drue tranquill logged 13 tackles and nick bolton had 12 plus a forced fumble detractors will point out it s only the jets and there are still some issues to work out think harrison butker missing a 56 yard field goal and the subsequent 51 yarder after getting a reprieve due to an offsides penalty just before half but the chiefs can only play who is in front of them in this case they demolished them next gen stats insight for jets chiefs via nfl pro travis kelce caught four of six targets for 72 yards accounting for two of the chiefs five explosive passes 40 0 nfl research kenneth walker had his first career game with multiple receiving touchdowns to go along with a rushing touchdown in the chiefs win over the jets his second career game with three touchdowns back to top bobby kownack s takeaways usual suspects lift detroit to tightly contested win sunday s victory over miami was not your typical lions affair jared goff and the offense took forever to get going and it seemed as if they knew things weren t quite clicking the lions pulled out all the stops against their one win opponent they went for it on fourth down on the first drive a few plays later jahmyr gibbs took a direct snap and faked a pitch to goff before streaking around the edge for 16 yards two plays into the second quarter detroit converted a fake punt throw by jack fox on fourth and 7 from its own 30 the lions constantly stalled out failing to score a touchdown until 1 20 remained in the third quarter and that was a run by gibbs on fourth down too luckily they had a couple stars to lean on to help guide them through their struggles amon ra st brown was the main source of the team s passing offense deep into the final frame at the start of the lions seventh drive of the game he had seven catches while the rest of detroit s pass catchers had combined for six st brown drew a third down pass interference penalty early on that possession and a few plays later hauled in a key 17 yard catch on third and 8 to keep the chains moving with a perilous seven point lead he eventually finished with 86 yards on eight receptions every other lion combined for 10 catches and 95 yards and though gibbs was frequently met by a pod of dolphins in the backfield he still broke off a number of clutch gainers including the aforementioned 8 yard td run he finished with a game high 74 rushing yards that was about it for offensive highlights but it was enough miami wastes strong defensive performance jeff hafley s defense fought valiantly against the league s no 3 scoring offense if only the rest of the team had been able to repay the group s efforts the dolphins consistently crashed into detroit s backfield to locate jahmyr gibbs containing the electric back who had been averaging 4 9 yards per carry entering week 9 to 3 7 yards per attempt on 20 rushes jared goff struggled to find and hit open passers throwing for a season low 170 yards he was sacked three times and tossed just his second pick of the season to rookie corner chris johnson after josh uche hit lead and the buccaneers driving johnson jumped on a mayfield pass and weaved 67 yards the other way for a touchdown for a team to have five turnovers and still come out with a victory is next door to astonishing and the bears defense allowing the buccaneers to score just 10 points off those turnovers is the biggest reason why next gen stats insight for buccaneers bears via nfl pro the buccaneers blitzed caleb williams on 26 of 41 dropbacks 63 4 tied for the third most blitzes any quarterback has faced in a game this season williams was pressured on 13 of those 26 blitzes 50 but was sacked just once he started 7 of 10 for 124 yards and two touchdowns against the blitz went 4 of 10 for 22 yards and three interceptions on his next nine drives and completed 3 of 4 passes for 52 yards against the blitz on the bears game winning drive nfl research zyon mccollum s brilliant toe tapping interception in the second quarter was his career best third of the season each of them coming over the last three games mccollum who added another later in the first half became the first buccaneers player to record an interception in three straight games since lavonte david in 2013 williams four total interceptions were a career high having never thrown that many in an nfl game in college or high school back to top

news_mentions.headline: Jonathan Taylor landing spots: Ranking top 7 trade fits for Colts Pro Bowl running back
news_mentions.description: With the NFL’s Nov. 10 trade deadline days away, all eyes are on Jonathan Taylor and the Colts. Kevin Patra identifies seven possible destinations for the star RB.
news_mentions.body_text: with the nfl s nov 10 trade deadline days away all eyes are on jonathan taylor and the indianapolis colts with indy in clear rebuild mode after firing general manager chris ballard moving the veteran running back could return valuable draft capital while the jury is still out on whether the colts will get their trade price met for taylor several squads could use a pro bowl running back as we push toward thanksgiving let s take a quick gander at some potential landing spots for the former all pro running back the league s worst rushing attack could certainly use some help green bay is averaging a measly 60 6 yards per game and has four total rushing touchdowns worse they re not even getting the yards blocked per next gen stats the packers have a comical 164 rush yards over expected they re averaging 1 0 rush yards over expected per carry woof the pack hoped that josh jacobs return would jumpstart the unit while he s been better than marshawn watch me bounce everything outside lloyd jacobs too has been woefully inefficient jacobs has just 75 rushing yards in two games averaging 2 3 yards per carry and has 1 1 rush yards over expected per carry as a team the packers have 27 total missed tackles forced a trade for taylor would immediately help and green bay could potentially move on from jacobs in 2027 if not sooner the question is whether brian gutekunst who played it conservatively with his backfield entering the season would shell out the draft picks needed to make the deal i m not holding my breath even though the fit makes sense the minnesota passing offense has been horrific with kyler murray at the helm carson wentz may coax more consistency this week but a long term upgrade at running back could help solve another issue for the vikings aaron jones and jordan mason have dealt with injuries and while they have generated yardage it s been inefficient jones is averaging 0 5 rush yards over expected this season and mason sits at 0 3 the vikings run attack lacks explosive plays jones and mason have combined for 14 runs of 10 plus yards taylor has 18 alone this season minnesota s poor interior blocking has played a role but the inability of the vikings backs to break tackles has led to a stymied attack 24 combined missed tackles forced from jones and mason taylor has 35 upgrading the rushing attack would help make the passing attack easier by keeping the vikings in better down and distance situations john harbaugh hasn t been shy about checking in on upgrades up and down the roster for the nfc east leaders while the giants have other needs adding a player of taylor s caliber would certainly boost j j mccarthy and the offense injuries have siphoned off the depth of the backfield tyrone tracy is on injured reserve and starter cam skattebo is dealing with a hamstring injury devin singletary stands as the primary back if skattebo can t go this week taylor and skatt would make a nice one two punch that big blue could lean on down the stretch a splash move at the deadline could go a long way to ensuring the giants keep their division lead into january and provide them a chance to pull off a postseason upset there has been scuttlebutt for weeks about the broncos potentially trading for taylor the denver rushing attack can t find a groove ranking in the bottom seven in yards per game 92 6 and sitting 26th with a 36 2 run success rate broncos rbs have combined for 10 runs of 10 plus yards this season rj harvey landing on injured reserve wiped out one option j k dobbins has been inefficient averaging 3 3 yards per carry with 100 rush yards over expected jonah coleman has shown some upside the past two weeks since returning from injury including posting 104 scrimmage yards in week 8 is it enough to quiet the concerns cincy is possibly the most interesting landing spot for taylor chase brown is a solid dual threat back and the bengals are a pass funnel offense behind joe burrow however adding an upper echelon runner could provide a completely different dimension to the offense it d be a play for the playoffs when a ground attack could be even more beneficial particularly in bad weather games cincinnati has attempted 21 9 rushes per game second fewest in the nfl behind only green bay on 94 carries brown has generated 340 yards and one td with a 35 1 success rate taylor could provide a completely different tackle breaking element pair taylor s ability to slam through light boxes with burrow s dive bombing ability and the bengals chances of returning to the super bowl would skyrocket injuries and ineffectiveness have forced washington to cycle through backs this year jacory croskey merritt still leads the commanders in rushing despite landing on injured reserve after only five games rachaad white has offered no consistency austin ekeler is 31 coming off a season ending injury and jeremy mcnichols is out for the season it s not pretty even at 2 4 1 washington isn t out of the nfc east hunt this week could be significant for that race taylor s multi year contract also puts the commanders in play for me he d provide jayden daniels a reliable running mate beyond 2026 and solve a significant problem in d c news of treveyon henderson s unexpected medical emergency gives the pats more incentive to upgrade the backfield rhamondre stevenson has averaged 3 8 yards per carry corey kiner who has impressed in limited opportunities and generated 29 rush yards over expected on just 42 carries could see a significant increase in reps however with henderson sidelined we shouldn t rule out the pats who have surged back into contention from making a splash

news_mentions.headline: Nick Sirianni not ruling out staff changes during Eagles' bye week following 7th consecutive loss
news_mentions.description: The Philadelphia Eagles lost their seventh consecutive game, falling 19-11 to the New York Giants on Sunday afternoon.
news_mentions.body_text: the philadelphia eagles head into the bye week spiraling losers of seven straight including sunday s 19 11 defeat to the new york giants with the trade deadline approaching the roster could look different when the club returns coach nick sirianni also didn t rule out staffing changes over the week off we ll talk sirianni said via espn obviously right now my job is to be there for our guys and to go watch the tape and go look through everything i ll do anything i can to help this team win football games i ll look at myself internally first and then go from there my job is to coach the players and to coach the coaches and anything i can do to help this team win games we ll do everything can always be on the table but i don t think you change just to change because that s what your record says that you ve got to look at what s really real and not react to anything else with the playoffs a pipe dream at this point the eagles are obvious sellers ahead of tuesday s trade deadline even if howie roseman doesn t gut the entire roster at the very least players on expiring contracts such as tight end dallas goedert corner tariq woolen and defensive tackle moro ojomo should garner trade interest the offensive struggles have been the no 1 reason behind the eagles plummet both before and after jalen hurts went down with blood clots sean mannion a 34 year old first time play caller hasn t had a handle on what the offense does well or how he wants to frame game plans the instability up front has been one big issue the offensive line has struggled from the onset lane johnson s retirement stung and the club jettisoned cam jurgens after the center s struggles continued the ground game has been horrific and whoever has been under center has struggled to generate positive plays after entering sunday s game with the league s worst three and out rate the joe milton led offense failed to earn a first down on seven drives in the loss to the giants milton took over for an ineffective tanner mckee while the offense tried to stretch the field a bit more and milton used his legs well it looked like an operation led by a qb making his first start after being in town for only a few weeks philly has had to operate at times without key players from hurts to johnson to devonta smith to saquon barkley and others however it s been more than just injuries that have stymied the eagles offense mannion and offensive line coach chris kuper are squarely in the crosshairs of criticism heading into the bye obviously none of us offensively have done a good enough job we re not going to sit here as coaches and it s not sean it s all of us and it starts with me sirianni said i think the correct question there to me is do you think you ve done a good enough job obviously i haven t done a good enough job we all have things that we ve got to get better at and we ve got to figure it out on offense if sirianni plans to make an in season change to his coaching staff the bye week makes the most sense to pull the trigger

news_mentions.headline: John Harbaugh is Giants' biggest asset in years. Can he lead them on a dream playoff run?
news_mentions.body_text: philadelphia john harbaugh was smiling on his sunday walk to the bus when he was reminded of something he said soon after the baltimore ravens fired him before the new york giants had even scooped up that fumble he had watched the 4 13 giants on tape and saw more talent than he expected told at the time that the open atlanta falcons job in the nfc south would give him a cleaner path to a division title in year 1 harbaugh said he wasn 39 t afraid of the competition in the nfc east he maintained that the same giants who had gone 13 38 over the previous three seasons could contend for their first division crown since 2011 a half hour after harbaugh agreed to become the giants 39 coach he told the athletic 34 i expect and want to make the playoffs next year 34 meaning this season 34 i thought we had good players 34 harbaugh said as he was leaving lincoln financial field as the first giants head coach to win in this building since tom coughlin in 2013 34 i didn 39 t really know the personality of the team but i think what i learned is these guys have what it takes they 39 re tough minded they 39 ve got big hearts and they 39 re willing to do what it takes having what it takes means you 39 re willing to do what it takes and they 39 ve been willing to do it they work they believe and they don 39 t flinch 34 with his first place giants at 5 2 1 after a gloriously ugly 19 11 victory over the philadelphia eagles and with his team three loss column games ahead of the dallas cowboys and washington commanders and five ahead of the eagles harbaugh was asked how far this joyride can go 34 everything is possible for every team so we 39 ve got as much chance as anybody else or more than most 34 he said 34 but we don 39 t talk about that 34 the first coach hired by the giants with a super bowl victory on his resume is too smart to dream out loud about the kind of magical way out of left field super bowl run that the new england patriots made last year on cue harbaugh said his only competitive thoughts are on thursday night against the commanders at metlife 34 but we have the lead 34 he conceded 34 my mom always said 39 keep the lead and extend the lead 39 we 39 ve got to keep winning those big picture conversations are good for you guys to talk about we 39 re only focused now on the commanders 34 this is what football coaches are trained to say they can 39 t order their players to remain locked in on the next practice rep in one breath and then address the possibility of matching the new york knicks 39 ticker tape parade in the next even after harbaugh improved his post bye week record to 16 3 and ended the giants 39 13 game losing streak in philly where he was once a longtime special teams coordinator unsure if he 39 d ever get to run his own team in the nfl and man is he ever running this team the giants did not play like a winning postseason team for much of the day especially in the first half when they allowed j j mccarthy to get sacked five times deonte banks committed a pass interference penalty that gifted the eagles a touchdown charlie jones fumbled away a punt down 8 6 to a team that had lost six in a row harbaugh spent part of halftime telling his players their performance was not acceptable 34 our head coach came in there and said we 39 ve got to clean our s up 34 francis mauigoa said 34 he 39 s the driver of the ship 133 and he keeps us focused he came in there and told us to handle our s and told us we had a lot of penalties a lot of missed blocks and we 39 re still only down two points he had that positivity in there but he also had that reality that we need to pick it up 34 patrick ricard who spent nine years with harbaugh in baltimore said the positive part of the coach 39 s halftime message 34 after how bad we looked it 39 s still a two point game 34 was important for the giants to hear 34 he has an accountability and set belief that guys hold onto especially in games like this 34 ricard said 34 maybe in years past here the guys didn 39 t get that from the coaches as much so that 39 s what 39 s been instilled in them as a group i feel like here everything is growing every week and it 39 s why you usually see a second half surge from us 34 that surge came despite the apparent knockout blow eagles linebacker zack baun delivered to mccarthy 39 s right hip leaving the quarterback in so much pain he collapsed to a knee on the sideline after one warmup throw jameis winston led the giants on a stirring 14 play touchdown drive offering the best of 34 the experience 34 with his arm and legs yet harbaugh replaced him when mccarthy suddenly returned from the locker room saying he was good to go you could argue winston deserved to stay in but almost every move harbaugh has made on and off the field including the trade for mccarthy and the two year extension for winston not everyone in the coach 39 s circle of trust loved that signing has come up roses harbaugh drafted arvell reese and reese spent the afternoon looking like a cross between harry carson and lawrence taylor harbaugh didn 39 t bring in a kicker to challenge dominic zvada and the kicker went 4 for 4 on his field goal attempts including three from between 49 and 53 yards there were all kinds of reasons for the giants to lose this game starting with the trade deadline talk that dominated the week it sure seemed sunday that the ghosts were swirling at the linc way up there with braden mann 39 s monster punt from the front of his own end zone that traveled 94 yards and was officially marked at 86 but harbaugh 39 s winning past has the giants believing in the present asked how much his coach has impacted this season kayvon thibodeaux replied 34 one hundred percent however much you can think a head coach should impact winning he 39 s impacted it 34 i think it 39 s from the day he walked in from the plan he put in and the systems he put in place one thing harbaugh 39 s talked about is principles and methods he 39 s strict on his principles and he 39 s flexible on his methods and i think that formula has allowed us to 133 let our best players play their best 34 so how far can the giants 39 best take them after losing jaxson dart brian burns and tremaine edmunds to season ending injuries can they win playoff games if they don 39 t land jonathan taylor or some other difference maker by tuesday 39 s 4 p m et trade deadline 34 that 39 s the beautiful thing in the nfl 34 ricard said 34 you never know right you never know if this is the team that can go win the super bowl all we can worry about is just getting healthy every week getting the game plan from the coaches and trying to execute on game day and just play as hard as we can the teams that win the super bowl do that they just focus on the day the mission at hand they don 39 t worry about winning the super bowl it just happens by working hard and sticking together 34 i feel like we have that makeup so why not us at the end of the day right we 39 ll just continue to get better and work and maybe it 39 s in the cards for us 34 more likely it 39 s next year or the year after or the year after that yet there 39 s no point in these giants putting an artificial ceiling on their dreams on the bus ride in harbaugh reflected on his departure from philadelphia for baltimore nearly two decades ago this homecoming with his giants touched his heart 34 it was really something 34 he said 34 i didn 39 t think it was going to be quite that 34 but he did think the giants could win the nfc east before the team even hired him before he became the franchise 39 s most valuable asset in a long long time this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Giants' Devin Singletary ready for showcase as likely RB1 vs. Eagles: 'I know what I can do'
news_mentions.description: New York Giants running back Devin Singletary, the team's overtime hero in Week 7, could be in line to lead the way on the ground this Sunday against the Philadelphia Eagles. After three healthy scratches earlier this season, he's ready for that chance.
news_mentions.body_text: just like that devin singletary will potentially be the last man standing on sunday against the eagles the giants running back room has been whittled down from a core four earlier this season to one as cam skattebo is currently doubtful to play due to a hamstring injury tyrone tracy was placed on injured reserve and najee harris was released on oct 20 the 29 year old singletary who played the hero with a 30 yard game winning touchdown run in overtime against the texans in week 7 is ready to meet the moment i know what i can do singletary said via the new york post i want to be able to display that singletary s newfound opportunity is surprising not just because of new york s rb depth only a few weeks ago but because of where the veteran ball carrier found himself in the pecking order he was a healthy scratch fourth of four on the depth chart in weeks 3 5 though that was something new for singletary who hasn t missed more than two games in a season for any reason since his 2019 rookie campaign he maintained the right attitude i just stayed positive because that s who i am singletary said do you want it to go down like this no but it s the nature of the beast i wouldn t say it was frustrating it s how the game goes a lot of competition deep backfield when that opportunity comes you want to be ready instead of being so mad or sad that you can t capture the moment when it s here singletary finally got back on the field in week 6 against the saints as new york momentarily shifted away from its normal lead back skattebo for the outing skattebo didn t receive a carry whereas six other giants players logged at least one rushing attempt singletary had four for 18 yards plus a 19 yard reception the giants released harris following the contest and tracy injured his hamstring the following game against houston in that one skattebo resumed his typical workload handling 17 carries for 124 yards and a score but on his final attempt a 42 yarder into texans territory during ot he felt something in his hamstring skattebo slid down to protect against injuring it further singletary stepped up and he broke through for the 30 yard game winner the very next play although skattebo hasn t been ruled out he managed only a limited practice friday before receiving a doubtful designation that means singletary could very well see an extended chance to build on his big run that took place before the team s week 8 bye he would be joined by rookie gregory desrosiers and phil mafah who was elevated from the practice squad in the backfield should singletary get the start it will be his first since week 2 of 2025 a very much unforeseen development for the eight year vet hoping to stack some success for big blue

news_mentions.headline: NFL trade grades: Evaluating every deal made ahead of the 2026 deadline
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Kevin Patra grades every trade made since the start of the 2026 regular season until Nov. 10's trade deadline.
news_mentions.body_text: with the 2026 nfl trade deadline set for nov 10 nfl com s kevin patra breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season ravens add journeyman qb after jackson huntley injured date of trade nov 6 baltimore receives qb jacoby brissett 2027 fifth round draft pick grade b arizona receives 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 seventh round draft pick grade b sometimes even in the nfl trades make too much sense not to happen when the ravens lost both lamar jackson and tyler huntley to injury all eyes turned to jacoby brissett whom the arizona cardinals had just benched days later we get a trade baltimore had to make a move jesse minters squad found itself floating up the creek without either paddle forced to steer with a soup spoon it would have been unfair to joe fagnano and the rest of the team to ride the undrafted rookie the rest of the way as we saw thursday night fagnano is simply outmatched right now the free agent options offered little better enter brissett the 33 year old journeyman joins his seventh team in seven seasons he should be able to get up to speed quickly having his former qb coach israel woolfork in baltimore makes the transition easier after sitting out the offseason in an effort to get a reworked contract brissett struggled to fit into mike lafleur s offense he s been a bottom quarter passer this season ranking 18th of 23 qbs in epa per dropback at 0 11 min 200 attempts his stats are down across the board from last season when he finished with 3 366 yards a 23 8 td int ratio a 94 1 passer rating and a 0 05 epa per dropback there is a reason brissett has bounced around there is also a reason he keeps winding up a starter brissett s not the ideal franchise setter but he s a solid addition to a floundering ravens squad that has lost four straight games the hope is that he fits in declan doyle s offense better and gets back to the distributing ways we saw last season the price is about right for a player who was benched the ravens don t currently own any non compensatory fifth or sixth round picks in 2027 so a middle round swap with a 2028 final round sweetener was about as best as they could do it s not great to spend assets to solve a problem on a sinking ship but baltimore couldn t move forward with what it had on the slim chance brissett turns things around and pushes the ravens to the playoffs it was worth the small price the cardinals paid a couple million dollars to move on from their third string qb for a day 3 draft swap and a 2028 dart throw it s not significant capital but it s better than nothing i wonder if they might have received more by waiting until monday to see if another club minnesota jumped into the fray but arizona couldn t let the deadline pass without moving the veteran it was clear brissett was done in the desert after sunday s comeback win from gardner minshew the presence of the mania inducing veteran along with rookie carson beck made brissett superfluous in hindsight arizona probably should have moved on from brissett in the offseason while he was seeking a pay bump i understand why they didn t but he was always going to be a stopgap having two bridges to some unknown land is hardly good asset usage in that view i can t give the cards a rave review but getting even a minor upgrade in the draft is positive and if the ravens continue to spiral even with brissett that fourth rounder could be better bears trade two first rounders for all pro dt date of trade oct 29 chicago receives dt jeffery simmons 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b tennessee receives 2027 first round draft pick 2027 fourth round draft pick 2028 first round draft pick grade a ryan poles finally upgraded the defensive line since may i ve been writing that the bears lack of action along the line whether adding a dt or pass rusher was head scratching the interior was particularly troubling as the bears have been counting on 33 year old grady jarrett and journeymen kentavius street neville gallimore and james lynch coordinator dennis allen has made it work but an upgrade was warranted before the operation collapsed poles never one to sit on his hands made a massive splash simmons is the type of game changing talent who could flip a playoff game in chicago s favor already an nfc favorite to make a postseason run the 5 2 bears have made a move that puts them squarely in the running to hoist a lombardi a beast among beasts simmons leads all defensive tackles with 28 quarterback pressures and is tied for second with four sacks notably he s racked up that production on a titans team that has been behind a lot this season imagine the numbers he d put up in game scripts that force more passes from the offense we re about to find out the 29 year old isn t just a get up the field fly wildly at the quarterback defensive tackle either no no no simmons is a wrecking ball to whatever unfortunate soul might be clutching the pigskin when he s on the warpath in addition to owning the most qb pressures among dts he also is tied for second with 21 run stops and tied for third with seven run stuffs per next gen stats there has been some chatter that his play has waned this season in tennessee i don t buy it if you haven t seen the man with the red armband manically flying around the field in tennessee this season you haven t been watching simmons has been every bit as good as any interior defender this season in the chicago spotlight he could push his way into the dpoy conversation the move could tip the balance of the nfc north and the entire conference in the bears favor that s how good simmons is from a pure player addition standpoint it s a home run for poles the issue is the compensation two first round picks and a fourth rounder is a massive haul it s also notable that the fifth round pick the bears got back with simmons is in 2028 not 2027 two first rounders for a non quarterback is a huge cost i understand why poles was willing to do it with most of his key players on rookie contracts now it was the time to strike however after he pays all those guys including quarterback caleb williams he ll need good players on cheap rookie deals to keep things rolling recent non quarterbacks traded for multiple first round picks include edge rusher micah parsons cornerback sauce gardner offensive tackle laremy tunsil safety jamal adams and edge khalil mack to chicago in 2018 that s a mixed bag of results if i m being kind and some outright cringey mistakes including gardner last year a d lineman isn t a cb but it s still a hefty price for anyone who doesn t sling the oblong the bears doing this twice is notable mack didn t bring the bears a super bowl two playoff appearances however the situation feels different this time chicago has a clear franchise difference maker at quarterback the other recent comparable trade was the dallas cowboys sending a first and second rounder for interior defensive lineman quinnen williams at the deadline last season i should note that simmons is older than every single player i mentioned above was at the time of their trade how the dt ages will factor into what this trade looks like three years from now if there was a parade in downtown chicago before then the locals won t care about the cost of two firsts this was a no brainer for the titans two firsts for a non qb for a team that isn t one player away from contending in a heartbeat simmons was a leader and the squad s pulse but when you have that kind of offer you have to pull the trigger tennessee isn t a jeffery simmons away from being a perennial contender his next few years would have been spent withering away during yet another rebuild and he d have lost trade value it s going to stink for the rest of the locker room this year as robert saleh s team figures to continue struggling however that would be the case with or without simmons until second year qb cam ward morphs into a consistent difference maker not just a sometimes player the titans won t take a step forward if that doesn t happen tennessee will need all the first round picks it can get to find the next guy and give him the best chance to succeed colts part with another pro bowler get pick from 49ers date of trade oct 27 san francisco receives dl deforest buckner grade a indianapolis receives 2027 fourth round draft pick grade b we didn t have to wait long to find out how others in the nfc west would react to the seahawks splash move for quenton nelson hours later the 49ers bolstered their defensive interior by bringing back buckner whom they traded to indy in 2020 the reunion was telegraphed for weeks buckner clearly fed up with the mounting losses in indianapolis began voicing his displeasure couple that with the 49ers need along the defensive line and the move made almost too much sense the niners have the cap space to cover the remainder of buckner s contract assuming it s not adjusted and are all in after their first loss of the season buckner has 47 0 sacks since 2020 tied for second among defensive tackles behind only chris jones 55 122 qb hits 420 tackles and 312 qb pressures the big man can still be a people mover on the interior however the 32 year old is showing some signs of a slide he generated four sacks in 10 games in 2025 his fewest since 2017 his pass rush percentages are also down a tick from the past couple of years he s generated an 8 3 qb pressure rate through seven games buckner was at 10 3 in 2025 and 11 7 in 2024 similarly his run stop rates have dipped as well going from 15 7 in 2024 to 15 6 in 2025 to 12 4 in 2026 is it age or can we just chalk the dips up to playing in a struggling defense for a losing team regardless of whether he s on the downturn buckner represents an upgrade in the middle of the 49ers battered defensive line paired with osa odighizuwa the niners now have two players who can push the pocket if buckner also boosts the interior run d probably the 49ers weakest spot at this point it will be a clear win for the niners the cost might be a tad much for an 11 year pro on the back nine of his career who could be a short term rental but a fourth rounder isn t exorbitant by any stretch it s the type of move a team like the 49ers in a super bowl window should make i ll reward aggression with day 3 draft picks when it nets a good player who can make a difference in a playoff run buckner was probably the most obvious asset the colts had that was going to be moved he was in the final year of his contract clearly unhappy and any compensatory pick they could have received back would have been at most a fifth rounder in 2028 due to how long he s been in the league if he even signs a deal big enough to qualify in 2027 getting a fourth rounder in 2027 out of that is a win for indy the colts need as many lotto tickets as possible for the next general manager i d expect ed dodds to listen to offers on any of his pending free agents and potentially others under contract beyond 2027 the only real issue with the oct 27 deal is that as with nelson the colts might have gotten more for buckner possibly a late round sweetener by shopping him around for another two weeks even with that qualification i still like the return indy got in this swap seahawks acquire eight time pro bowl guard from colts date of trade oct 27 seattle receives g quenton nelson grade a indianapolis receives 2027 third round draft pick 2028 fifth round draft pick grade b the seahawks had some sneaky issues along the offensive line despite entering the season with the same five that helped win a super bowl while the run game concerns have mostly been pinned on the running backs the blocking has struggled to open holes on 184 rb carries the seahawks have just 92 yards before contact this season per next gen stats and they ve been stuffed 37 times that s not the type of offense mike macdonald wants to employ yes getting zach charbonnet and jadarian price back healthy could have helped but general manager john schneider went to cure the root cause nelson is an eight time pro bowl guard who is still playing at a hall of fame level the 30 year old can open holes in the run game is a weapon as a puller and is superior as a pass protector in eight seasons in indy he allowed no more than eight qb hits in a single season per pff the seahawks just added the nfl s most complete guard how will the rest of the nfc west respond the addition will immediately help sam darnold keeping the qb clean will go a long way toward negating some of the wayward interceptions adding nelson also aids whoever lines up at left tackle where starter charles cross is expected to miss a week or two with a high ankle sprain importing the left guard will bump second year player grey zabel to right guard where he played in college and where seattle has had trouble for a while anthony bradford struggled even during the super bowl run the price for seattle is excellent given that it s expected to get a slew of compensatory picks in 2027 nelson being on an expiring deal also helps if he leaves for a big deal the seahawks would be in line for another comp pick in 2028 we ve seen schneider re sign players acquired in season as well leonard williams and rashid shaheed so it s not guaranteed to be a rental for the seahawks either it s not every day you can snag a future hall of famer to fill a significant hole without giving up a pick in the top two rounds i was somewhat surprised indy couldn t get a second round pick back given the overwhelming need across the league along the offensive line but we know that gms are stingier in season then become drunken sailors on draft day so maybe i shouldn t be so amazed i can t blame the colts for moving any and all assets to recoup chris ballard s mistakes but i wonder if they d have gotten more by waiting until closer to the deadline without a first round pick which right now would be in the top 10 and a roster riddled with holes the next general manager needs as much ammo as possible stripping down the roster will only make the sauce gardner trade sting even more given nelson s status as a pending free agent the colts could have waited and let him walk in free agency but the compensation would have been a third round pick max in 2028 this trade allows them to get the pick a year earlier and adds a fifth round sweetener trading away their best player two weeks before the trade deadline suggests a teardown is in play indy should be very active over the next fortnight and you can bet any gm with a need is going to put in a call to colts interim gm ed dodds cards deal former no 4 pick to texans date of trade oct 12 houston receives wr marvin harrison 2027 sixth round draft pick grade c arizona receives 2027 second round draft pick 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b when the trade details came through i assumed it was a typo that the texans shipped a 2027 second round pick for a player who was clearly out of the rotation in arizona my brain rationalized it as a 2028 second rounder or a 2027 fourth rounder nope the texans paid a premium pick in the upcoming draft for a shot at revitalizing harrison s career the cards reportedly had made it known they were holding out for a second round pick the moment the texans upped their bid to a second in 2027 they pounced i don t fault arizona for moving on right now in four games in 2026 harrison caught five passes on 13 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown that s like a half of one game for the upper echelon of wrs harrison has generated 0 6 yards per route run this year the third lowest among players with at least 100 routes per next gen stats basically harrison has been doing little more than a cardio workout on sundays getting a second rounder is solid work the grade isn t higher because the same brass that acquired that asset used the no 4 overall pick on harrison in 2024 monti ossenfort still gets docked for whiffing on a prime selection i understand why the texans would take a swing on harrison like most of the league they probably gave the ohio state product a very high pre draft grade reuniting him with former buckeyes teammate c j stroud could bring out the best in the wideout the texans have struggled mightily to move the ball when nico collins has been injured and given collins history and the hard hits he takes he s not guaranteed to make it through the rest of the season without missing time after laying an egg for four weeks the 1 4 texans don t have any more wiggle room harrison s contract isn t onerous giving houston some insurance if tank dell never returns to form or jayden higgins is delayed next year coming off a season ending injury in the short term this trade is somewhat duplicative of the much cheaper deal in which it acquired kayshon boutte it s more costly but gives the club more control of the future mostly i don t love the price tag for a player who hasn t been who we thought he was for it to make sense to give up a day 2 pick the texans need harrison to finally break out after two mediocre seasons perhaps in improved surroundings and on a team that clearly wants him with a qb he knows and trusts harrison can blossom frankly i probably like many scouts can t figure out the disconnect between a player who looked as polished and well rounded as harrison did at osu and the one we ve seen lope about for two plus years the question is whether you believe the scouting or the two separate coaching staffs who haven t found much use for him the texans are betting on their scouting eagles send pro bowl ol to ravens date of trade oct 7 baltimore receives c cam jurgens 2027 seventh round draft pick grade b philadelphia receives 2027 fifth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade a we should start with the obvious the two time pro bowler was available for a reason especially after the same offensive line saw a future hall of famer lane johnson retire the day prior jurgens is currently a pro bowler in name only after battling through a back injury in 2024 to help the eagles net a super bowl ring jurgens has not been the same player he struggled through last season and has been a liability through four games this year his pass blocking has never been otherworldly but it s particularly crumbled after he was asked to move to left guard the past three weeks blame the previous injuries or the ill fit in the eagles new blocking scheme but jurgens has been borderline unplayable the past few weeks drew kendall played better than jurgens at center in sean mannion s scheme so a move back wasn t in the cards it got so bad that nick sirianni was fending off questions about potentially benching the guard instead philly shipped him out of town we know that howie roseman doesn t care what year he gets his picks famously saying a first round pick is a first round pick regarding the a j brown trade this offseason when philly netted a 28 first however we can dock him ever so slightly for delayed satisfaction otherwise getting a second rounder for a struggling player who was not a fit is a home run in the short term the eagles offensive line is in flux with willie lampkin in line to take over at guard the hope is that landon dickerson returns to form when he eventually comes off injured reserve the trade is jarring coming right after johnson s retirement but getting a significant draft pick back for a player who was on the verge of being benched makes sense philly is now loaded in the 2028 draft with two firsts and two seconds even acknowledging jurgens significant struggles the play makes sense for the ravens the plans to replace tyler linderbaum who signed with the raiders in free agency this summer were wobbly from the start the ones they rode with danny pinter jovaughn gwyn and ethan pocic have all landed on injured reserve counting on pocic coming off injury was always a gamble the ravens crapped out instead of sticking with rookie olaivavega ioane out of position at center baltimore will take a roll of the dice that jurgens can get back to form it s not a terrible gamble and it s conceivable the 27 year old can bounce back with a return to center in a different scheme jurgens contract which has him under team control through 2029 for relatively cheap is also desirable for baltimore injury is always part of the equation and jurgens enters his time in baltimore in the league s concussion protocol nfl network s mike garafolo reported if he s healthy and returns to form this will be an excellent move for baltimore if he continues to struggle or misses a ton of time it will be the latest swing and miss in trying to replace linderbaum porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york
